facts.sourceQuote: AFC was founded in 1895 when a group of young Amsterdammers decided to create a football club. On 18 January 1895 the founding meeting took place in the basement of a house on the Koninginneweg where after a long discussion the name "Amsterdamsche Football Club (AFC)" was chosen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AFC was founded in 1895 when a group of young Amsterdammers decided to create a football club. On 18 January 1895 the founding meeting took place in the basement of a house on the Koninginneweg where after a long discussion the name "Amsterdamsche Football Club (AFC)" was chosen.

facts.text: AFC won championships in 1906, 1909, and 2019 among fourteen total titles.
facts.sourceQuote: AFC-1 were crowned champions 14 times; 1906, 1909, 1917, 1918, 1919, 1946, 1961, 1963, 1967, 1969, 2001, 2010, 2014 and 2019, while also having been relegated three times; 1921, 1922 and 1998.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AFC-1 were crowned champions 14 times; 1906, 1909, 1917, 1918, 1919, 1946, 1961, 1963, 1967, 1969, 2001, 2010, 2014 and 2019, while also having been relegated three times; 1921, 1922 and 1998.

facts.text: By its centenary in 1995, AFC had grown to over 1,500 members from just fifteen at founding.
facts.sourceQuote: Despite only having 15 members when founded, by the time of the club's 50th anniversary (1945) it had over 700. By AFC's 100-year existence (1995) it has more than 1,500 members and in summer 2016 the club, including non-playing donors, over 2,100 members.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Despite only having 15 members when founded, by the time of the club's 50th anniversary (1945) it had over 700. By AFC's 100-year existence (1995) it has more than 1,500 members and in summer 2016 the club, including non-playing donors, over 2,100 members.

features.opening: Amsterdamsche Football Club, commonly known as AFC is a football club based in Amsterdam.

features.name: English Reformed Church

facts.text: The English Reformed Church serves an English-speaking congregation.
facts.sourceQuote: It is home to an English-speaking congregation which is affiliated to the Church of Scotland and to the Protestant Church in the Netherlands (formerly Dutch Reformed Church).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is home to an English-speaking congregation which is affiliated to the Church of Scotland and to the Protestant Church in the Netherlands (formerly Dutch Reformed Church).

features.opening: The English Reformed Church is one of the oldest buildings in Amsterdam, situated in the Begijnhof, in the centre of the city.

features.name: Bijzondere Collecties

facts.text: Monastery libraries annexed in 1578 formed the basis for Amsterdam's new City Library.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de alteratie van 1578 werden de kloosterbibliotheken van Amsterdam door de stad geannexeerd. Zij vormden de basis voor de nieuwe Stadsbibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the alteration of 1578, the monastery libraries of Amsterdam were annexed by the city. They formed the basis for the new City Library.

facts.text: The library supported the Athenaeum Illustre, founded in 1632 as a precursor to the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de stad faciliteerde de bibliotheek het in 1632 opgerichte Athenaeum Illustre, de voorloper van de Universiteit van Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the city, the library facilitated the Athenaeum Illustre, founded in 1632, the precursor to the Universiteit of Amsterdam.

facts.text: In 1877, the Athenaeum Illustre became a municipal university, elevating the City Library to a university library.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1877 werd het Athenaeum Illustre verheven tot gemeentelijke universiteit en de Stadsbibliotheek daarmee tot universiteitsbibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1877, the Athenaeum Illustre was elevated to municipal university and the City Library was thus elevated to university library.

facts.text: Most large collections were acquired after 1850, including the medical society's library by 1855.
facts.sourceQuote: Maar de meeste grote collecties werden verworven na 1850. De bibliotheek van de Nederlandsche Maatschappij tot Bevordering der Geneeskunst werd bijvoorbeeld al in 1855 ondergebracht in de Stadsbibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: But most of the large collections were acquired after 1850. For example, the library of the Nederlandsche Maatschappij tot Bevordering der Geneeskunst was already housed in the Stadsbibliotheek in 1855.

facts.text: The Bibliotheca Rosenthaliana became the first department in 1880 after Leeser Rosenthal donated Jewish and Hebrew works.
facts.sourceQuote: De schenking van een belangrijke collectie Joodse en Hebreeuwse werken van Leeser Rosenthal in 1880 leidde tot de oprichting van de eerste afdeling binnen de Universiteitsbibliotheek, de Bibliotheca Rosenthaliana, met een eigen conservator en gehuisvest in een eigen zaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The donation of an important collection of Jewish and Hebrew works by Leeser Rosenthal in 1880 led to the establishment of the first department within the University Library, the Bibliotheca Rosenthaliana, with its own curator and housed in its own room.

facts.text: Separate conservators were appointed specifically for printed works and manuscripts shortly after the first department was established.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna werden er al snel afzonderlijke conservatoren aangesteld voor de gedrukte werken en de handschriften.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, separate conservators were soon appointed for the printed works and the manuscripts.

features.opening: The Bijzondere Collecties of the University of Amsterdam is part of the University Library of Amsterdam.

features.name: Dam Square Victims 7 mei 1945

facts.text: The Algemeen Handelsblad reported nineteen victims following the shooting event.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Algemeen Handelsblad maakte toen melding van negentien slachtoffers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Algemeen Handelsblad then reported nineteen victims.

facts.text: Initial records assumed twenty deaths, but investigation revealed thirty-one fatal casualties.
facts.sourceQuote: Men ging daarbij uit van een twintigtal doden; het bleek na onderzoek om eenendertig dodelijke slachtoffers te gaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was assumed that there were twenty deaths; it turned out after investigation that there were thirty-one fatal casualties.

facts.text: Sand-blasted stones measuring sixty by forty centimeters were manufactured in Belgium for the memorial.
facts.sourceQuote: Die gezandstraalde stenen van ongeveer 60 bij 40 centimeter werden gefabriceerd bij de firma Gielkens in België en kwamen te liggen tussen het Damrak en de Nieuwendijk (schuin tegenover De Groote Club).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Those sand-blasted stones of about 60 by 40 centimeters were manufactured by the Gielkens company in Belgium and were laid between the Damrak and the Nieuwendijk (across from De Groote Club).

features.opening: A plaque and thirty-two street stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the Shooting on the Dam on May 7, 1945.

features.name: Plaquette Chet Baker

facts.text: Artist Zhuk depicted Baker as he appeared in the 1970s on the bronze surface.
facts.sourceQuote: Zhuk beeldde Chet Baker af zoals hij er de jaren zeventig van de 20e eeuw moet hebben uitgezien.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Zhuk depicted Chet Baker as he must have looked in the 1970s of the 20th century.

features.opening: The Plaquette Chet Baker is an artistic work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Buiksloterkerk

facts.text: No church services have been held at this site since 1984.
facts.sourceQuote: Er worden sinds 1984 geen kerkdiensten meer gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: No church services have been held since 1984.

facts.text: Construction in 1710 incorporated older elements like beautifully carved seventeenth-century corbels.
facts.sourceQuote: De eenbeukige, vijfzijdig gesloten kerk kwam in 1710 tot stand met gebruikmaking van oudere onderdelen waaronder fraai gesneden zeventiende-eeuwse korbelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The single-aisled, five-sided closed church was built in 1710 using older parts including beautifully carved seventeenth-century corbels.

facts.text: A mid-seventeenth-century pulpit stands alongside a baptismal cover dating from 1788.
facts.sourceQuote: De preekstoel dateert uit het midden van de 17de eeuw, het doophek uit 1788.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pulpit dates from the mid-17th century, the baptismal cover from 1788.

features.opening: The Buiksloterkerk is the (former) village church of the dike village Buiksloot in Amsterdam-Noord.

features.name: The Amsterdam Dungeon

facts.text: A prop grave for Rembrandt van Rijn appears in the show, though he is actually buried elsewhere.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam Dungeon features a prop grave belonging to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn (who is mentioned in one of the shows). While it is very convincing, Rembrandt van Rijn is actually buried in the Westerkerk, a different church in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam Dungeon features a prop grave belonging to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn (who is mentioned in one of the shows). While it is very convincing, Rembrandt van Rijn is actually buried in the Westerkerk, a different church in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The attraction features a Nieuwezijdse Kapel built atop several real but invisible graves.
facts.sourceQuote: However, the Nieuwezijdse Kapel is built on top of several real graves, none of which are visible to the Dungeon's visitors.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the Nieuwezijdse Kapel is built on top of several real graves, none of which are visible to the Dungeon's visitors.

facts.text: British company Merlin Entertainments owns and operates the site.
facts.sourceQuote: The attraction is owned and operated by British company Merlin Entertainments, and is similar to Merlin's other properties, the London Dungeon, York Dungeon, Berlin Dungeon and Hamburg Dungeon.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The attraction is owned and operated by British company Merlin Entertainments, and is similar to Merlin's other properties, the London Dungeon, York Dungeon, Berlin Dungeon and Hamburg Dungeon.

facts.text: Live actors, rides, shows, and special effects simulate dark historical times.
facts.sourceQuote: It depicts history through an interactive adventure, using live actors, a ride, shows and special effects to simulate historical dark and bleak times.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It depicts history through an interactive adventure, using live actors, a ride, shows and special effects to simulate historical dark and bleak times.

features.opening: The Amsterdam Dungeon is a haunted attraction in central Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: The Movies

facts.text: Founded in 1912 as Bioscoop Tavenu, the cinema changed its name to Cinema Hollandia just two years later.
facts.sourceQuote: The Movies is opgericht in 1912 onder de naam Bioscoop Tavenu. Reeds twee jaar later werd de naam gewijzigd in Cinema Hollandia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Movies was founded in 1912 under the name Bioscoop Tavenu. Two years later, the name was changed to Cinema Hollandia.

facts.text: While many neighborhood cinemas closed during the 1960s, this specific location managed to survive the era.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren zestig, waar vele buurtbioscopen ten onder gingen, wist de bioscoop te overleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1960s, when many neighborhood cinemas went under, the cinema managed to survive.

facts.text: The owner initially wanted to call it Piccadilly but settled on The Movies.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij wilde de cinema aanvankelijk van naam laten veranderen in "Piccadilly", maar koos uiteindelijk voor de naam The Movies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He initially wanted to change the cinema's name to "Piccadilly", but eventually chose the name The Movies.

facts.text: In 2007, Roeland Kerbosch sold the cinema to Kadir Selçuk, who also owns de Filmhallen.
facts.sourceQuote: Roeland Kerbosch verkocht The Movies in oktober 2007 aan de van LantarenVenster afkomstige Kadir Selçuk, die ook eigenaar is van bioscoop de Filmhallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Roeland Kerbosch sold The Movies in October 2007 to Kadir Selçuk from van LantarenVenster, who also owns cinema de Filmhallen.

features.opening: The Movies is a cinema in Amsterdam.

features.name: The Shipping House

facts.text: The van Gendt brothers handled the concrete frame while architect Johan van der Mey led the design.
facts.sourceQuote: The building's design and execution were entrusted to the brothers Johan Godart and Adolf Daniel Nicholas van Gendt. The van Gendt brothers were responsible for the technical implementation and the design of the concrete frame. The architectural design was left to the then relatively unknown architect Johan van der Mey.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building's design and execution were entrusted to the brothers Johan Godart and Adolf Daniel Nicholas van Gendt. The van Gendt brothers were responsible for the technical implementation and the design of the concrete frame. The architectural design was left to the then relatively unknown architect Johan van der Mey.

facts.text: Sculpted exotic women personify the oceans at the main entrance to reflect Dutch colonial history.
facts.sourceQuote: For example, the outside of the building is covered in carving and relief sculptures that reflect the Dutch colonial empire, with the sculpted personifications of the oceans around the main entrance presented as "exotic mysterious women".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, the outside of the building is covered in carving and relief sculptures that reflect the Dutch colonial empire, with the sculpted personifications of the oceans around the main entrance presented as "exotic mysterious women".

facts.text: Shipping companies inside operated global lines that circumnavigated the earth from Dutch hub points.
facts.sourceQuote: The shipping companies housed inside were all involved in global trade, their combined lines "circumnavigated the earth in several directions" from Dutch hub points in the East and West Indies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The shipping companies housed inside were all involved in global trade, their combined lines "circumnavigated the earth in several directions" from Dutch hub points in the East and West Indies.

facts.text: Bricks for both construction phases were baked simultaneously to ensure uniform color.
facts.sourceQuote: In order to avoid colour variation, the bricks were baked at the same time for both construction phases.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to avoid colour variation, the bricks were baked at the same time for both construction phases.

facts.text: Thirteen existing buildings were demolished to make way for this massive structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Thirteen buildings had to be demolished: numbers 108 to 114 on Prins Hendrikkade and numbers 1 to 6 on Binnenkant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thirteen buildings had to be demolished: numbers 108 to 114 on Prins Hendrikkade and numbers 1 to 6 on Binnenkant.

facts.text: Granite, marble, and porphyry diorite were used alongside terracotta in the facade.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides terracotta, much precious stone was also used, including granite, marble and varieties of porphyry diorite.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides terracotta, much precious stone was also used, including granite, marble and varieties of porphyry diorite.

features.opening: The Shipping House (Dutch: Scheepvaarthuis) is a building on the western tip of the Waalseiland near Amsterdam harbour that is one of the top 100 Dutch…

features.name: Kraan 2868

facts.text: German occupiers destroyed all cranes in 1944, forcing post-war replacements.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944, tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog, werden de hijskranen door de Duitse bezetter vernield, waardoor na de oorlog alle kranen vernieuwd moesten worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, during World War II, the cranes were destroyed by the German occupiers, so after the war all the cranes had to be replaced.

facts.text: Figee factory produced this crane in 1957 before it served until 1979.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1957 kwam hijskraan 2868 uit de fabrieken van Figee (NV Haarlemsche Machinefabriek van de Gebroeders Figee). De kraan deed dienst tot 1979, toen de KNSM haar werkzaamheden hier beëindigde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1957, the crane 2868 came out of the factories of Figee (NV Haarlemsche Machinefabriek van de Gebroeders Figee). The crane served until 1979, when the KNSM ended its operations here.

facts.text: Neighbors convinced officials to save it from demolition while other cranes were destroyed.
facts.sourceQuote: De vele hijskranen die hier nog stonden vielen ten prooi aan de slopershamer, maar buurtbewoners wisten de gemeente Amsterdam te overtuigen deze kraan te redden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The many cranes that were still standing here fell victim to the wrecking hammer, but neighbors managed to convince the municipality of Amsterdam to save this crane.

facts.text: The crane officially became a municipal monument on November 29, 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: Het object is van het type wipkraan (geen vaste arm, maar een die in hoogte verstelbaar is) en is sinds 29 november 2011 een gemeentelijk monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The object is of the type of gantry crane (no fixed arm, but one that can be adjusted in height) and has been a municipal monument since November 29, 2011.

features.opening: Kraan 2868, also called the Figeekraan, is a former harbour crane on KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: Academie van Bouwkunst

facts.text: The school opened in 1908 to fill a forty-year gap in Amsterdam's architectural education.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1908 the Academy of Architecture Amsterdam was set up by prominent members of the association Architectura et Amicitia as a department of the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten. At that time Amsterdam had been lacking an architecture school for 40 years already, after the architecture department of Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten had been moved to the Polytechnic School of Delft (now known as Delft University of Technology) in 1870.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1908 the Academy of Architecture Amsterdam was set up by prominent members of the association Architectura et Amicitia as a department of the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten. At that time Amsterdam had been lacking an architecture school for 40 years already, after the architecture department of Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten had been moved to the Polytechnic School of Delft (now known as Delft University of Technology) in 1870.

facts.text: Urban design was already part of the unique curriculum when the academy first opened.
facts.sourceQuote: Thus at the conception of the academy, education in urban design was already provided. At that time this was a relatively new discipline, and the curriculum was unique at that time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thus at the conception of the academy, education in urban design was already provided. At that time this was a relatively new discipline, and the curriculum was unique at that time.

facts.text: The Academie van Bouwkunst stands as the largest architectural postgraduate school in the entire Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: The Academy of Architecture is the largest architectural postgraduate school in the Netherlands, offering interdisciplinary programs in architecture, urban design, and landscape architecture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Academy of Architecture is the largest architectural postgraduate school in the Netherlands, offering interdisciplinary programs in architecture, urban design, and landscape architecture.

features.opening: The Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam (Dutch: Academie van Bouwkunst Amsterdam) is a Dutch postgraduate school in architecture located in Amsterdam.

features.name: Martin Luther King

facts.text: The final bronze monument stands 1.20 meters tall and was secured using a concrete drill.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze waren intens, want het beeld moest met behulp van een betonboor op zijn plaats vastgezet worden. Het beeld is 1,20 meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These were intense, because the image had to be fixed in place using a concrete drill. The image is 1.20 meters high.

facts.text: An anonymous copy of the image was intended for Barack Obama but the project leaked before distribution.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook zou een aantal politici als Sylvana Simons, Barack Obama en Michelle Obama anoniem een exemplaar van het beeld ontvangen. Het project, in samenwerking met Ien Sluyters en Marjon Deul, lekte echter uit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of politicians such as Sylvana Simons, Barack Obama and Michelle Obama would also receive an anonymous copy of the image. However, the project, in collaboration with Ien Sluyters and Marjon Deul, leaked out.

features.opening: The Image of Martin Luther King is an artistic work of art in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam

facts.text: Josephine Tussaud, great-great-granddaughter of founder Marie Tussaud, initiated the museum's creation.
facts.sourceQuote: Museum The idea to establish a wax museum in Amsterdam came from Josephine Tussaud (1900–1985), businesswoman and great-great-granddaughter of Madame Tussauds founder Marie Tussaud.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Museum The idea to establish a wax museum in Amsterdam came from Josephine Tussaud (1900–1985), businesswoman and great-great-granddaughter of Madame Tussauds founder Marie Tussaud.

facts.text: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam opened in 1970 as the first mainland European branch.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded in 1970, it was the first Madame Tussauds that was opened in mainland Europe as well as being the first foreign branch of the British institution.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded in 1970, it was the first Madame Tussauds that was opened in mainland Europe as well as being the first foreign branch of the British institution.

features.opening: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam is a wax museum situated in Amsterdam, the capital city of the Netherlands.

features.name: Samen Spelen Samen Leven

facts.text: A sloping marble wall separates two groups of bronze playing children from two watching children.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste deel laat twee spelende kinderen van diverse komaf in brons zien; vervolgens staat er een schuin aflopende marmeren muur, waarachter twee niet spelende joodse kinderen, beteuterd en elkaar troostend, staan toe te kijken, ook in brons.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first part shows two playing children of different backgrounds in bronze; then there is a sloping marble wall, behind which two non-playing Jewish children, gesturing and comforting each other, stand watching, also in bronze.

features.opening: War memorial in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: De hongerwinter

facts.text: De hongerwinter means the hunger winter of 1944/1945 when food was scarce.
facts.sourceQuote: Het handelt over de hongerwinter 1944/1945.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is about the hunger winter 1944/1945.

facts.text: The original statue by Hildo Krop was damaged by weather and rust over the years.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat in twee versies: Het origineel, van de hand van Hildo Krop, is geplaatst in de Oosterkerk. Dit was eerst aan de straatzijde aangebracht, maar in de loop der jaren aangevreten door weersinvloeden en roetaanslag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It exists in two versions: The original, by Hildo Krop, is located in the Oosterkerk. This was initially applied on the street side, but over the years has been eaten away by weather influences and rust.

facts.text: Farmers from Groningen and Friesland secretly sent food to Amsterdam by ship.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Interkerkelijk Comité Levensmiddelenvoorziening voor De Eilanden zamelde voedsel in bij Groningse en Friese boeren, dat heimelijk per schip naar Amsterdam werd vervoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Interchurch Committee for Food Supply for the Islands collected food from Groningse and Friese farmers, which was secretly transported by ship to Amsterdam.

features.opening: De hongerwinter is a war monument on the Eastern Islands in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: AFAS Live

facts.text: The aluminum facade spells AFAS Live using 70,000 blue caps.
facts.sourceQuote: The name AFAS Live is spelt out on the aluminum facade with 70,000 blue caps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name AFAS Live is spelt out on the aluminum facade with 70,000 blue caps.

facts.text: A bomb threat at a nearby IKEA forced The Killers to postpone their March 2009 concert.
facts.sourceQuote: In March 2009, a concert by The Killers had to be postponed until May because of a bomb threat at a nearby IKEA.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2009, a concert by The Killers had to be postponed until May because of a bomb threat at a nearby IKEA.

facts.text: AFAS Live honors sponsor AFAS Software BV, standing for Applications for Administrative Solutions.
facts.sourceQuote: On 16 September 2016, it was announced that the name will be changed to AFAS Live on 1 January 2017. It is named after the venue's partner and sponsor AFAS Software BV (the acronym stands for Applications for Administrative Solutions) a business software developer in Leusden, the Netherlands with 450 employees.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 16 September 2016, it was announced that the name will be changed to AFAS Live on 1 January 2017. It is named after the venue's partner and sponsor AFAS Software BV (the acronym stands for Applications for Administrative Solutions) a business software developer in Leusden, the Netherlands with 450 employees.

facts.text: The main Black Box hall spans 3000 square meters and holds 6,000 people.
facts.sourceQuote: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.

facts.text: Heineken sponsored the venue from its 2001 opening until 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: The venue opened in 2001 and was sponsored by Heineken until 2017.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The venue opened in 2001 and was sponsored by Heineken until 2017.

facts.text: An after-party room called Beat Box accommodates up to 700 guests.
facts.sourceQuote: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.

features.opening: AFAS Live (formerly known as the Heineken Music Hall) is a concert hall in Amsterdam, Netherlands, near the Johan Cruyff Arena.

features.name: Co-kathedrale Basiliek van Sint Nicolaas

facts.text: Adrianus Bleijs designed the structure using Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance styles.
facts.sourceQuote: The architect Adrianus Bleijs (1842-1912) designed the church based on a combination of several revival styles: the most prominent being the Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Adrianus Bleijs (1842-1912) designed the church based on a combination of several revival styles: the most prominent being the Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance.

facts.text: Construction of the building was finished in the year 1887.
facts.sourceQuote: Construction was completed in 1887.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction was completed in 1887.

facts.text: A relic believed to be a fragment of Saint Nicholas's rib arrived in December 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: In December 2021, the basilica received a relic of St. Nicholas from Egmond Abbey. Said to be a fragment of the saint's rib, the bone had been in the custody of the abbey since 1087.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In December 2021, the basilica received a relic of St. Nicholas from Egmond Abbey. Said to be a fragment of the saint's rib, the bone had been in the custody of the abbey since 1087.

facts.text: Saint Nicholas serves as the patron saint for both this church and the entire city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The basilica honors Saint Nicholas, who is the patron saint of the city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.

features.opening: The Co-cathedral Basilica of Saint Nicholas (Dutch: Co-kathedrale Basiliek van de Heilige Nicolaas) is located in the Old Centre district of Amsterdam,…

features.name: Multatuli Museum

facts.text: Eduard Douwes Dekker, known as Multatuli, was born in this house before dying decades later in Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: Eduard Douwes Dekker was born in the Multatuli House and he died 67 years later in Ingelheim am Rhein, Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eduard Douwes Dekker was born in the Multatuli House and he died 67 years later in Ingelheim am Rhein, Germany.

facts.text: A separate, unaffiliated Multatuli Museum opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia, in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2018, another (unaffiliated) Multatuli Museum has also opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2018, another (unaffiliated) Multatuli Museum has also opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia.

facts.text: Multatuli died on a red couch that remains in the house today.
facts.sourceQuote: These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.

facts.text: Over five thousand of his manuscripts are preserved at the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Elsewhere, more than 5000 of Multatuli's manuscripts are preserved in the Special Collections at the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Elsewhere, more than 5000 of Multatuli's manuscripts are preserved in the Special Collections at the University of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The house displays Multatuli's personal globe, desk, and library as they were.
facts.sourceQuote: At the Multatuli House, one can see how Multatuli would have lived in the 19th century; his personal belongings still decorate the house. These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the Multatuli House, one can see how Multatuli would have lived in the 19th century; his personal belongings still decorate the house. These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.

features.opening: The Multatuli Museum (also Multatuli House/Huis) is a 17th-century museum in the Jordaan neighbourhood of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Ravensbrück memorial

facts.text: The monument honors Dutch women who died in the Nazi camp Ravensbrück.
facts.sourceQuote: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is een monument op het Museumplein in Amsterdam ter nagedachtenis van de Nederlandse slachtoffers van het voor vrouwen opgezette nazi-concentratiekamp Ravensbrück in Duitsland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on Museumplein in Amsterdam in memory of the Dutch victims of the Nazi concentration camp Ravensbrück set up for women in Germany.

facts.text: Ravensbrück was a concentration camp established specifically for women in Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is een monument op het Museumplein in Amsterdam ter nagedachtenis van de Nederlandse slachtoffers van het voor vrouwen opgezette nazi-concentratiekamp Ravensbrück in Duitsland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on Museumplein in Amsterdam in memory of the Dutch victims of the Nazi concentration camp Ravensbrück set up for women in Germany.

facts.text: The initiative for this war monument was taken in 1972 by the Vrouwen Committee of Ravenbrück.
facts.sourceQuote: Het initiatief voor dit oorlogsmonument werd genomen in 1972, toen het Comité Vrouwen van Ravenbrück een opdracht naar kunstenaars zond voor een ontwerp van een artistiek kunstwerk ter herinnering aan Nederlandse slachtoffers van concentratiekamp Ravensbrück.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The initiative for this war monument was taken in 1972, when the Vrouwen Committee of Ravenbrück sent an order to artists for a design of an artistic work in memory of Dutch victims of the Ravensbrück concentration camp.

facts.text: Joost van Santen, Frank Nix and Guido Eckhardt created the design turned into an image.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van Joost van Santen, Frank Nix en Guido Eckhardt werd in een beeld omgezet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design by Joost van Santen, Frank Nix and Guido Eckhardt was turned into an image.

features.opening: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on the Museumplein in Amsterdam commemorating the Dutch victims of Ravensbrück, the Nazi concentration camp for…

features.name: Spanjemonument

facts.text: The statue was originally rejected for the Buikslotermeerplein due to swampy soil and crowding before finding its home.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld zou oorspronkelijk in 1985 met een bijdrage van Provinciale Staten Noord-Holland geplaatst worden op het marktplein van het Buikslotermeerplein, maar dat werd te druk bevonden. Bovendien waren er problemen omtrent de fundering van het beeld in de aldaar drassige bodem. Roos en Van Weerden gingen er zelf op uit om een nieuwe plek te vinden die geschikter was en vonden die bij een naamloze parkeerplaats naast het IJtunnel-traject aan het Hagedoornplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue was originally to be placed in 1985 on the market square of the Buikslotermeerplein with a contribution from the Provincial States of North Holland, but it was found too crowded. In addition, there were problems regarding the foundation of the statue in the swampy soil there. Roos and Van Weerden set out on their own to find a new place that was more suitable and found it at an unnamed parking space next to the IJtunnel route on Hagedoornplein.

facts.text: Concentric ground circles in red, yellow, and purple honor the colors of the International Brigades flag.
facts.sourceQuote: De eeuwige beweging van het beeld vond haar weerspiegeling in de ondergrond met concentrische cirkels rondom het beeld, ontworpen door Harm van Weerden. Die cirkels waren origineel in de kleuren rood, geel en paars (de kleuren van de vlag van de Internationale Brigades).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The eternal movement of the image found its reflection in the ground with concentric circles around the image, designed by Harm van Weerden. Those circles were original in the colors red, yellow and purple (the colors of the flag of the International Brigades).

facts.text: Spanjemonument combines Dutch and Spanish text to honor those who fought fascism in Spain.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

facts.text: The monument commemorates the years 1936-1939 when Dutch volunteers joined the Spanish Civil War.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

facts.text: Three columns display the slogan No Pasaran alongside a bilingual dedication to Dutch fighters.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

features.opening: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

features.name: Meervaart Theater

facts.text: Meervaart Theater takes its name from the nearby Meer and Vaart street.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrum bestaat sinds 1977 en is vernoemd naar de straat Meer en Vaart, waaraan het is gelegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The center has existed since 1977 and is named after the Meer and Vaart street, to which it is located.

facts.text: The center first opened in 1977 after plans were made in 1966.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1966 werden al de eerste plannen gemaakt voor de bouw van een vrijetijdscentrum in de toen nog nieuwe tuinstad Osdorp. Het centrum bestaat sinds 1977 en is vernoemd naar de straat Meer en Vaart, waaraan het is gelegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1966, the first plans were already made for the construction of a leisure center in the then still new garden city of Osdorp. The center has existed since 1977 and is named after the Meer and Vaart street, to which it is located.

facts.text: The children's film festival Cinekid began at this venue in 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1986 begon hier het kinderfilmfestival Cinekid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1986, the children's film festival Cinekid began here.

facts.text: A 1999 renovation added a theater tower and two halls seating 800 and 250 people.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1999 werd de Meervaart grondig verbouwd, waarbij het oorspronkelijke gebouw tot op het skelet werd gestript. Er werden nieuwe zalen, vergaderruimten en een toneeltoren toegevoegd. Het complex heeft nu een grote zaal met 800 plaatsen (de rode zaal) en een kleinere zaal met 250 plaatsen (de blauwe zaal), die beide zowel voor voorstellingen als congressen kunnen worden gebruikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1999, the Meervaart was thoroughly renovated, stripping the original building down to the skeleton. New rooms, meeting rooms and a theater tower were added. The complex now has a large hall with 800 seats (the red hall) and a smaller hall with 250 seats (the blue hall), both of which can be used for both performances and congresses.

features.opening: Meervaart is a theater and a convention center in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

features.name: Portugese Synagoge

facts.text: Portuguese authorities blocked all ports to force Jewish residents into forced conversion by default.
facts.sourceQuote: While in theory, the Jews now in Portugal who chose not convert to Catholicism also had the option to be expelled (or executed) by 1497, the Portuguese king, in practice blocked Portugal's ports of exit, and subsequently reasoned that those who stayed behind agreed to become Christians by default. Thus the Jews in Portugal were forced to convert to Catholicism in 1496 after the decree and, all but a few who did manage to flee, became Portugal's Jewish-origin New Christians or conversos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: While in theory, the Jews now in Portugal who chose not convert to Catholicism also had the option to be expelled (or executed) by 1497, the Portuguese king, in practice blocked Portugal's ports of exit, and subsequently reasoned that those who stayed behind agreed to become Christians by default. Thus the Jews in Portugal were forced to convert to Catholicism in 1496 after the decree and, all but a few who did manage to flee, became Portugal's Jewish-origin New Christians or conversos.

facts.text: Volunteers convinced Nazis to spare the Portugese Synagoge from becoming a deportation center.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Nazi campaign to systematically murder Jews in the Holocaust, the facility was slated to become a deportation center for Jews, but Leo Palache and a team of volunteers managed to dissuade the Nazis from this plan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Nazi campaign to systematically murder Jews in the Holocaust, the facility was slated to become a deportation center for Jews, but Leo Palache and a team of volunteers managed to dissuade the Nazis from this plan.

facts.text: The Portugese Synagoge hid Jewish ritual items inside its sanctuary ceiling and attic floor.
facts.sourceQuote: Instead, the building concealed Jewish ritual items for deported Jews in the sanctuary ceiling and attic floor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instead, the building concealed Jewish ritual items for deported Jews in the sanctuary ceiling and attic floor.

facts.text: Executive director Salomon Coutinho documented the building's protective efforts in his wartime diary.
facts.sourceQuote: The World War II diary of executive director Salomon Coutinho was discovered in Amsterdam and details the synagogue's works and efforts to protect the building during the war.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The World War II diary of executive director Salomon Coutinho was discovered in Amsterdam and details the synagogue's works and efforts to protect the building during the war.

features.opening: The Portuguese Synagogue, also known as the Esnoga, or Snoge, is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at Mr. Visserplein 3 in Central…

features.name: National Holocaust Museum

facts.text: During Nazi occupation, 102,000 Dutch Jews were killed, the highest percentage in Western Europe.
facts.section: History of the Jews in Amsterdam
facts.sourceQuote: Three-quarters of the country's Jews, the highest percentage in Western Europe, in total 102,000 people, were killed during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands during 1940–1945.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three-quarters of the country's Jews, the highest percentage in Western Europe, in total 102,000 people, were killed during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands during 1940–1945.

facts.text: Scholars cite Dutch authorities and the Jewish Council in Amsterdam as factors in the high death toll.
facts.section: History of the Jews in Amsterdam
facts.sourceQuote: Scholars see the concentration of the Jewish population in one place, the single-mindedness of Nazi policies to separate Jews from the general Dutch population and then to eliminate them, the cooperation of Dutch authorities, as well as the Jewish Council in Amsterdam as factors resulting in the high percentage of Jewish deaths.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scholars see the concentration of the Jewish population in one place, the single-mindedness of Nazi policies to separate Jews from the general Dutch population and then to eliminate them, the cooperation of Dutch authorities, as well as the Jewish Council in Amsterdam as factors resulting in the high percentage of Jewish deaths.

facts.text: Jews in the Netherlands held equal citizenship rights since the eighteenth century before losing them.
facts.sourceQuote: There is a floor-to-ceiling display of all the laws limiting and obliterating the rights of Jews in the Netherlands, who since the eighteenth century had been Dutch citizens with equal rights.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a floor-to-ceiling display of all the laws limiting and obliterating the rights of Jews in the Netherlands, who since the eighteenth century had been Dutch citizens with equal rights.

facts.text: A former child care center near the museum helped rescue Jewish children during the war.
facts.sourceQuote: It is located in an historic building in the Jewish Cultural Quarter of Amsterdam, near a former child care center that played a role in rescuing Jewish children.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is located in an historic building in the Jewish Cultural Quarter of Amsterdam, near a former child care center that played a role in rescuing Jewish children.

facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling displays show every law that stripped Dutch Jews of their rights.
facts.sourceQuote: There is a floor-to-ceiling display of all the laws limiting and obliterating the rights of Jews in the Netherlands, who since the eighteenth century had been Dutch citizens with equal rights.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a floor-to-ceiling display of all the laws limiting and obliterating the rights of Jews in the Netherlands, who since the eighteenth century had been Dutch citizens with equal rights.

features.opening: The Dutch National Holocaust Museum (Dutch: Nationaal Holocaust museum) is the first official museum on the Holocaust in the Netherlands.

features.name: Amstel Academie

facts.text: Founded in 1961, it trained nurses for the VU Hospital with a nationally recognized diploma.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amstel Academie is in 1961 opgericht als zogenaamde verpleegstersschool, later ook wel de School voor Verpleegkundigen genoemd. Het doel bij de oprichting was destijds dat het toenmalig Ziekenhuis der Vrije Universiteit haar eigen verpleegkundigen zou opleiden, die een diploma zouden ontvangen met een landelijke erkenning en registratie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amstel Academie was founded in 1961 as a so-called nursing school, later also called the School for Nurses. The goal at the time of its establishment was that the then Ziekenhuis der Vrije Universiteit would train its own nurses, who would receive a diploma with national recognition and registration.

facts.text: The institute received its final name, Amstel Academie, in 2004 after previous titles.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 kreeg het instituut zijn uiteindelijke naam: Amstel Academie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, the institute received its final name: Amstel Academie.

facts.text: In 2005, the academy relocated from Uilenstede to the OZW building on De Boelelaan.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2005 verhuisde de Amstel Academie van Uilenstede naar het OZW-gebouw aan de De Boelelaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2005, the Amstel Academie moved from Uilenstede to the OZW building on De Boelelaan.

features.opening: The Amstel Academie is a Dutch academy that specializes in training in the medical sector.

features.name: Nationaal monument Slavernijverleden

facts.text: The sculpture itself is crafted from bronze while its base consists of concrete.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld is van brons en de sokkel is van beton.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image is made of bronze and the base is made of concrete.

features.opening: The Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden is a monument in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam to commemorate the abolition of slavery in the Dutch Kingdom.

features.name: waterdraagster

facts.text: The central figure stands 84 cm high while flanking fish reach only 34 cm in height.
facts.sourceQuote: Het grootste beeld (eigenlijk beeldje, 84 cm hoog)) bestaat uit een bronzen vrouw in lang gewaad die een waterkruik draagt. Zij wordt geflankeerd door twee visfiguren (34 cm hoog); vrouw en vissen zijn uitgevoerd met spuwers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The largest image (actually a small image, 84 cm high)) consists of a bronze woman in a long robe carrying a water jug. She is flanked by two fish figures (34 cm high); woman and fish are executed with spouts.

facts.text: The central image was stolen in 1977 before a new cast replaced it in 1981.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrale beeld werd in 1977 ontvreemd. Aan de hand van een gelijk beeld in Arnhem werd onder initiatief van medekunstenaar Harry Visser (Beroepsvereniging van Beeldende Kunstenaars) een nieuw afgietsel gemaakt en in 1981 geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The central image was stolen in 1977. Based on a similar image in Arnhem, a new cast was made and placed in 1981 at the initiative of fellow artist Harry Visser (Professional Association of Visual Artists).

features.opening: Sculpture in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Willem de Zwijgerkerk

facts.text: Stained glass windows by Kees Kuiler depict Christmas, Easter and Pentecost.
facts.sourceQuote: De glas-in-loodramen in de kerk, ontworpen door Kees Kuiler, verbeelden de kerkelijke feesten Kerstmis, Pasen en Pinksteren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stained glass windows in the church, designed by Kees Kuiler, depict the church festivals Christmas, Easter and Pentecost.

facts.text: Gerrit van Leeuwen built the organ which was restored in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is gebouwd door Gerrit van Leeuwen en in 2008 gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was built by Gerrit van Leeuwen and restored in 2008.

facts.text: A light artwork was installed during a renovation in 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de renovatie van 1995 is ook een licht-kunstwerk aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the renovation in 1995, a light artwork was also installed.

features.opening: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk is a Protestant church on Olympiaweg in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Van Gendt Hallen

facts.text: Halls four and five partially burned down in 1922 before being restored to their original design.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1922 brandden hal 4 en 5 gedeeltelijk af. Ze werden direct naar oorspronkelijk ontwerp hersteld, onder leiding van G.J.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1922, halls 4 and 5 partially burned down. They were restored directly to original design, under the leadership of G.J.

facts.text: Large light covers span the entire length of each hall to illuminate the interior spaces.
facts.sourceQuote: De hallen hebben grote lichtkappen over de gehele lengte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The halls have large light covers throughout the entire length.

features.opening: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam.

features.name: Tranen

facts.text: Resistance fighters robbed the detention center on May 1, 1944 to free captured members.
facts.sourceQuote: Een verzetsgroep onder leiding van Gerrit van der Veen pleegde op 1 mei 1944 een overval op het Huis van Bewaring in een poging gevangengenomen verzetsleden te bevrijden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A resistance group led by Gerrit van der Veen carried out a robbery of the Detention Center on May 1, 1944 in an attempt to free captured resistance members.

facts.text: A second robbery occurred at the site during the night of July 14-15, 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: Een tweede overval werd uitgevoerd door Johannes Post in de nacht van 14-15 juli 1944.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A second robbery was carried out by Johannes Post on the night of July 14-15, 1944.

facts.text: Mayor Ed van Thijn unveiled the work alongside widows of resistance leaders Dirk Walda and Gerrit van der Veen.
facts.sourceQuote: Tranen voor het verzet werd op 25 februari 1993 onthuld door burgemeester Ed van Thijn in aanwezigheid van de weduwen van Dirk Walda (lid van het comité Februaristaking bij de Ford-fabrieken) en Gerrit van der Veen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Tranen voor het verzet was unveiled on February 25, 1993 by Mayor Ed van Thijn in the presence of the widows of Dirk Walda (member of the February Strike Committee at the Ford factories) and Gerrit van der Veen.

facts.text: Tranen means tears, representing the suffering caused by World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Heesen gaf met de tranen het leed veroorzaakt door de Tweede Wereldoorlog weer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Heesen expressed the suffering caused by World War II with tears.

facts.text: The artwork features two glass tears resting on a blue plate.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk bestaat uit twee tranen van glas op een blauwe plaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork consists of two tears of glass on a blue plate.

features.opening: Tranen for the Resistance or Two Tears is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the center of Amsterdam.

features.name: Gerrit Rietveld Academie

facts.text: The school was renamed Gerrit Rietveld Academie in 1968 to honor the architect Gerrit Rietveld.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1968, following the completion of the Rietveld Building, the school was renamed to Gerrit Rietveld Academie, in honor of Gerrit Rietveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1968, following the completion of the Rietveld Building, the school was renamed to Gerrit Rietveld Academie, in honor of Gerrit Rietveld.

facts.text: From 1939 to 1960, education there reflected De Stijl and Bauhaus ideas under director Mart Stam.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1939 to 1960, the education provided was influenced by the functionalist and socially critical ideas of De Stijl and the Bauhaus, partly due to the role of the socialist architect Mart Stam as Director of Education.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1939 to 1960, the education provided was influenced by the functionalist and socially critical ideas of De Stijl and the Bauhaus, partly due to the role of the socialist architect Mart Stam as Director of Education.

facts.text: A new building by Benthem Crouwel Architects opened on campus in 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2003, the Benthem Crouwel Building, designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects, was completed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2003, the Benthem Crouwel Building, designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects, was completed.

facts.text: The Fedlev Building designed by Paulien Bremmer's collective was completed in 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2019, the Fedlev Building designed by Paulien Bremmer of the Fedlev collective and Hootsmans Architects was completed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2019, the Fedlev Building designed by Paulien Bremmer of the Fedlev collective and Hootsmans Architects was completed.

facts.text: The academy opened its doors in 1924 to offer fine arts and design programs.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded in 1924 and offers programs in fine arts and design.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded in 1924 and offers programs in fine arts and design.

facts.text: Gerrit Rietveld Academie is also known as the Rietveld School of Art & Design.
facts.sourceQuote: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.opening: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Micropia

facts.text: Micropia opened its doors on September 30, 2014 as a separate museum within Artis Zoo.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum opened on 30 September 2014 and is a separate museum which is part of Artis Zoo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum opened on 30 September 2014 and is a separate museum which is part of Artis Zoo.

features.opening: Micropia is a museum in Amsterdam based on the idea of distributing information about microbes, which are often associated with illness and disease despite…

features.name: Laurenskerk

facts.text: A carillon cast in 1671 by Amsterdam's famous bellfounder Pieter Hemony sits atop the Romanesque tower.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven in de romaanse toren, een restant van de eerdere kerk, bevindt zich een carillon, dat in 1671 werd gegoten door de beroemde klokkengieter Pieter Hemony uit Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top of the Romanesque tower, a remnant of the earlier church, there is a carillon, which was cast in 1671 by the famous bellfounder Pieter Hemony from Amsterdam.

facts.text: From 1489, a seven-season college with paid professional singers was attached to the church.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1489 was aan de kerk een zeven-getijdencollege verbonden met betaalde en professionele zangers. .
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1489, a seven-season college was attached to the church with paid and professional singers. .

features.opening: The Grote or Laurenskerk is a church building on Kerkstraat/Nieuwstraat in the center of the North Holland town of Weesp.

features.name: Mint Tower

facts.text: Cinema organists played weekly on the bells after a 1961 renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Just after the renovation around 1961, cinema organist played weekly on the Munt bells and even made a recording of the bells together with the City Theater orchestra directed by Lex van Weren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Just after the renovation around 1961, cinema organist played weekly on the Munt bells and even made a recording of the bells together with the City Theater orchestra directed by Lex van Weren.

facts.text: Scale models of this tower appear at Madurodam and Mini-Europe attractions.
facts.sourceQuote: Scale models of the tower are exhibited at Madurodam in The Hague and at Mini-Europe in Brussels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scale models of the tower are exhibited at Madurodam in The Hague and at Mini-Europe in Brussels.

facts.text: The Mint Tower name comes from its guard house being used to mint coins in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuote: The name of the tower refers to the fact that the guard house on the side of it was used to mint coins in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the tower refers to the fact that the guard house on the side of it was used to mint coins in the 17th century.

facts.text: During the 1672 disaster, silver and gold were temporarily minted here when transport routes were blocked.
facts.sourceQuote: In the Rampjaar ("year of disaster") of 1672, when both England and France declared war on the Dutch Republic and French troops occupied much of the country, silver and gold could no longer be safely transported to Dordrecht and Enkhuizen (where coins were normally minted), so the guard house of the Munttoren was temporarily used to mint coin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Rampjaar ("year of disaster") of 1672, when both England and France declared war on the Dutch Republic and French troops occupied much of the country, silver and gold could no longer be safely transported to Dordrecht and Enkhuizen (where coins were normally minted), so the guard house of the Munttoren was temporarily used to mint coin.

facts.text: Hendrick de Keyser designed an eight-sided top with an open spire, clockwork, and a carillon of bells.
facts.sourceQuote: The tower was then rebuilt in Amsterdam Renaissance style in 1620, with an eight-sided top half and elegant open spire designed by Hendrick de Keyser, featuring a clockwork with four clockfaces and a carillon of bells.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was then rebuilt in Amsterdam Renaissance style in 1620, with an eight-sided top half and elegant open spire designed by Hendrick de Keyser, featuring a clockwork with four clockfaces and a carillon of bells.

features.opening: The Munttoren (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʏnˌtoːrə(n)]; "Mint Tower") or Munt ([mʏnt]) is a tower in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten

facts.text: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten includes the Breitner Academy for arts education.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

facts.text: The institution houses a dedicated Netherlands Film Academy among its constituent schools.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

facts.text: Music studies are conducted at the Conservatorium van Amsterdam within this institute.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

facts.text: Museology studies are offered through the Reinwardt Academy as part of the university.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

features.opening: The Amsterdam University of the Arts (Dutch: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten) is a Dutch institute for higher professional education located in…

features.name: Equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina

facts.text: Queen Juliana helped select the specific clothing her mother Wilhelmina would wear in the bronze statue.
facts.sourceQuote: Wilhelmina's daughter Queen Juliana assisted Van der Pant, suggesting what clothes Wilhelmina should wear.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wilhelmina's daughter Queen Juliana assisted Van der Pant, suggesting what clothes Wilhelmina should wear.

facts.text: The statue was unveiled on Rokin street in 1972 after being deemed too large for its originally considered Damrak location.
facts.sourceQuote: At first Damrak street was considered as the location for the statue. Because the sculpture turned out larger than expected, and it was not intended as a place of remembrance and therefore could possibly clash with the National Monument on nearby Dam Square, it was unveiled on Rokin street in 1972.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At first Damrak street was considered as the location for the statue. Because the sculpture turned out larger than expected, and it was not intended as a place of remembrance and therefore could possibly clash with the National Monument on nearby Dam Square, it was unveiled on Rokin street in 1972.

features.opening: The equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina in Amsterdam is located on Rokin street, at the corner with Langebrugsteeg alley.

features.name: Pancratiuskerk

facts.text: Roman Catholics were forced to use farmer's barns as a refuge for several decades after expulsion.
facts.sourceQuote: De rooms-katholieken waren verdreven uit de kerk van Sloten en moesten enige decennia lang gebruikmaken van boerenschuren die als schuilkerk dienstdeden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Roman Catholics were expelled from the church of Sloten and had to use farmer's barns as a church of refuge for several decades.

facts.text: Subsidence from draining polders made the structure unsound, leading to demolition in 1901.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de vervening van de omliggende polders werd de kerk als gevolg van verzakking bouwvallig en moest in 1901 worden afgebroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the draining of the surrounding polders, the church became structurally unsound due to subsidence and had to be demolished in 1901.

facts.text: A local football club named Pancratius once played opposite the Slotense Pancratiuskerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is daardoor ook nog steeds een voetbalclub Pancratius, die vroeger op een veld speelde tegenover de Slotense Pancratiuskerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result, there is still a football club Pancratius, which used to play on a field opposite the Slotense Pancratiuskerk.

facts.text: The Pancratius football club relocated to Badhoevedorp when a community garden park was built.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen hier een volkstuinpark werd aangelegd, verhuisde de club naar Badhoevedorp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When a community garden park was built here, the club moved to Badhoevedorp.

facts.text: Catholics in Badhoevedorp established their own parish in 1937 with a church on Pa Verkuyllaan.
facts.sourceQuote: De katholieken in Badhoevedorp hebben sinds 1937 een eigen parochie (H.H. Engelbewaarderskerk) met een kerkgebouw aan de Pa Verkuyllaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Catholics in Badhoevedorp have had their own parish since 1937 (H.H. Angel Guardians Church) with a church building on the Pa Verkuyllaan.

features.opening: The Sint-Pancratiuskerk is a Roman Catholic church in the village of Sloten.

features.name: West India House

facts.text: The name West India House comes from the Dutch West India Company warehouse on the IJ waterfront that later adopted this title.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1647, the Dutch West India Company got into financial troubles and was forced to move to the West-Indisch Pakhuis, a Dutch West India Company warehouse on the IJ waterfront, which thereafter became known as the West-Indisch Huis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1647, the Dutch West India Company got into financial troubles and was forced to move to the West-Indisch Pakhuis, a Dutch West India Company warehouse on the IJ waterfront, which thereafter became known as the West-Indisch Huis.

facts.text: A bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, stands in the courtyard fountain.
facts.sourceQuote: In the courtyard, a fountain was placed with a bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, the Dutch colony on the east coast of what is now the United States.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the courtyard, a fountain was placed with a bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, the Dutch colony on the east coast of what is now the United States.

facts.text: The John Adams Institute hosts cultural exchange between the Netherlands and the U.S.
facts.sourceQuote: The John Adams Institute, which aims to further cultural exchange between The Netherlands and the U.S., is housed in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The John Adams Institute, which aims to further cultural exchange between The Netherlands and the U.S., is housed in the building.

features.opening: The West-Indisch Huis ("West India House") is the former headquarters of the Dutch West India Company in Amsterdam.

features.name: Banpaal

facts.text: Rembrandt sketched the pole but removed its head in his final etching of the landscape.
facts.sourceQuote: De paal was net geplaatst toen Rembrandt van Rijn op een van zijn tochten deze obeliskachtige staander vastlegde nabij een boerderij. Hij schetste de gehele paal, maar onthoofdde hem op de definitieve ets Landschap met een obelisk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pole had just been placed when Rembrandt van Rijn captured this obelisk-like stand near a farm on one of his trips. He sketched the entire pole, but beheaded it in the final etching Landscape with an obelisk.

features.opening: The Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk is a banpole from 1624, which has stood since then on the Spaarndammerdijk outside Amsterdam.

features.name: Rialto

facts.text: The biennial CinemAsia film festival takes place at this venue.
facts.sourceQuote: The biennial CinemAsia film festival is also held there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The biennial CinemAsia film festival is also held there.

facts.text: Architect Jan van Schaik designed the structure in 1920 for Anton Pieter du Mée.
facts.sourceQuote: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.

features.opening: Rialto is a cinema at Ceintuurbaan in the De Pijp neighborhood in Amsterdam.

features.name: Sint-Gertrudiskerk

facts.text: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk is dedicated to Holy Gertrude of Nijvel, depicted with a staff and mice.
facts.sourceQuote: Dessing en was gewijd aan de Heilige Gertrudis van Nijvel. In de kerk staat een beeld van Gertrudis met een staf met muizen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design and wash were dedicated to the Holy Gertrude of Nijvel. In the church there is a statue of Gertrudis with a staff with mice.

facts.text: Artists took possession of the church in July 1973 after the village was slated for demolition.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1973 is de kerk buiten gebruik gesteld, omdat het gehele dorp gesloopt zou worden. In juli 1973 gaf de laatste pastoor de sleutels van de pastorie aan Amsterdamse kunstenaars, die het kerkgebouw en de pastorie in gebruik namen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1973, the church was put out of use because the entire village would be demolished. In July 1973, the last pastor handed over the keys of the rectory to Amsterdam artists, who took possession of the church building and the rectory.

features.opening: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk is a former Roman Catholic church building in the village of Ruigoord in the municipality of Amsterdam in the Dutch province of North…

features.name: Royal Tropical Institute

facts.text: Architect Johannes van Nieukerken designed the complex, completed by his sons after his death.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect Johannes van Nieukerken heeft het gebouw ontworpen. Na zijn dood in 1913 werd het vervolgens voltooid door zijn zoons Johan en Marie Adrianus van Nieukerken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Johannes van Nieukerken designed the building. After his death in 1913, it was then completed by his sons Johan and Marie Adrianus van Nieukerken.

facts.text: Shell and the Overseas Gas and Electricity Company helped finance this colonial museum building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd gefinancierd door bijdragen van onder meer de Bataafse Petroleum Maatschappij (Shell), de Overzeese Gas- en Elektriciteitsmaatschappij N.V., de Handelsvereniging Amsterdam (HVA), en het departement van Koloniën.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was financed by contributions from among others the Bataafse Petroleum Maatschappij (Shell), the Overseas Gas and Electricity Company N.V., the Amsterdam Chamber of Commerce (HVA), and the Department of Colonies.

facts.text: All decorative images relate to Dutch colonial history and trade under a Symbolism Commission.
facts.sourceQuote: De beelden werden gecoördineerd door de Commissie voor de symboliek en hebben allen betrekking de Nederlandse koloniale geschiedenis en handel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The images were coordinated by the Commission for Symbolism and all relate to Dutch colonial history and trade.

facts.text: The entrance hall features rare marble and leads to auditoriums, course rooms, boardrooms, and a library.
facts.sourceQuote: Het instituutsgebouw heeft een grote entreehal van zeldzaam marmer vanwaar toegangen zijn naar een grote en een kleine aula en verschillende cursusruimten, bestuurskamers en bibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The institute building has a large entrance hall of rare marble from which access is provided to a large and a small auditorium and several course rooms, boardrooms and library.

facts.text: A quarter-circle structure physically connects the institute building to the museum building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het instituutsgebouw is verbonden aan het museumgebouw door een kwartrond gebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The institute building is connected to the museum building by a quarter-circle building.

features.opening: The KIT building is a complex of buildings in Amsterdam-Oost, built from 1915 to 1926 for the accommodation of the Colonial Institute and museum.

features.name: Hofkerk

facts.text: The massive red brick structure features a closed front with only a three-part entrance portico.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk, opgebouwd uit grote rode bakstenen (waalformaat) en afgedekt met rode pannendaken, is een massief ogend gebouw. De voorzijde is, op de drieledige ingangsportiek en de dubbele boog in de toren na, geheel gesloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church, built from large red bricks (walley size) and covered with red tiled roofs, is a massive looking building. The front is completely closed, except for the three-part entrance portico and the double arch in the tower.

facts.text: Architect Kropholler designed the church under strong influence from Berlage's architectural style.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat Kropholler sterk beïnvloed is door de architect Berlage komt ook sterk tot uiting in de kerk; er zijn duidelijke verwijzingen naar de Beurs van Berlage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fact that Kropholler has been strongly influenced by the architect Berlage is also strongly reflected in the church; there are clear references to the Berlage Building.

facts.text: Architect Alexander Kropholler designed the Linnaeushof complex that includes this church.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij maakt als "Hofkerk" deel uit van het door architect Alexander Kropholler ontworpen complex van de Linnaeushof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As "Hofkerk", it is part of the complex of the Linnaeushof designed by architect Alexander Kropholler.

features.opening: The Parish Church of the Holy Martyrs of Gorkum is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer.

features.name: Afrikahuis

facts.text: The new church replaced a demolished predecessor but held only 900 seats instead of the original 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk was bedoeld als vervanging voor Sint-Willibrorduskerk buiten de Veste die gesloopt werd. Omdat het aantal kerkgangers was afgenomen kwamen er in het nieuwe gebouw 900 in plaats van de eerdere 2000 zitplaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was intended as a replacement for the St. Willibrordus Church outside the Veste that was demolished. Because the number of churchgoers had decreased, 900 seats were installed in the new building instead of the previous 2000 seats.

facts.text: Five coupled octagons form a strongly geometric floor plan in this structuralist building.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de sterk geometrische plattegrond van vijf gekoppelde achthoeken is het gebouw te scharen onder de structuralistische bouwstijl.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the strongly geometric floor plan of five coupled octagons, the building can be classified under the structuralist architectural style.

facts.text: French limestone facades sit on a concrete base while a roof floats freely above to let light enter.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de betonnen plint die soms als 'tafel' is vormgegeven, staan gevels van Frans kalksteen. Het dak zweeft vrij boven de gevels, waardoor licht kan invallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the concrete base that is sometimes designed as a 'table', there are facades of French limestone. The roof floats freely above the facades, allowing light to enter.

facts.text: Detached entrances with steel frames and wire glass connect the eight-sided building volumes.
facts.sourceQuote: De achthoekige bouwvolumes worden geschakeld door vrijstaande entrees van stalen kozijnen met draadglas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The eight-sided building volumes are connected by detached entrances with steel frames and wire glass.

features.opening: The Afrikahuis is the former church of the Roman Catholic Sint Willibrordus parish in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam.

features.name: Huis Bartolotti

facts.text: The Hendrick de Keyser Monuments acquired the building in 1924 and later established headquarters there.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hendrick de Keyser Monumenten verwierf Herengracht 170 in 1924. Herengracht 172 werd in 1971 verworven onder het directoraat van Walther Raue en waarin de vereniging nadien haar zetel vestigde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hendrick de Keyser Monuments acquired Herengracht 170 in 1924. Herengracht 172 was acquired in 1971 under the direction of Walther Raue and in which the association later established its headquarters.

facts.text: A second restoration from 1995 to 1997 returned the interior to its original condition.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1995 tot 1997 heeft een tweede restauratie plaatsgevonden waarbij met name het interieur in de oorspronkelijke staat hersteld is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1995 to 1997, a second restoration took place, during which the interior was restored to its original condition, in particular.

facts.text: The owner adopted the name Bartolotti to inherit money from his childless uncle Giovanni Battista.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is circa 1617 gebouwd voor Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, een van de rijkste Amsterdammers in die tijd, die veel geld had geërfd van een kinderloze aangetrouwde oom, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, koopman uit Bologna. In het testament van deze oom stond als voorwaarde vermeld dat hij zich "Bartolotti" moest noemen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdamers of that time, who had inherited a lot of money from a childless brother-in-law, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, a merchant from Bologna. In the will of this uncle, it was stated as a condition that he must be called "Bartolotti".

facts.text: Willem van den Heuvel built this house around 1617 after receiving a large inheritance.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is circa 1617 gebouwd voor Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, een van de rijkste Amsterdammers in die tijd, die veel geld had geërfd van een kinderloze aangetrouwde oom, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, koopman uit Bologna.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdamers of that time, who had inherited a lot of money from a childless brother-in-law, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, a merchant from Bologna.

facts.text: Jacoba Victoria was born in the house in 1639 as the daughter of Guillelmo.
