facts.text: The chapel served the hospital complex from 1895 until 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: Van deze kerk zijn twee versies: Van 1895 tot 1986 maakte ze deel uit van het gebouwencomplex Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis waarvan de laatste gebouwen (Annapaviljoen en Mariapaviljoen) rond 2001 gesloopt werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are two versions of this church: From 1895 to 1986 it was part of the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Hospital complex, whose last buildings (Annapaviljoen and Mariapaviljoen) were demolished around 2001.

facts.text: The chapel was leveled in June 1987 after a final celebration in November 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een laatste eucharistieviering op 17 november 1986 viel het doek voor de kapel; in juni 1987 was het grootste deel van kerk en kapel met de grond gelijk gemaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a final Eucharistic celebration on November 17, 1986, the curtain fell on the chapel; in June 1987, most of the church and chapel were leveled.

facts.text: Adrianus Bleijs created the total design for the site bordering Oosterpark.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van kapel, kerk en ziekenhuis kwam van de hand van Adrianus Bleijs, die een totaalontwerp maakte voor het terrein dat grensde aan het Oosterpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design of the chapel, church and hospital was by Adrianus Bleijs, who made a total design for the site bordering the Oosterpark.

facts.text: Covered corridors allowed caregivers to reach the chapel without going outside.
facts.sourceQuote: Nieuw aan de opstelling van de kerk/kapel was, dat zij door overdekte gangen vanuit de paviljoens en het zusterhuis bereikbaar waren, zodat verpleegden en verplegers niet door de buitenlucht hoefden als zij dat niet wilden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: New to the arrangement of the church/chapel was that they could be accessed through covered corridors from the pavilions and the sister house, so that nurses and caregivers did not have to go outside if they did not want to.

features.opening: The Onze Lieve Vrouwe Kapel is a chapel in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: De Ateliers

facts.text: Founders included Ger Lataster, Mari Andriessen, Nic Jonk, Theo Mulder and Wessel Couzijn.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded in Haarlem in 1963, among others by Ger Lataster, Mari Andriessen, Nic Jonk, Theo Mulder and Wessel Couzijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded in Haarlem in 1963, among others by Ger Lataster, Mari Andriessen, Nic Jonk, Theo Mulder and Wessel Couzijn.

facts.text: Students are called participants rather than students or pupils.
facts.sourceQuote: Students are called 'participants'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students are called 'participants'.

facts.text: The institute moved from Haarlem to Amsterdam's former Rijksakademie building on Stadhouderskade.
facts.sourceQuote: After many years located in Haarlem, the institute moved to Amsterdam to the former building of the Rijksakademie at the Stadhouderskade in the Amsterdam city center.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After many years located in Haarlem, the institute moved to Amsterdam to the former building of the Rijksakademie at the Stadhouderskade in the Amsterdam city center.

features.opening: De Ateliers (formerly Ateliers '63) is an independent art school in located in Amsterdam.

features.name: Pathé Tuschinski Cinema

facts.text: Abraham Icek Tuschinski founded the venue with his brothers-in-law Hermann Gerschtanowitz and Hermann Ehrlich.
facts.sourceQuote: The theatre was founded by Abraham Icek Tuschinski, together with his brothers-in-law Hermann Gerschtanowitz and Hermann Ehrlich.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theatre was founded by Abraham Icek Tuschinski, together with his brothers-in-law Hermann Gerschtanowitz and Hermann Ehrlich.

facts.text: A unique heating system maintained an even temperature throughout the entire building during its operation.
facts.sourceQuote: Its unique heating and ventilation system kept the temperature even throughout the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its unique heating and ventilation system kept the temperature even throughout the building.

facts.text: The lobby was designed to make theatergoers feel they are stepping into an illusion.
facts.sourceQuote: The building contains Asian influences while the lobby was designed in a way to offer theatergoers the feeling that they are stepping into an illusion.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building contains Asian influences while the lobby was designed in a way to offer theatergoers the feeling that they are stepping into an illusion.

facts.text: The main auditorium features a stage and organ for both films and live performances.
facts.sourceQuote: The Tuschinski's main auditorium has served as both a movie theater and a live performance space since its opening. In addition to a film screen, it also contains a stage and an organ.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Tuschinski's main auditorium has served as both a movie theater and a live performance space since its opening. In addition to a film screen, it also contains a stage and an organ.

features.opening: The Koninklijk Theater Tuschinski (English: Royal Theatre Tuschinski) also called Pathé Tuchinski, is a movie theatre in Amsterdam, Netherlands, near…

features.name: Het Veem Theater

facts.text: An open day for workspace seekers was held on November 7, 1981.
facts.sourceQuote: Met hun kraakactie en de oprichting van de stichting (later vereniging) Werkgebouw Het Veem werd op 7 november 1981 een open dag gehouden voor alle geïnteresseerden die werkruimte zochten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With their eviction campaign and the establishment of the foundation (later association) Werkgebouw Het Veem, an open day was held on November 7, 1981 for all interested parties looking for workspace.

facts.text: Sjoerd Schwibettus and Gail Dockery served as founders and artistic leaders.
facts.sourceQuote: Oprichters en artistieke leiding waren Sjoerd Schwibettus en Gail Dockery.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founders and artistic leadership were Sjoerd Schwibettus and Gail Dockery.

facts.text: Kors van Bennekom photographed the studio theater while it was still under construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Kors van Bennekom was de fotograaf van de foto's van het studio-theater in aanbouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Kors van Bennekom was the photographer of the photos of the under construction studio theater.

facts.text: The venue was known as Het Veem Theater until 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Veem House for Performance (tot 2014: Het Veem Theater) is een productiehuis, werkplaats, podium, laboratorium en expertisecentrum van eigentijds mimetheater, gevestigd in Werkgebouw "Het Veem" in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Veem House for Performance (until 2014: Het Veem Theater) is a production house, workshop, stage, laboratory and expertise center of contemporary mime theater, located in Works Building "Het Veem" in Amsterdam.

features.opening: Veem House for Performance, called Het Veem Theater until 2014, is a production house, workshop, stage, laboratory and centre of expertise for contemporary…

features.name: Plein Theater

facts.text: The venue began in 1982 as a neighborhood theater inside an empty brewery canteen.
facts.sourceQuote: Een groep Amsterdammers startte in 1982 een buurttheater op met een eetcafé, dit in een leegstaande bedrijfskantine van de voormalige Amstelbrouwerij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A group of Amsterdamers started a neighborhood theater in 1982 with a restaurant, this in an empty company canteen of the former Amstel brewery.

facts.text: Plein Theater was briefly renamed East Bloc from 2015 until regaining its original name in March 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2015 werd Pleintheater omgedoopt tot Oostblok, maar kreeg in maart 2019 weer de originele naam terug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2015 Pleintheater was renamed East Bloc, but regained its original name in March 2019.

facts.text: The archive of Theatre Embassy is physically housed inside the Plein Theater building.
facts.sourceQuote: In het Pleintheater staat het archief van Theatre Embassy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The archive of Theatre Embassy is located in the Pleintheater.

facts.text: The Nieuwe Noten Amsterdam concert series has been based at Plein Theater since June 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: De concertreeks Nieuwe Noten Amsterdam startte in 2016 en kreeg vanaf juni 2019 als vaste standplaats het Plein Theater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Nieuwe Noten Amsterdam concert series started in 2016 and has been based at the Plein Theater since June 2019.

facts.text: Monthly contemporary chamber music is presented by curators Fie Schouten and Aspasia Nasopoulou.
facts.sourceQuote: In de reeks wordt maandelijks hedendaags gecomponeerde kamermuziek gepresenteerd. Curatoren zijn basklarinettist Fie Schouten en componist Aspasia Nasopoulou.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The series presents contemporary chamber music composed monthly. Curators are bass clarinetist Fie Schouten and composer Aspasia Nasopoulou.

features.opening: The PleinTheater in Amsterdam-Oost is a stage for small-scale theatre, dance, contemporary classical music, youth theatre and neighbourhood activities.

features.name: Zuiderkerk Tower

facts.text: The Zuiderkerk Tower rises 68 meters high in a Renaissance style designed by Hendrick Cornelisz de Keyser.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp in renaissancestijl is van de Amsterdamse architect Hendrick Cornelisz de Keyser zoon van een meubelmaker uit Utrecht die rond 1591 samen met de stadsingenieur Cornelis Bloemaert naar Amsterdam was gekomen. De Zuidertoren kwam pas in 1614 gereed en is 68 meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design in Renaissance style was by the Amsterdam architect Hendrick Cornelisz de Keyser, son of a furniture maker from Utrecht who had come to Amsterdam around 1591 together with the city engineer Cornelis Bloemaert. The Zuidertoren was not ready until 1614 and is 68 meters high.

facts.text: The summit offers a view of the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter and Nieuwmarkt Quarter.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de toren is er een fraai uitzicht over de voormalige Amsterdamse Jodenbuurt en Nieuwmarktbuurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the tower there is a beautiful view over the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter and Nieuwmarkt Quarter.

features.opening: The Zuidertoren is the tower of the Zuiderkerk in Amsterdam.

features.name: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam

facts.text: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam translates to Municipal Museum Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈsteːdələk myˈzeːjʏm ˌɑmstərˈdɑm]; Municipal Museum Amsterdam), colloquially known as the Stedelijk, is a museum for modern art, contemporary art, and design located in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈsteːdələk myˈzeːjʏm ˌɑmstərˈdɑm]; Municipal Museum Amsterdam), colloquially known as the Stedelijk, is a museum for modern art, contemporary art, and design located in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Adriaan Willem Weissman designed the original nineteenth-century building.
facts.sourceQuote: The 19th-century building was designed by Adriaan Willem Weissman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 19th-century building was designed by Adriaan Willem Weissman.

facts.text: Benthem Crouwel Architects created the modern wing housing the current entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: The connecting 21st-century wing, which houses the current entrance, was designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The connecting 21st-century wing, which houses the current entrance, was designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects.

features.opening: The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈsteːdələk myˈzeːjʏm ˌɑmstərˈdɑm]; Municipal Museum Amsterdam), colloquially known as the Stedelijk, is a…

features.name: Van Eesteren Museum

facts.text: The Van Eesteren Museum honors Cornelis van Eesteren, architect of the 1934 Amsterdam General Expansion Plan.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Van Eesteren Museum moest een eerbetoon worden aan Cornelis van Eesteren die als architect en stedenbouwkundige aan de wieg stond van het Algemeen Uitbreidingsplan (AUP) van Amsterdam uit 1934.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Van Eesteren Museum was to become a tribute to Cornelis van Eesteren, who as an architect and urban planner was at the forefront of the 1934 Amsterdam General Expansion Plan (AUP).

facts.text: A half-square-kilometer area was designated a protected urban landscape in 2007 as the 'Van Eesteren Outdoor Museum'.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 bestempelde het bestuur van Geuzenveld-Slotermeer daar een gebied van ongeveer een halve vierkante kilometer als een belangrijk cultuurhistorisch erfgoed tot beschermd stadsgezicht vanwege de architectuur en vooral de stedenbouwkundige opzet: het 'Van Eesteren Buitenmuseum'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, the board of directors of Geuzenveld-Slotermeer designated an area of about half a square kilometer as an important cultural historical heritage as a protected urban landscape due to the architecture and especially the urban planning layout: the 'Van Eesteren Outdoor Museum'.

facts.text: Representatives of heritage associations and residents founded the museum on May 1, 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum werd opgericht op 1 mei 2010 door vertegenwoordigers van erfgoedverenigingen en bewoners in het toenmalige Amsterdamse stadsdeel Geuzenveld-Slotermeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded on May 1, 2010 by representatives of heritage associations and residents in the then-current Amsterdam district of Geuzenveld-Slotermeer.

facts.text: Aldermen Gehrels and Bos officially opened the museum on October 15, 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 15 oktober 2010 werd het museum geopend door de wethouders Gehrels van de gemeente Amsterdam en Bos van het stadsdeel Nieuw-West.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 15, 2010, the museum was opened by the aldermen Gehrels of the municipality of Amsterdam and Bos of the Nieuw-West district.

features.opening: The Van Eesteren Museum is a museum in Amsterdam Nieuw-West devoted entirely to the architect and town planner Cornelis van Eesteren.

features.name: NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust, and Genocide Studies

facts.text: The institute merged the Netherlands Institute for War Documentation with the Center for Holocaust and Genocide Studies.
facts.sourceQuote: The institute was founded as a merger of the Netherlands Institute for War Documentation (Dutch: Nederlands instituut voor oorlogsdocumentatie, NIOD, formerly National Institute for War Documentation, Dutch: Rijksinstituut voor oorlogsdocumentatie, RIOD) and the Center for Holocaust and Genocide Studies (CHGS).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The institute was founded as a merger of the Netherlands Institute for War Documentation (Dutch: Nederlands instituut voor oorlogsdocumentatie, NIOD, formerly National Institute for War Documentation, Dutch: Rijksinstituut voor oorlogsdocumentatie, RIOD) and the Center for Holocaust and Genocide Studies (CHGS).

facts.text: Since January 1, 1999, it has belonged to the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been part of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences since 1 January 1999.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been part of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences since 1 January 1999.

facts.text: The institute administers archives of the Japanese occupation of the Dutch East Indies.
facts.sourceQuote: It administers the archives of the German occupation of the Netherlands and the Japanese occupation of the Dutch East Indies, as well as large collections of clandestine newspapers and pamphlets, photographs, books and articles.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It administers the archives of the German occupation of the Netherlands and the Japanese occupation of the Dutch East Indies, as well as large collections of clandestine newspapers and pamphlets, photographs, books and articles.

features.opening: The NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust and Genocide Studies (Dutch: NIOD Instituut voor Oorlogs-, Holocaust- en Genocidestudies) is an organisation in the…

features.name: Sarphatimonument

facts.text: Jacobus Roeland de Kruijff designed this 12-meter stone temple surrounded by a 16-meter water basin with fountains.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een rond stenen tempelachtig bouwwerk, van 12 meter hoog, ontworpen door Jacobus Roeland de Kruijff, dat omringd wordt door water. De waterbak bevat fonteinen en heeft een diameter van 16 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a round stone temple-like structure, 12 meters high, designed by Jacobus Roeland de Kruijff, surrounded by water. The water basin contains fountains and has a diameter of 16 meters.

facts.text: During WWII occupation, the bust was removed and the park renamed Bollandpark before restoration in 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Duitse bezetting van Nederland in de Tweede Wereldoorlog kregen alle straten en dergelijke die vernoemd waren naar Joden een andere naam en zo werd het Sarphatipark omgedoopt tot Bollandpark. Uit het monument werd het borstbeeld van Sarphati verwijderd. Dit werd op 18 mei 1945 teruggedraaid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German occupation of the Netherlands during World War II, all streets and such that were named after Jews were given a different name and thus Sarphatipark was renamed Bollandpark. The bust of Sarphati was removed from the monument. This was reversed on May 18, 1945.

features.opening: The Sarphatimonument is a monument in honor of the 19th-century Jewish Amsterdam physician and benefactor Samuel Sarphati, in Sarphatipark in the Amsterdam…

features.name: Sexmuseum

facts.text: Sexmuseum holds the title of the world's first and oldest dedicated sex museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is the world's first and oldest museum of sex, however since, a number of other sex museum's have opened, such as those in Berlin (Beate Uhse Erotic Museum), Paris (Museum of Eroticism), and Copenhagen (Museum Erotica).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is the world's first and oldest museum of sex, however since, a number of other sex museum's have opened, such as those in Berlin (Beate Uhse Erotic Museum), Paris (Museum of Eroticism), and Copenhagen (Museum Erotica).

facts.text: Exhibits trace sexual history from Cleopatra's male regiment through Roman appetites to medieval repression.
facts.sourceQuote: From Cleopatra's regiment of men, to the Romans’ insatiable appetite for sex, to the repressive Middle Ages, visitors are presented with how sex was viewed throughout historical civilizations.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From Cleopatra's regiment of men, to the Romans’ insatiable appetite for sex, to the repressive Middle Ages, visitors are presented with how sex was viewed throughout historical civilizations.

facts.text: In 2015 alone, the museum welcomed 675,000 visitors.
facts.sourceQuote: It had 675,000 visitors in 2015, making it one of the most visited museums in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It had 675,000 visitors in 2015, making it one of the most visited museums in the Netherlands.

features.opening: The Sexmuseum or the Temple of Venus (Dutch: Venustempel) is a sex museum located in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Faralda NDSM Crane Hotel Amsterdam

facts.text: Crane 13 was restored in Franeker after being transported on a pontoon in July 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: De kraan werd op 26 juli 2013 op een 100 meter lang ponton vervoerd naar Franeker om te worden gerestaureerd. Op 22 oktober 2013 keerde de kraan gerestaureerd terug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The crane was transported on July 26, 2013 on a 100-meter-long pontoon to Franeker to be restored. On October 22, 2013, the crane returned restored.

facts.text: The crane tower rotates around a bellows while pipes and fire safety devices run through its tiny shaft.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren van de kraan met daarin de drie suites, blijft draaien om een taatslager. In deze zeer kleine draaiende as van enkele centimeters doorsnee lopen alle leidingen, sleepkoppelingen en brandveiligheidsvoorzieningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower of the crane with the three suites inside, continues to rotate around a bellows. All pipes, drag couplings and fire safety devices run through this very small rotating shaft with a diameter of a few centimeters.

facts.text: Three luxury suites and a jacuzzi are located at the very top of this steel colossus.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven in de kraan bevinden zich drie luxe hotelsuites. In de top van de kraan bevindt zich een jacuzzi.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three luxury hotel suites are located at the top of the crane. At the top of the crane is a jacuzzi.

features.opening: The Crane Hotel Faralda (Kraanhotel Faralda) is a hotel located on top of a Rijksmonumentale crane on the NDSM site, a former shipyard on the banks of the IJ…

features.name: NACO-house

facts.text: The NACO-house earned its nickname from the Nederlandsche Auto Car Onderneming office that occupied it from the mid-1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf midden jaren zestig was het gebouw in gebruik als kantoor van de scheepvaartafdeling van de Nederlandsche Auto Car Onderneming (NACO), vandaar de officieuze naam NACO-huisje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the mid-1960s, the building was used as an office for the shipping department of the Nederlandsche Auto Car Onderneming (NACO), hence the unofficial name NACO cottage.

facts.text: Koppe's shipping company vanished as an independent entity after becoming a Dutch Railways subsidiary in 1972.
facts.sourceQuote: Reederij Koppe werd een dochteronderneming van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen en verdween in 1972 als bedrijf.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Shipping company Koppe became a subsidiary of the Dutch Railways and disappeared as a company in 1972.

features.opening: The Office of Koppe's Shipping Agency, also known as the NACO cottage, is a former shipping office on the De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Amsterdam Memorial to the Canadian Liberators

facts.text: Thousands of Canadian troops entered Amsterdam in 1945 via the Berlage Bridge and Apollolaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Via de Berlagebrug, de Apollolaan, de Van Baerlestraat, het Leidseplein en het Singel trokken in 1945 duizend Canadezen Amsterdam binnen en gingen naar de Dam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1945, thousands of Canadezen Amsterdam entered via the Berlage Bridge, the Apollolaan, the Van Baerlestraat, the Leidseplein and the Singel and went to the Dam.

facts.text: About half a million locals cheered the Canadian liberators as they marched through the city.
facts.sourceQuote: Ongeveer een half miljoen Amsterdammers juichten hen toe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: About half a million Amsterdamers cheered them on.

facts.text: The Canadian forces marched past Leidseplein and the Singel before reaching Dam square.
facts.sourceQuote: Via de Berlagebrug, de Apollolaan, de Van Baerlestraat, het Leidseplein en het Singel trokken in 1945 duizend Canadezen Amsterdam binnen en gingen naar de Dam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1945, thousands of Canadezen Amsterdam entered via the Berlage Bridge, the Apollolaan, the Van Baerlestraat, the Leidseplein and the Singel and went to the Dam.

facts.text: On May 5, 1980, Canadians marched the same route through Amsterdam as they did in 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 5 mei 1980 trokken Canadezen over dezelfde route als in 1945 opnieuw Amsterdam binnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 5, 1980, Canadezen again entered Amsterdam along the same route as in 1945.

facts.text: The monument was created by sculptor Jan de Baat, who lived from 1921 to 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is gemaakt door Jan de Baat (1921-2010) en omvat een stalen wimpel die uit de grond rijst in een grasveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was made by Jan de Baat (1921-2010) and includes a steel flag that rises from the ground in a grassy field.

facts.text: A steel flag rises from a grassy field to symbolize restored freedom of movement.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is gemaakt door Jan de Baat (1921-2010) en omvat een stalen wimpel die uit de grond rijst in een grasveld. Het uitwaaieren van de wimpel is een verwijzing naar de toekomst en de in 1945 herstelde bewegingsvrijheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was made by Jan de Baat (1921-2010) and includes a steel flag that rises from the ground in a grassy field. The waving of the flag is a reference to the future and the restored freedom of movement in 1945.

features.opening: Amsterdam dankt zijn Canadezen is a monument in the Canadezenplantsoen, called the Apollolaan before 2020, in Amsterdam, opposite the Apollohal between the…

features.name: Red Light District

facts.text: The walled canals gave the area its name De Wallen and Walletjes, meaning little walls.
facts.sourceQuote: The walled canals led to the names De Wallen and Walletjes (little walls).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The walled canals led to the names De Wallen and Walletjes (little walls).

facts.text: French Imperial Naval Corps soldiers became the primary clients during the Napoleonic era.
facts.sourceQuote: In this Napoleonic era, men from the French Imperial Naval Corps were the main clients for prostitutes in De Wallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In this Napoleonic era, men from the French Imperial Naval Corps were the main clients for prostitutes in De Wallen.

features.opening: De Wallen (Dutch pronunciation: [də ˈʋɑlə(n)]) is the largest and best known red-light district in Amsterdam.

features.name: Our Lord in the Attic

facts.text: Catholics built a hidden church on the top three floors during the 1660s to worship in secret.
facts.sourceQuote: The Catholic church was built on the top three floors of the canal house during the 1660s. It is an important example of a "schuilkerk", or "clandestine church" in which Catholics and other religious dissenters from the seventeenth-century Dutch Reformed Church, unable to worship in public, held services.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Catholic church was built on the top three floors of the canal house during the 1660s. It is an important example of a "schuilkerk", or "clandestine church" in which Catholics and other religious dissenters from the seventeenth-century Dutch Reformed Church, unable to worship in public, held services.

facts.text: Dissenters used this space as a clandestine church because public worship was forbidden then.
facts.sourceQuote: It is an important example of a "schuilkerk", or "clandestine church" in which Catholics and other religious dissenters from the seventeenth-century Dutch Reformed Church, unable to worship in public, held services.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is an important example of a "schuilkerk", or "clandestine church" in which Catholics and other religious dissenters from the seventeenth-century Dutch Reformed Church, unable to worship in public, held services.

facts.text: Renovations to the property occurred during both the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was renovated in the 18th and 19th centuries.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was renovated in the 18th and 19th centuries.

features.opening: Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder (OLHOS; English: Our Lord in the Attic) is a 17th-century canal house, house church, and museum in the city center of Amsterdam, The…

features.name: Dutch East Indian Company

facts.text: Hendrick de Keyser likely designed the Amsterdam Renaissance style facades of the Oost-Indisch Huis.
facts.sourceQuote: A gate with Tuscan-style pilasters and a small tunnel lead to an inner courtyard with elegant facades in Amsterdam Renaissance style, a style closely identified with the architect Hendrick de Keyser, who was most likely responsible for designing the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A gate with Tuscan-style pilasters and a small tunnel lead to an inner courtyard with elegant facades in Amsterdam Renaissance style, a style closely identified with the architect Hendrick de Keyser, who was most likely responsible for designing the building.

facts.text: After dissolution, the building served as the colonial government seat until 1808.
facts.sourceQuote: After the East India Company was dissolved in 1798, the building served until 1808 as the seat of the colonial government of the Batavian Republic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the East India Company was dissolved in 1798, the building served until 1808 as the seat of the colonial government of the Batavian Republic.

facts.text: The Dutch East Indian Company (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie) operated from the Amsterdam chamber.
facts.sourceQuote: It was the headquarters of the Amsterdam chamber of the Dutch East India Company (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie or VOC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the headquarters of the Amsterdam chamber of the Dutch East India Company (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie or VOC).

facts.text: The Oost-Indisch Huis served as headquarters for the Dutch East Indian Company in the early 17th century.
facts.sourceQuote: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam. It was the headquarters of the Amsterdam chamber of the Dutch East India Company (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie or VOC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam. It was the headquarters of the Amsterdam chamber of the Dutch East India Company (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie or VOC).

features.opening: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam.

features.name: Theo Thijssen Museum

facts.text: A foundation founded in 1987 placed a memorial stone at the site to keep his memory alive.
facts.sourceQuote: Enkele liefhebbers van Thijssen richtten in 1987 een stichting op om de herinnering aan hem levend te houden. Het eerste wat zij deden is een gedenksteen aanbrengen in het geboortehuis van Thijssen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some Thijssen enthusiasts founded a foundation in 1987 to keep his memory alive. The first thing they did was place a memorial stone in Thijssen's birthplace.

facts.text: Visual artist Hans Bayens offered the memorial stone and created the statue on Lindengracht.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze steen was aangeboden door beeldend kunstenaar Hans Bayens, die ook het standbeeld van Thijssen maakte dat op de Lindengracht staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This stone was offered by visual artist Hans Bayens, who also made the statue of Thijssen that stands on the Lindengracht.

facts.text: Public uproar stopped a demolition plan, leading to the building's reconstruction between 1991 and 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeenteraad had echter al besloten het pand te slopen om plaats te maken voor een nieuwbouwproject. Na enige ophef kwam dat project er toch niet. In plaats daarvan werd tussen 1991 en 1995 het pand in oorspronkelijke vorm herbouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the municipal council had already decided to demolish the building to make way for a new construction project. After some uproar, that project still did not come to fruition. Instead, between 1991 and 1995 the building was rebuilt in its original form.

facts.text: The municipal council approved a 1990 plan that included space for the proposed museum.
facts.sourceQuote: In hetzelfde plan, waar de gemeenteraad in 1990 mee instemde, kreeg ook het voorgestelde museum een plek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the same plan, which the municipal council agreed to in 1990, the proposed museum also received a place.

facts.text: Theo Thijssen was a writer, teacher, and politician honored by this site.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Theo Thijssen Museum is een museum in Amsterdam, gewijd aan schrijver, onderwijzer en politicus Theo Thijssen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Theo Thijssen Museum is a museum in Amsterdam, dedicated to writer, teacher and politician Theo Thijssen.

features.opening: The Theo Thijssen Museum is a museum in Amsterdam devoted to the writer, teacher and politician Theo Thijssen.

features.name: Blauwe Moskee

facts.text: The two-storey structure covers 790 square metres with a mix of traditional and modern styles.
facts.sourceQuote: The Blue Mosque mixes traditional and modern architecture and is two storeys in height. The mosque cover 790 square metres (8,500 sq ft) and is built of blue bricks.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Blue Mosque mixes traditional and modern architecture and is two storeys in height. The mosque cover 790 square metres (8,500 sq ft) and is built of blue bricks.

facts.text: Unlike many mosques, this building lacks loudspeakers to broadcast the call to prayer.
facts.sourceQuote: Unlike many traditional mosques, the Blue Mosque lacks a loudspeaker used to broadcast the call to prayer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike many traditional mosques, the Blue Mosque lacks a loudspeaker used to broadcast the call to prayer.

facts.text: Inside are five Islamic education classrooms alongside spaces for lectures and meetings.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque consists of a room for prayer, five Islamic education class rooms, a room for lectures, and two meeting rooms.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque consists of a room for prayer, five Islamic education class rooms, a room for lectures, and two meeting rooms.

facts.text: The Blauwe Moskee takes its name from the distinctive blue color of its exterior.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque is architecturally significant for both its blue color and the fact that the structure lacks traditional minarets and other symbols associated with Muslim places of worship.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque is architecturally significant for both its blue color and the fact that the structure lacks traditional minarets and other symbols associated with Muslim places of worship.

facts.text: Construction began in 2008 using funds provided by the Kuwaiti government.
facts.sourceQuote: Construction of the mosque was financed by the government of Kuwait through the offices of Europe Trust Netherlands and began in 2008.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the mosque was financed by the government of Kuwait through the offices of Europe Trust Netherlands and began in 2008.

facts.text: Unlike many mosques, this structure lacks traditional minarets and other typical symbols.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque is architecturally significant for both its blue color and the fact that the structure lacks traditional minarets and other symbols associated with Muslim places of worship.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque is architecturally significant for both its blue color and the fact that the structure lacks traditional minarets and other symbols associated with Muslim places of worship.

features.opening: The Blue Mosque (Dutch: Blauwe Moskee) is a mosque and cultural center in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, the Netherlands.

features.name: De Ark

facts.text: Four chapters from Noah's story appear on the bronze doors, including the construction of the ark and the sacrifice.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn vier hoofdstukken uit het verhaal van Noach afgebeeld. Te zien zijn de bouw van de ark, de intocht in de ark, de duif met een takje en het dankoffer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Four chapters from the story of Noah are depicted. The construction of the ark, the entry into the ark, the dove with a twig and the sacrifice are visible.

features.opening: De Ark is a church building in the Slotervaart district in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

features.name: This is Holland

facts.text: The original film used a 6k camera with a fisheye lens requiring extremely low flight waivers.
facts.sourceQuote: De beelden zijn opgenomen met een 6k-camera met fisheye-objectief. Vanwege deze camera was het noodzakelijk zeer laag te vliegen, waarvoor een ontheffing nodig was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The images were recorded with a 6k camera with a fisheye lens. Due to this camera, it was necessary to fly very low, for which a waiver was required.

facts.text: Vekoma and Brogent Technologies constructed the simulator for this Dutch attraction.
facts.sourceQuote: De simulator is gebouwd door de pretparkattractiebouwer Vekoma en Brogent Technologies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The simulator was built by the amusement park attraction builder Vekoma and Brogent Technologies.

features.opening: THIS IS HOLLAND is a tourist attraction with a panoramic flight simulator in Amsterdam.

features.name: Orgelpark

facts.text: Pastor Johannes Geelkerken sparked controversy in 1923 by calling the Genesis snake a metaphor.
facts.sourceQuote: De Parkkerk werd gebouwd in 1918 als Gereformeerde Kerk, waarin predikant Johannes Geelkerken in 1923 ophef veroorzaakte door te preken, dat de sprekende slang in Genesis 3 moest worden opgevat als een metafoor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Park Church was built in 1918 as a Reformed Church, in which pastor Johannes Geelkerken caused a stir in 1923 by preaching that the talking snake in Genesis 3 should be understood as a metaphor.

facts.text: The venue officially opened its doors on January 20, 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is op 20 januari 2007 geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was opened on January 20, 2007.

facts.text: Performances here blend organ music with dance, ballet, and theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Orgelpark geeft de mogelijkheid om orgelmuziek met andere kunstvormen te combineren, zoals dans, ballet en theater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Orgelpark gives the opportunity to combine organ music with other forms of art, such as dance, ballet and theater.

facts.text: Businessman Loek Dijkman's Utopa Foundation provides the financial resources.
facts.sourceQuote: Financiële middelen voor het Orgelpark worden door de Stichting Utopa van de zakenman Loek Dijkman beschikbaar gesteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Financial resources for Orgelpark are made available by the Utopa Foundation of businessman Loek Dijkman.

facts.text: Several organs coexist alongside other keyboard instruments within the space.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn meerdere orgels, maar ook andere toetsinstrumenten aanwezig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are several organs, but also other keyboard instruments present.

features.opening: The Orgelpark is an art center in Amsterdam where the organ is central.

features.name: El Tawheed

facts.text: The mosque offers Arabic language lessons and operates a bookstore alongside its religious services.
facts.sourceQuote: Aside from its normal function, the mosque is used for social work, and for lessons in the Arabic language. It also houses a book store and a publisher of religious videos and DVDs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Aside from its normal function, the mosque is used for social work, and for lessons in the Arabic language. It also houses a book store and a publisher of religious videos and DVDs.

facts.text: Construction funding came in part from the Saudi non-governmental organization al-Haramain Foundation.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque was in-part funded by the Saudi non-governmental organization al-Haramain Foundation.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque was in-part funded by the Saudi non-governmental organization al-Haramain Foundation.

features.opening: The El Tawheed Mosque is a Sunni mosque in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Kunstenaarsverzet

facts.text: The statue arrived tilted at five point six meters wide and only one point eight meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld was toen al gekanteld: 5,6 meter breed en slechts 1,8 meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image was already tilted at that time: 5.6 meters wide and only 1.8 meters high.

features.opening: Monument and work of art in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: ACTA

facts.text: ACTA was founded in 1985 due to an oversupply of dentists preventing two separate faculties.
facts.sourceQuote: ACTA is in 1985 opgericht. Destijds had Nederland een overschot aan tandartsen, zodat er voor twee afzonderlijke faculteiten geen plaats meer was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: ACTA was founded in 1985. At that time, the Netherlands had an oversupply of dentists, so there was no room left for two separate faculties.

facts.text: Dentists specializing here can focus on fields like oral kinesiology or pediatric dentistry.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast kunnen tandartsen zich specialiseren en differentiëren in de onderscheiden disciplines van de tandheelkunde: orale kinesiologie, parodontologie, endodontologie, orale implantologie, orthodontie, kindertandheelkunde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, dentists can specialize and differentiate in the different disciplines of dentistry: oral kinesiology, periodontology, endodontology, oral implantology, orthodontics, pediatric dentistry.

facts.text: The Louwesweg 1 site housed roughly 27,000 patients alongside nine hundred students in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 bediende dit gebouw circa negenhonderd studenten en 27 000 patiënten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, this building served approximately nine hundred students and 27,000 patients.

facts.text: After ACTA departed in 2010, the former headquarters building was converted for student housing.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadat ACTA er in 2010 vertrok, werd dit pand heringericht voor studentenhuisvesting.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After ACTA left in 2010, this building was redesigned for student accommodation.

facts.text: The facility served approximately 27,000 patients while simultaneously accommodating nine hundred students.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 bediende dit gebouw circa negenhonderd studenten en 27 000 patiënten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, this building served approximately nine hundred students and 27,000 patients.

features.opening: The Academic Center for Dentistry Amsterdam (ACTA) is the joint Faculty of Dentistry of the University of Amsterdam and the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.

features.name: foam

facts.text: Architects BenthemCrouwel converted three Keizersgracht buildings into a modern museum space.
facts.sourceQuote: Architects BenthemCrouwel turned three buildings at the Keizersgracht into a modern museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architects BenthemCrouwel turned three buildings at the Keizersgracht into a modern museum.

facts.text: Foam publishes a quarterly international photography magazine called Foam Magazine.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum also publishes a quarterly international photography magazine called Foam Magazine.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum also publishes a quarterly international photography magazine called Foam Magazine.

facts.text: The venue includes a commercial gallery named Foam Editions alongside its exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum contains a café, a library, a bookshop, and a commercial gallery called Foam Editions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum contains a café, a library, a bookshop, and a commercial gallery called Foam Editions.

features.opening: Foam or Fotografiemuseum Amsterdam is a photography museum located on Keizersgracht in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Nemo

facts.text: In 2016, the institution officially changed its title to NEMO Science Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016, the name was changed to NEMO Science Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016, the name was changed to NEMO Science Museum.

facts.text: The name Nemo comes from Latin, meaning Nobody.
facts.sourceQuote: NEMO Science Museum (from Latin: Nemo, lit. 'Nobody') is a science centre in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: NEMO Science Museum (from Latin: Nemo, lit. 'Nobody') is a science centre in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.opening: NEMO Science Museum (from Latin: Nemo, lit.

features.name: W139

facts.text: Five artists squatted a former theatre there in October 1979 to oppose commercial art.
facts.sourceQuote: The former theatre was squatted in October 1979 by five young artists as "a movement against the closed world of commercial art and museums".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former theatre was squatted in October 1979 by five young artists as "a movement against the closed world of commercial art and museums".

facts.text: In 2016, the space hosted exhibitions titled Gym of Absolute Technology and Shifting Spaces.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the expositions 'Gym of Absolute Technology', 'Shifting Spaces' and 'UU&ME' were held.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the expositions 'Gym of Absolute Technology', 'Shifting Spaces' and 'UU&ME' were held.

features.opening: W139 is an artist-run space established in 1979 on the Warmoesstraat, Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Waag

facts.text: Surgeons commissioned Rembrandt's famous painting for the guildhall located inside this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: The Waag is depicted in Rembrandt's 1632 painting The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp. The surgeons' guild commissioned this painting for their guildhall in the Waag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Waag is depicted in Rembrandt's 1632 painting The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp. The surgeons' guild commissioned this painting for their guildhall in the Waag.

features.opening: The Waag ("weigh house") is a 15th-century building on Nieuwmarkt square in Amsterdam.

features.name: Badhuistheater

facts.text: In 1913, it became the first free-standing communal bathhouse built for that specific purpose.
facts.sourceQuote: It was the first free standing communal bath house, built in 1913 for this purpose.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the first free standing communal bath house, built in 1913 for this purpose.

facts.text: Badhuistheater means "Bath house theatre" in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: The Badhuistheater (Dutch: Bath house theatre) is a theater venue located in a former bath house on the east-side of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Badhuistheater (Dutch: Bath house theatre) is a theater venue located in a former bath house on the east-side of Amsterdam.

facts.text: British writer Michael Manicardi transformed the neglected bath house into a theater around 1985.
facts.sourceQuote: The theater is run by British actor and writer Michael Manicardi who acquired the neglected bath house around 1985 and transformed it into a theater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater is run by British actor and writer Michael Manicardi who acquired the neglected bath house around 1985 and transformed it into a theater.

facts.text: The venue seats between 50 and 120 people depending on the chosen configuration.
facts.sourceQuote: As a theater it seats between 50 and 120 people, depending on the chosen configuration.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a theater it seats between 50 and 120 people, depending on the chosen configuration.

features.opening: The Badhuistheater (Dutch: Bath house theatre) is a theater venue located in a former bath house on the east-side of Amsterdam.

features.name: Buchenwald Memorial

facts.text: Herman Schutte, a Camp Vught survivor and Zeelandish artist, designed the sculpture.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zeeuwse kunstenaar Herman Schutte (1908-1964 en overlever van Kamp Vught) ontwierp een beeld bestaande uit twee handen die uit het graf omhoogsteken en een stenen urn vasthouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zeelandish artist Herman Schutte (1908-1964 and survivor of Camp Vught) designed a sculpture consisting of two hands rising from the grave and holding a stone urn.

facts.text: Annual commemorative services were held on April 11 until the last one in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Fuçik) Jaarlijks werden er op 11 april herdenkingsdiensten gehouden; de laatste vond plaats in 2018.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Fuçik) Commemorative services were held annually on April 11; the last took place in 2018.

facts.text: The monument features two hands rising from the grave holding a stone urn.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zeeuwse kunstenaar Herman Schutte (1908-1964 en overlever van Kamp Vught) ontwierp een beeld bestaande uit twee handen die uit het graf omhoogsteken en een stenen urn vasthouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zeelandish artist Herman Schutte (1908-1964 and survivor of Camp Vught) designed a sculpture consisting of two hands rising from the grave and holding a stone urn.

features.opening: The Buchenwald monument is a monument placed on De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery.

features.name: Anthony Winkler Prins

facts.text: Young people originally used the structure as a climbing frame before gaps were sealed.
facts.sourceQuote: Voltens kunstwerken worden ook wel door jeugd gebruikt als klimrek, reden waarom in overleg met de kunstenaar de ruimten tussen aantal schijven is gedicht zodat beklimmen niet meer mogelijk is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Voltens' works of art are also used by young people as a climbing frame, which is why, in consultation with the artist, the spaces between the number of discs have been closed so that climbing is no longer possible.

facts.text: Artist André Volten refused to name the piece, calling it simply 'the thing'.
facts.sourceQuote: Volten noemde het zelf "het ding" (een ding tussen andere dingen op het plein), hij vond een titel met monument daarin te zwaar klinken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Volten himself called it "the thing" (a thing among other things on the square), he found a title with a monument in it too heavy sounding.

features.opening: A work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum is a reminder of Anthony Winkler Prins.

features.name: Bevrijdingslinde

facts.text: Bevrijdingslinde means 'Liberation Linden' and honors children from the Jordaan who died during WWII.
facts.sourceQuote: De bevrijdingslinde werd geplant ter nagedachtenis van kinderen in de Jordaan (de wijk ligt aan de andere kant van de Lijnbaansgracht), die de Tweede Wereldoorlog niet overleefd hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The liberation tree was planted in memory of children in the Jordaan (the district is on the other side of the Lijnbaansgracht), who had not survived World War II.

facts.text: In 1984, the tree nearly vanished when the Municipal Energy Company planned to build an electricity shed there.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1984 gingen boom en gedenksteen bijna verloren toen het Gemeentelijk Energie Bedrijf hier een elektriciteitshuisje wilde bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1984, the tree and monument almost disappeared when the Municipal Energy Company wanted to build an electricity shed here.

facts.text: An urn under the stone holds the names of the children who contributed to this memorial.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder de gedenksteen bevindt zich een urn met daarin de namen van de kinderen die meebetaalden aan de gedenksteen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the memorial stone is an urn containing the names of the children who contributed to the memorial stone.

features.opening: Bevrijdingslinde van de Jordaankinderen is a war monument in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Museum Vrolik

facts.text: Gerardus and Willem Vrolik, father and son anatomy professors, assembled the museum's original collection.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum's history begins around 1800 when Gerardus Vrolik (1775–1859) and his son Willem Vrolik (1801–1863) began assembling a collection of anatomical and medical specimens. Both were professors of anatomy at the Athenaeum Illustre, the predecessor of the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum's history begins around 1800 when Gerardus Vrolik (1775–1859) and his son Willem Vrolik (1801–1863) began assembling a collection of anatomical and medical specimens. Both were professors of anatomy at the Athenaeum Illustre, the predecessor of the University of Amsterdam.

features.opening: Museum Vrolik is an anatomical museum renowned for its collection of medical heritage.

features.name: Albert

facts.text: Albert suffocated at home using a handkerchief from his boss after his caregiver was hospitalized.
facts.sourceQuote: Zijn begeleider moest opgenomen worden in het Burgerziekenhuis, de hond stikte thuis in een zakdoek van zijn baas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His caregiver had to be admitted to the Civic Hospital, the dog suffocated at home in a handkerchief from his boss.

features.opening: Police dog Albert is a 1924 statue placed in Oosterpark in Amsterdam.

features.name: Muziekgebouw

facts.text: The venue replaced the former Muziekcentrum de IJsbreker located at Weesperzijde.
facts.sourceQuote: Before the Muziekgebouw there was Muziekcentrum de IJsbreker located at the Weesperzijde that got shut down and replaced by the Muziekgebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the Muziekgebouw there was Muziekcentrum de IJsbreker located at the Weesperzijde that got shut down and replaced by the Muziekgebouw.

facts.text: Jan Wolff served as the first artistic director from 2005 to 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: The first main and artistic director was Jan Wolff (2005–2008); Tino Haenen has been artistic director since June 2008.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first main and artistic director was Jan Wolff (2005–2008); Tino Haenen has been artistic director since June 2008.

facts.text: Concerts are held on three large balconies above the restaurant.
facts.sourceQuote: Also concerts take place at various other locations in the building such as the atrium and on the three large balconies above the restaurant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Also concerts take place at various other locations in the building such as the atrium and on the three large balconies above the restaurant.

facts.text: The Bimhuis venue is integrated into the Muziekgebouw.
facts.sourceQuote: The Bimhuis is part of and partly integrated in the Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bimhuis is part of and partly integrated in the Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ.

features.opening: Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ (English: "Music Building on the IJ") is the main concert hall for contemporary classical music on the IJ in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Grenspaal

facts.text: 1970s neighborhood resistance and police clashes halted the planned highway construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Buurtbewoners van de Nieuwmarktbuurt verzetten zich daar in de jaren zeventig hevig tegen. Onder meer schermutselingen met politie en Mobiele Eenheid leidden er toe dat de aanleg werd gestaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Neighbors of the Nieuwmarkt neighborhood strongly resisted this in the 1970s. Among other things, clashes with the police and Mobile Unit led to the suspension of construction.

features.opening: Grenspaal, also known as the Column-bearing Turtle or Monument of Jacob Israël de Haan is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Obrechtkerk

facts.text: Bishop Augustinus Callier consecrated the building in 1911.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was consecrated in 1911 by Mgr. A.J. Callier (Augustinus Callier), the bishop of Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was consecrated in 1911 by Mgr. A.J. Callier (Augustinus Callier), the bishop of Haarlem.

facts.text: Artists including Otto van Rees and Mari Andriessen contributed to its decoration.
facts.sourceQuote: Many artists contributed to the decoration of the church, including Jan Eloy Brom, Joep Nicolas, Otto van Rees, John Rädecker, Matthieu Wiegman, Kees Dunselman, Nico Witteman and Mari Andriessen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many artists contributed to the decoration of the church, including Jan Eloy Brom, Joep Nicolas, Otto van Rees, John Rädecker, Matthieu Wiegman, Kees Dunselman, Nico Witteman and Mari Andriessen.

features.name: Dutch National Opera & Ballet

facts.text: The complex earned the nickname Stopera, a blend of its functions as town hall and opera house.
facts.sourceQuote: Het complex kreeg al snel de bijnaam Stopera (stadhuis + opera).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex soon earned the nickname Stopera (town hall + opera house).

facts.text: Residents staged loud demonstrations at the opening due to years of noise pollution from construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook bij de opening werd luidruchtig gedemonstreerd door omwonenden die jarenlang geluidsoverlast hadden ondervonden van de bouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the opening, there was also a loud demonstration by residents who had suffered from noise pollution from the construction for years.

facts.text: The organization includes both De Nationale Opera and Het Nationale Ballet alongside the theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is tevens de naam van de organisatie die naast het theater ook de gezelschappen De Nationale Opera en Het Nationale Ballet omvat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is also the name of the organization that, in addition to the theater, also includes the companies De Nationale Opera and Het Nationale Ballet.

features.opening: National Opera & Ballet (formerly Het Muziektheater Amsterdam) is a theater in Amsterdam that was specially built for the performance of operas, ballets and…

features.name: Oosterkerk

facts.text: Architect Daniël Stalpaert began construction while bell caster Pieter Hemony forged the bells.
facts.sourceQuote: The Oosterkerk was built in the period 1669-1671 by architect Daniël Stalpaert and completed by Adriaan Dortsman. The church bells were cast by Pieter Hemony.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oosterkerk was built in the period 1669-1671 by architect Daniël Stalpaert and completed by Adriaan Dortsman. The church bells were cast by Pieter Hemony.

facts.text: About 500 people were buried inside, including architect Adriaan Dortsman.
facts.sourceQuote: Some 500 people were buried in the church, including Adriaan Dortsman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some 500 people were buried in the church, including Adriaan Dortsman.

features.opening: The Oosterkerk ("eastern church") is a 17th-Century Dutch Reformed church in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Internationaal Theater Amsterdam

facts.text: Amsterdam lacked permanent theater buildings while early troupes used temporary stages.
facts.sourceQuote: At that time, there were no permanent theater buildings in Amsterdam, and the shipping company cherries performed on temporary stages, from carts (during processions) or in public spaces.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At that time, there were no permanent theater buildings in Amsterdam, and the shipping company cherries performed on temporary stages, from carts (during processions) or in public spaces.
