features.name: Muurschildering Johan Cruijff

facts.text: Brazilian artist Paulo Consentino painted this portrait with help from local youth over eleven days.
facts.sourceQuote: De Braziliaanse straat-kunstenaar Paulo Consentino, die ook elders in de wereld muurschilderingen gerelateerd aan de voetbalsport aanbracht, zag een wens in vervulling gaan om Johan Cruijff vast te leggen. De schildering die de kunstenaar met behulp van jongeren uit de buurt in elf dagen maakte werd gesponsord door Legacy of John Cruyff, Johan Cruyff Foundation en Akzo Nobel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Brazilian street artist Paulo Consentino, who also painted murals related to the sport of football elsewhere in the world, saw a wish come true to capture Johan Cruijff. The painting that the artist made in eleven days with the help of young people from the neighborhood was sponsored by Legacy of John Cruyff, Johan Cruyff Foundation and Akzo Nobel.

facts.text: Danny Cruijff and Amsterdam mayor Eberhard van der Laan unveiled the work on May 9, 2017 at 2:14 p.m.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 9 mei 2017, 14 over zes, werd de schildering onthuld door Danny Cruijff, de weduwe van Johan Cruijff, en toenmalig burgemeester van Amsterdam Eberhard van der Laan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 9, 2017, at 2:14 p.m., the painting was unveiled by Danny Cruijff, the widow of Johan Cruijff, and then-mayor of Amsterdam Eberhard van der Laan.

facts.text: The mural faces Betondorp, the actual birthplace of Johan Cruyff himself.
facts.sourceQuote: De desbetreffende flat kijkt westwaarts uit over Betondorp, geboortegrond van de voetballer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The relevant flat overlooks Betondorp to the west, the birthplace of the footballer.

features.opening: The Muurschildering Johan Cruijff is a mural in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer.

features.name: Wine buyers' guildhall

facts.text: Amsterdam master mason Pieter de Keyser radically altered the structure after the guild purchased it in 1630.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was purchased in 1630 by the guild of wine buyers, who had it radically altered by the Amsterdam master mason Pieter de Keyser.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was purchased in 1630 by the guild of wine buyers, who had it radically altered by the Amsterdam master mason Pieter de Keyser.

facts.text: An entrance gate designed by Pieter de Keyser originally depicted Bacchus astride a wine barrel.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1633 the right wing of the building (Koestraat number 10) began to be used as guildhall, with a meeting room for the guild directors at the front, a new back wing with a communal guild room (gildezaal), large cellars for storage, and an entrance gate designed by Pieter de Keyser. This gate originally depicted Bacchus astride a barrel of wine, but this was later replaced with an image of the saint Urban.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1633 the right wing of the building (Koestraat number 10) began to be used as guildhall, with a meeting room for the guild directors at the front, a new back wing with a communal guild room (gildezaal), large cellars for storage, and an entrance gate designed by Pieter de Keyser. This gate originally depicted Bacchus astride a barrel of wine, but this was later replaced with an image of the saint Urban.

features.opening: The Wijnkopersgildehuis ("Wine buyers' guildhall") is a former guildhall in Amsterdam.

features.name: Nationaal Holocaust Namenmonument

facts.text: 102,000 red bricks bear the name, birth date, and age at death of each victim.
facts.sourceQuote: Inscribed on each of these 102,000 alphabetically ordered bricks is a name, date of birth and age at death of a victim.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Inscribed on each of these 102,000 alphabetically ordered bricks is a name, date of birth and age at death of a victim.

facts.text: A separate wall of 1,000 bricks remains blank to add names discovered later.
facts.sourceQuote: A separate wall called 1000 Names Wall of 1,000 bricks at the southern entrance was left blank to accommodate additional names of victims found later.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A separate wall called 1000 Names Wall of 1,000 bricks at the southern entrance was left blank to accommodate additional names of victims found later.

facts.text: Four stainless steel profiles shaped like Hebrew letters sit atop the brick walls.
facts.sourceQuote: On top of the brick walls four huge horizontal stainless steel profiles are mounted in the shape of the four Hebrew characters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On top of the brick walls four huge horizontal stainless steel profiles are mounted in the shape of the four Hebrew characters.

facts.text: The Nationaal Holocaust Namenmonument honors the names of approximately 102,000 Jewish victims and 220 Roma and Sinti victims.
facts.sourceQuote: It commemorates the approximately 102,000 Jewish victims from the Netherlands who were arrested by the Nazi regime during the German occupation of the country (1940-1945), deported and mostly murdered in the Auschwitz and Sobibor death camps, as well as 220 Roma and Sinti victims.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It commemorates the approximately 102,000 Jewish victims from the Netherlands who were arrested by the Nazi regime during the German occupation of the country (1940-1945), deported and mostly murdered in the Auschwitz and Sobibor death camps, as well as 220 Roma and Sinti victims.

facts.text: Nazi forces arrested Dutch Jews between 1940 and 1945 before deporting them to death camps like Auschwitz and Sobibor.
facts.sourceQuote: It commemorates the approximately 102,000 Jewish victims from the Netherlands who were arrested by the Nazi regime during the German occupation of the country (1940-1945), deported and mostly murdered in the Auschwitz and Sobibor death camps, as well as 220 Roma and Sinti victims.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It commemorates the approximately 102,000 Jewish victims from the Netherlands who were arrested by the Nazi regime during the German occupation of the country (1940-1945), deported and mostly murdered in the Auschwitz and Sobibor death camps, as well as 220 Roma and Sinti victims.

facts.text: The Nederlands Auschwitz Comité founded this memorial dedicated to those murdered during the German occupation.
facts.sourceQuote: The monument founded by the Nederlands Auschwitz Comité (Dutch Auschwitz Committee) is located in the former Jewish quarter (Dutch: Jodenbuurt) on a roughly north–south strip along the west side of the Weesperstraat, clockwise from the north between Nieuwe Herengracht, Weesperstraat, Nieuwe Keizersgracht, and Amstel river, east of the H'ART Museum Museum and the Hoftuin garden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument founded by the Nederlands Auschwitz Comité (Dutch Auschwitz Committee) is located in the former Jewish quarter (Dutch: Jodenbuurt) on a roughly north–south strip along the west side of the Weesperstraat, clockwise from the north between Nieuwe Herengracht, Weesperstraat, Nieuwe Keizersgracht, and Amstel river, east of the H'ART Museum Museum and the Hoftuin garden.

features.opening: The National Holocaust Names Memorial (Amsterdam) (Dutch: Holocaust Namenmonument) is since 2021 the Dutch national memorial for the Holocaust and the Porajmos…

features.name: Decembermoorden

facts.text: Two victims, Rambocus and Sheombar, were already imprisoned for a failed countercoup attempt.
facts.sourceQuote: The other two were Surendre Rambocus and Jiwansingh Sheombar who were already imprisoned for attempting a countercoup in March 1982.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The other two were Surendre Rambocus and Jiwansingh Sheombar who were already imprisoned for attempting a countercoup in March 1982.

facts.text: Victims included lawyers, journalists, businessmen, soldiers, teachers and a union leader.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the victims were lawyers, journalists, businessmen, soldiers, university teachers and a union leader.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the victims were lawyers, journalists, businessmen, soldiers, university teachers and a union leader.

features.opening: The December murders (Dutch: Decembermoorden) were the murders on 7, 8, and 9 December 1982, of fifteen prominent young Surinamese men who had criticized the…

features.name: OT301

facts.text: Artists squatted the former Dutch film academy in 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1999, a group of artists squatted the former Dutch film academy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1999, a group of artists squatted the former Dutch film academy.

facts.text: The user association Eerste Hulp Bij Kunst bought the building in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: After serving as a breeding ground for several years, the building was bought by the user association Eerste Hulp Bij Kunst (EHBK) from the council in 2006.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After serving as a breeding ground for several years, the building was bought by the user association Eerste Hulp Bij Kunst (EHBK) from the council in 2006.

facts.text: OT301 serves as a multi-media alternative cultural centre.
facts.sourceQuote: It is used as a multi-media alternative cultural centre, comparable to projects in other Dutch cities, such as Extrapool in Nijmegen and WORM in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is used as a multi-media alternative cultural centre, comparable to projects in other Dutch cities, such as Extrapool in Nijmegen and WORM in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A vegan restaurant named De Peper operated here until closing in 2023 to become Café Gilde.
facts.sourceQuote: OT301 is a venue for music and films, a non-profit print shop, artists' workspace and originally an 'organic cultural kitchen' (a vegan restaurant) called De Peper, which was closed in 2023 and has become a lunch café called Café Gilde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: OT301 is a venue for music and films, a non-profit print shop, artists' workspace and originally an 'organic cultural kitchen' (a vegan restaurant) called De Peper, which was closed in 2023 and has become a lunch café called Café Gilde.

facts.text: Mayor Job Cohen awarded OT301 the Amsterdam Prize for the Arts on August 23, 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: Amsterdam Mayor Job Cohen presented OT301 with the Amsterdamprijs voor de Kunsten (Amsterdam Prize for the Arts) from the Amsterdam Fonds voor de Kunst on 23 August 2007.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Amsterdam Mayor Job Cohen presented OT301 with the Amsterdamprijs voor de Kunsten (Amsterdam Prize for the Arts) from the Amsterdam Fonds voor de Kunst on 23 August 2007.

facts.text: Former tenants included the offices of European Youth For Action and Green Pepper magazine.
facts.sourceQuote: Formerly, it housed the offices of European Youth For Action and Green Pepper magazine.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Formerly, it housed the offices of European Youth For Action and Green Pepper magazine.

features.opening: OT301 is a self-managed social centre in a legalized squat in the Dutch city of Amsterdam, located on Overtoom 301.

features.name: OCCII

facts.text: The original building was squatted in 1984 before being legalized in 1989.
facts.sourceQuote: The original building was squatted in 1984 and "legalized" in 1989.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original building was squatted in 1984 and "legalized" in 1989.

facts.text: Architect Abraham Salm designed the structure originally as a horse tram garage.
facts.sourceQuote: The building the OCCII resides in was built as a horse tram garage with stables in 1883-84 by architect Abraham Salm (1857–1915), who also designed (together with his father G. B. Salm) the buildings where popular commercial venues Melkweg and Paradiso now operate.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building the OCCII resides in was built as a horse tram garage with stables in 1883-84 by architect Abraham Salm (1857–1915), who also designed (together with his father G. B. Salm) the buildings where popular commercial venues Melkweg and Paradiso now operate.

facts.text: Several independent groups set the agenda instead of a central programming committee.
facts.sourceQuote: The OCCII has no central programming, instead there are several programming groups that set the agenda.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The OCCII has no central programming, instead there are several programming groups that set the agenda.

features.opening: The OCCII (Onafhankelijk Cultureel Centrum In It) is a venue for alternative and independent music at Amstelveenseweg 134, in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Mama Baranka (Moeder Rots)

facts.text: Mama Baranka (Moeder Rots) translates to Mother Rock or Mother Earth.
facts.sourceQuote: In plaats van een buste of standbeeld van Duinmeijer te maken kwam hij met zijn impressie van Mama Baranka (M'ma Aïsa, Moeder Rots, Moeder Aarde).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instead of making a bust or statue of Duinmeijer, he came up with his impression of Mama Baranka (M'ma Aïsa, Mother Rock, Mother Earth).

features.opening: Mama Baranka is an artistic work of art in Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid, in memory of the death of Kerwin Duinmeijer.

features.name: Haarlemmermeerstation

facts.text: Passenger service ended in 1950, but coal transport continued until 1972.
facts.sourceQuote: Passenger traffic was discontinued in 1950, after which the traffic of goods (mainly coal transport) remained until 1972.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Passenger traffic was discontinued in 1950, after which the traffic of goods (mainly coal transport) remained until 1972.

facts.text: The station and line served the Electrische Museumtramlijn Amsterdam starting in 1975.
facts.sourceQuote: After the closure, the Haarlemmermeer station and the line to Amstelveen – Bovenkerk came to use from 1975 at the Electrische Museumtramlijn Amsterdam (EMA).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the closure, the Haarlemmermeer station and the line to Amstelveen – Bovenkerk came to use from 1975 at the Electrische Museumtramlijn Amsterdam (EMA).

features.opening: The Haarlemmermeer station, called Willemspark Station, was built in 1915 by architect H. van Emmerik, but originally designed by Karel de Bazel.

features.name: Fatih

facts.text: The former church featured a double tower front reaching forty meters in height.
facts.sourceQuote: Valk, bood plaats aan 600 gelovigen en had een dubbeltorenfront van 40 meter hoogte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Valk, accommodated 600 believers and had a double tower front of 40 meters in height.

facts.text: Prayer direction faces the original main entrance where a mihrab now stands.
facts.sourceQuote: De gebedsrichting is tegenovergesteld aan de oorspronkelijke bouw. Tijdens het gebed richten de aanwezigen zich tot de voormalige hoofdingang, waar een mihrab is aangebracht met daarboven een kalligrafie van 'Gods naam'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The direction of prayer is opposite to the original construction. During prayer, the attendees turn to the former main entrance, where a mihrab has been installed with calligraphy of 'God's name' above it.

features.opening: The Fatih mosque is a mosque on the Rozengracht in the Jordaan, Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Artis

facts.text: Visitors saw only the middle gate with 'Artis' above it, so few knew the full name Natura Artis Magistra.
facts.sourceQuote: The zoo is commonly referred to as Artis, because the zoo has three gates with the words 'Natura', 'Artis', and 'Magistra' written above each of them, respectively, which combined formed its actual name. More often than not, only the middle gate was open, so that people who walked through it, seeing that 'Artis' was written above it, believed that the zoo was just called Artis. Thanks to this, soon few people knew it by its full name: Natura Artis Magistra.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The zoo is commonly referred to as Artis, because the zoo has three gates with the words 'Natura', 'Artis', and 'Magistra' written above each of them, respectively, which combined formed its actual name. More often than not, only the middle gate was open, so that people who walked through it, seeing that 'Artis' was written above it, believed that the zoo was just called Artis. Thanks to this, soon few people knew it by its full name: Natura Artis Magistra.

facts.text: An extensive ethnographic collection moved to the Tropenmuseum in 1921 after long display at the site.
facts.sourceQuote: The extensive ethnographic collection that Artis displayed for a long time in its Ethnographic Museum was transferred in 1921 to the nearby Tropenmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The extensive ethnographic collection that Artis displayed for a long time in its Ethnographic Museum was transferred in 1921 to the nearby Tropenmuseum.

facts.text: Twenty-seven historic buildings and bridges within the grounds serve as animal enclosures.
facts.sourceQuote: Artis contains 27 historically significant (listed) buildings, bridges, and ponds, most of which are still used as animal enclosures.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Artis contains 27 historically significant (listed) buildings, bridges, and ponds, most of which are still used as animal enclosures.

facts.text: An aquarium building houses a portion of the zoo's art collection.
facts.sourceQuote: A part of the art collection is on display in the aquarium building of the zoo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A part of the art collection is on display in the aquarium building of the zoo.

features.opening: Natura Artis Magistra (Latin for "Nature is the teacher of art"), commonly known just as Artis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɑrtɪs]), is a zoo and botanical garden…

features.name: Arcam

facts.text: Arcam was established in 1986 as the oldest of over forty Dutch architecture centers.
facts.sourceQuote: Amsterdam Centre for Architecture (Arcam) is an organisation that was founded in 1986 that "concentrates its activities in Amsterdam and the surrounding area." Arcam focuses on architecture, urban design, and landscape architecture. Arcam is the oldest and largest of more than forty local Dutch architecture centers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Amsterdam Centre for Architecture (Arcam) is an organisation that was founded in 1986 that "concentrates its activities in Amsterdam and the surrounding area." Arcam focuses on architecture, urban design, and landscape architecture. Arcam is the oldest and largest of more than forty local Dutch architecture centers.

facts.text: Municipal services and the Support Foundation for Architecture fund its work.
facts.sourceQuote: Arcam's work is made possible by donors, sponsors, several services of the municipality of Amsterdam and the Stimuleringsfonds voor Architectuur (English: Support Foundation for Architecture).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Arcam's work is made possible by donors, sponsors, several services of the municipality of Amsterdam and the Stimuleringsfonds voor Architectuur (English: Support Foundation for Architecture).

features.opening: Amsterdam Centre for Architecture (Arcam) is an organisation that was founded in 1986 that "concentrates its activities in Amsterdam and the surrounding area."…

features.name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk

facts.text: In 2005 the site transformed into the Russian Orthodox Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2005 werd het de Russisch-orthodoxe Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk.

facts.text: After the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, this parish left the Moscow Patriarchate for Constantinople.
facts.sourceQuote: Naar aanleiding van de Russische invasie van Oekraïne in 2022 scheidde de parochie zich af van het Patriarchaat Moskou en sloot zich aan bij het Orthodox Aartsbisdom van België, Exarchaat van Nederland en Luxemburg onder het Oecumenisch patriarchaat van Constantinopel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Following the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the parish separated from the Patriarchate of Moscow and joined the Orthodox Archdiocese of Belgium, Exarchate of the Netherlands and Luxembourg under the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople.

facts.text: The Capuchin order bought the land in 1910 for just 2200 guilders to build a chapel.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1910 kocht de kapucijner-orde voor 2200 gulden het terrein omdat ze er een hulpkerk wilden bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1910, the Capuchin order bought the land for 2200 guilders because they wanted to build a chapel there.

facts.text: Reinforced concrete was used extensively for foundations, floors, and columns throughout the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Van gewapend beton is op ruime schaal gebruik gemaakt o.a. voor geheel de fundering, voor alle vloeren van rectoraat, kerk en tribune, terwijl mede alle onderlaagbalken en kolommen van gewapend beton zijn."
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Reinforced concrete has been used on a large scale, among other things, for the entire foundation, for all floors of the rectory, church and tribune, while many of the subfloor beams and columns are also made of reinforced concrete."

features.opening: The Tichelkerk or Tichel is a church building at the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdamse Jordaan.

features.name: Jeruzalemkerk

facts.text: The name Jeruzalemkerk references Jerusalem as a city without a temple since 70 CE.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze is ontleend aan de inzamelingsactie Stad zonder Tempel die gehouden werd om de kerk te financieren. Omdat Jeruzalem sinds het jaar 70 een stad zonder tempel is, was deze naam toepasselijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is taken from the City without Temple fundraising campaign held to finance the church. Because Jerusalem has been a city without a temple since the year 70, this name was appropriate.

facts.text: Architect Ferdinand Jantzen designed this church built between 1928 and 1929.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd gebouwd in de jaren 1928-1929 naar een ontwerp van de architect Ferdinand Jantzen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in the years 1928-1929 according to a design by the architect Ferdinand Jantzen.

facts.text: The architect Jantzen deliberately built the church onto existing houses to express God living with people.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was een bewuste keuze van de architect Jantzen om de kerk aan woningen vast te bouwen. Dit drukt uit dat God bij de mensen wil wonen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was a deliberate choice of the architect Jantzen to build the church onto houses. This expresses that God wants to live with people.

facts.text: Unlike most churches, this structure is oriented north-south rather than east-west.
facts.sourceQuote: De Jeruzalemkerk is noord-zuid gericht, terwijl de meeste kerken oost-west gericht zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Jeruzalemkerk is north-south oriented, while most churches are east-west oriented.

features.opening: The Jeruzalemkerk is a Protestant church on the Jan Maijenstraat in the West borough of Amsterdam, in the De Baarsjes district near the Mercatorplein.

features.name: Rembrandt van Rijn statue

facts.text: The statue depicts Rembrandt van Rijn sitting on a box with initials RVR while holding a pencil and sketchbook.
facts.sourceQuote: In zijn ontwerp beeldde hij Rembrandt zittend en tekenend af, met in zijn linkerhand een schetsboek en in zijn rechterhand een tekenstift. Rembrandt zit op een kist, met de initialen RVR, waar een palet met penselen tegenaan staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In his design, he depicted Rembrandt sitting and drawing, with a sketchbook in his left hand and a drawing pencil in his right hand. Rembrandt is sitting on a box, with the initials RVR, where a palette of brushes is standing against it.

facts.text: Johannes Immerzeel advocated for the monument in 1838 before municipal officials asked him to investigate possibilities.
facts.sourceQuote: De schrijver Johannes Immerzeel schreef in 1838 zijn Lofrede op Rembrandt, hij pleit daarin voor het oprichten van een standbeeld voor de schilder. Immerzeel werd door het Amsterdams gemeentebestuur gevraagd de mogelijkheden voor een standbeeld te onderzoeken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The writer Johannes Immerzeel wrote his Lofrede op Rembrandt in 1838, in which he advocates the creation of a statue for the painter. The Amsterdam municipal government asked Immerzeel to investigate the possibilities for a statue.

features.opening: The Rembrandt monument is a 19th-century memorial to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn on the Rembrandtplein in Amsterdam.

features.name: Herdenkingsmonument

facts.text: Artist Mischa Rakier created the work after a 2014 order from Amsterdam authorities.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld van kunstenaar Mischa Rakier (geboren Delft 1970) is in 2014 geplaatst na een opdracht van de gemeente Amsterdam en het Stadsdeel Zuid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image of artist Mischa Rakier (born Delft 1970) was placed in 2014 after an order from the municipality of Amsterdam and the South District.

facts.text: The ceramic-polished stainless steel diamond shape appears matte due to its processing.
facts.sourceQuote: Het herdenkingsteken is gemaakt van keramisch gepareld roestvast staal en heeft de vorm van een liggende diamant. Die bewerking zorgt ervoor dat het staal enigszins mat is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The commemorative sign is made of ceramic-polished stainless steel and has the shape of a lying diamond. That processing ensures that the steel is somewhat matte.

facts.text: A quote by Elie Wiesel about understanding memory is inscribed on the monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld is voorzien van de tekst If you could remember what I remember you would understand. Die tekst sprak Elie Wiesel uit toen hij de Nobelprijs voor de Vrede op 10 december 1986 in Oslo kreeg overhandigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image is provided with the text If you could remember what I remember you would understand. That text was spoken by Elie Wiesel when he received the Nobel Peace Prize on December 10, 1986 in Oslo.

features.opening: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Commemoration and remembrance, is an artistic work of art in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Museum Amsterdam Noord

facts.text: A dedicated bathhouse was built because the garden village houses lacked private bathrooms.
facts.sourceQuote: De woningen in dit tuindorp hadden geen badkamer en dus was een badhuis noodzakelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The houses in this garden village did not have a bathroom and so a bathhouse was necessary.

facts.text: Visitors can attend lectures, watch films, or join guided tours of Amsterdam-Noord here.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier worden ook lezingen gehouden en films vertoond. Tevens organiseert het museum regelmatig rondleidingen door Amsterdam-Noord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Lectures and films are also held here. The museum also regularly organizes guided tours of Amsterdam-Noord.

features.opening: Museum Amsterdam Noord is a Dutch cultural history museum on the corner of Zamenhofstraat and Meeuwenlaan in Amsterdam-North.

features.name: Ketelhuis

facts.text: The original temporary location featured reclining benches rather than traditional cinema seats for visitors.
facts.sourceQuote: De tijdelijke locatie kenmerkte zich door het gebruik van (lig)banken in plaats van bioscoopstoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The temporary location was characterized by the use of (reclining) benches instead of cinema seats.

facts.text: The venue screens Dutch productions, European arthouse cinema, documentaries, and family films.
facts.sourceQuote: Er worden Nederlandse films, Europese arthousefilms, documentaires en familiefilms vertoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dutch films, European arthouse films, documentaries and family films are shown.

facts.text: Ketelhuis has operated as a film theater within the Westergasfabriek cultural park since 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Ketelhuis is een Nederlands filmtheater dat sinds 1999 gevestigd is in cultuurpark Westergasfabriek in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Het Ketelhuis is a Dutch film theater that has been located in Westergasfabriek cultural park in Amsterdam since 1999.

features.opening: Het Ketelhuis is a Dutch film theater that has been located in the Westergasfabriek cultural park in Amsterdam since 1999.

features.name: Felix Meritis

facts.text: Five sculptures on the façade represent the society's five departments: visual arts, literature, trade, science, and music.
facts.sourceQuote: The classical temple façade with its colossal Corinthian pilasters and pediment represent the society's five departments with five sculptures representing the visual arts and architecture, literature, trade, natural sciences and music.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The classical temple façade with its colossal Corinthian pilasters and pediment represent the society's five departments with five sculptures representing the visual arts and architecture, literature, trade, natural sciences and music.

facts.text: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony and Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique received their Dutch premieres in this hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Thus, Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony and Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique had their Dutch premiere in the concert hall of Felix Meritis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thus, Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony and Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique had their Dutch premiere in the concert hall of Felix Meritis.

facts.text: A fire destroyed part of the structure in 1932.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1932 part of the building was destroyed in a fire.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1932 part of the building was destroyed in a fire.

facts.text: The Communist Party made this site its headquarters after World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Second World War the Communist Party of the Netherlands set up its headquarters in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Second World War the Communist Party of the Netherlands set up its headquarters in the building.

features.opening: Felix Meritis ('Happy through Merit') is the name of an intellectual society in Amsterdam, but subsequently used for their building on the Keizersgracht.

features.name: Simon Carmiggelt

facts.text: The hollow granite pedestal contains a box holding 4,000 transfer cards submitted by donors.
facts.sourceQuote: Die sokkel is hol van binnen. Ze bevat in een zinken kistje de 4000 overschrijvingskaarten die na de oproep van Van Duinhoven binnenkwamen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That base is hollow inside. It contains in a sinker box the 4000 transfer cards that came in after Van Duinhoven's call.

features.opening: The Bust of Simon Carmiggelt is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Marseille House

facts.text: The house bears a stone on its façade showing the layout of Marseille, the French port city.
facts.sourceQuote: On the building's classical façade, Focquier placed a stone depicting the layout of the French port city of Marseille.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the building's classical façade, Focquier placed a stone depicting the layout of the French port city of Marseille.

facts.text: The venue preserves original ceiling paintings, stucco work, and a red Louis XIV-style room within its canal houses.
facts.sourceQuote: Many original details have been preserved, including ceiling paintings, stucco work, marble finishes, and a Louis XIV-style room featuring a red interior; the building was restored and the museum extended into the adjacent building in 2007–2013.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many original details have been preserved, including ceiling paintings, stucco work, marble finishes, and a Louis XIV-style room featuring a red interior; the building was restored and the museum extended into the adjacent building in 2007–2013.

facts.text: Unlike traditional galleries, this museum avoids white cube layouts to utilize authentic light-filled spaces.
facts.sourceQuote: Huis Marseille deviates from the traditional "white cube" layout. Its authentic, light-filled spaces enhance the presentation and experience of the photographic works.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis Marseille deviates from the traditional "white cube" layout. Its authentic, light-filled spaces enhance the presentation and experience of the photographic works.

facts.text: Visitors can explore a specialized photobook store and a historic garden house located in the canal garden.
facts.sourceQuote: In addition, the museum features a photography library, a specialized photobook store, and a canal garden with a historic garden house.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, the museum features a photography library, a specialized photobook store, and a canal garden with a historic garden house.

features.opening: Huis Marseille is a photography museum in Amsterdam.

features.name: Cinecenter

facts.text: A police station now occupies a new construction at Lijnbaansgracht 219 opposite the cinema.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast Cinecenter is op Lijnbaansgracht 219 een politiebureau gevestigd in nieuwbouw uit dezelfde tijd als de bioscoop; tegenover de bioscoop aan de overzijde van de Lijnbaansgracht ligt cultureel centrum Melkweg, nog refererend aan de oude fabriek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to Cinecenter, a police station is located at Lijnbaansgracht 219 in new construction dating from the same period as the cinema; opposite the cinema on the other side of the Lijnbaansgracht is the cultural center Melkweg, still referring to the old factory.

features.opening: Cinecenter is an Amsterdam cinema in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Van Gogh Museum

facts.text: Architects Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa designed the buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum opened on 2 June 1973, and its buildings were designed by Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum opened on 2 June 1973, and its buildings were designed by Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa.

facts.text: A global immersive experience about Van Gogh launched there in 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2019, the Van Gogh Museum launched the Meet Vincent Van Gogh Experience, a technology-driven "immersive exhibition" on Van Gogh's life and works, which has toured globally.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2019, the Van Gogh Museum launched the Meet Vincent Van Gogh Experience, a technology-driven "immersive exhibition" on Van Gogh's life and works, which has toured globally.

facts.text: The collection was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.

facts.text: Johanna van Gogh-Bonger organized exhibitions that significantly contributed to his posthumous recognition.
facts.sourceQuote: In the years following her husband’s death, Johanna van Gogh-Bonger organized exhibitions of Vincent van Gogh's work in the Netherlands and abroad, significantly contributing to his posthumous recognition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the years following her husband’s death, Johanna van Gogh-Bonger organized exhibitions of Vincent van Gogh's work in the Netherlands and abroad, significantly contributing to his posthumous recognition.

facts.text: Vincent's unsold works passed to his brother Theo, who died just six months later.
facts.sourceQuote: Upon Vincent van Gogh's death in 1890, his work not sold fell into the possession of his brother Theo. Theo died six months after Vincent, leaving the work in the possession of his widow, Johanna van Gogh-Bonger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Upon Vincent van Gogh's death in 1890, his work not sold fell into the possession of his brother Theo. Theo died six months after Vincent, leaving the work in the possession of his widow, Johanna van Gogh-Bonger.

facts.text: The son inherited the private collection in 1925 before it was loaned to the Stedelijk Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.

features.opening: The Van Gogh Museum (Dutch pronunciation: [vɑŋˈɣɔx mʏˌzeːjʏm]) is a Dutch art museum dedicated to the works of Vincent van Gogh and his contemporaries in the…

features.name: Amsterdam Museum

facts.text: Hendrick de Keyser and his son Pieter extended the structure before Jacob van Campen rebuilt it in 1634.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.

facts.text: The institution operated under the name Amsterdam Historical Museum until 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.

features.opening: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.

features.name: Keizersgrachtkerk

facts.text: Abraham Kuyper led the Suffering Dutch Reformed Church that commissioned this building following the 1886 split.
facts.sourceQuote: De opdracht voor de bouw van de Keizersgrachtkerk (ook Dolerende Kerk geheten) werd gegeven door de dolerende Nederduitsche Gereformeerde Gemeente onder leiding van Abraham Kuyper, in die tijd hoogleraar aan de Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam. Deze gemeente was ontstaan na een scheuring in de Nederlandse Hervormde Kerk in 1886, de zogenaamde Doleantie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The commission for the construction of the Keizersgrachtkerk (also called the Suffering Church) was given by the Suffering Dutch Reformed Church under the leadership of Abraham Kuyper, at that time professor at the Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam. This municipality was formed after a split in the Dutch Reformed Church in 1886, the so-called Doleantie.

facts.text: Iron pillars supported galleries that allowed 1600 seats inside a space resembling a 17th century gallery church.
facts.sourceQuote: Het interieur lijkt op een galerijkerk uit de 17e eeuw waardoor er plaats is voor veel mensen op een kleine oppervlakte. Hiervoor is gebruikgemaakt van op ijzeren zuiltjes geplaatste galerijen. De kerk telde oorspronkelijk 1600 zitplaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The interior resembles a 17th century gallery church, which allows for a large number of people in a small space. For this purpose, galleries were used placed on iron pillars. The church originally had 1600 seats.

facts.text: Two priests were shot dead by German occupiers in September 1944 after weapons were found in a church annex.
facts.sourceQuote: In de nacht van 12 op 13 september 1944 werden de koster, Sieberen van der Baan (1894), en een van de twee predikanten, Taeke Ferwerda (1876), door Duitse bezetters in de Kerkstraat doodgeschoten, vijf dagen na de vondst van wapens in een bijgebouw van de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the night of September 12 to 13, 1944, the parish priest, Sieberen van der Baan (1894), and one of the two priests, Taeke Ferwerda (1876), were shot dead by German occupiers in Kerkstraat, five days after the discovery of weapons in an annex of the church.

features.opening: The Keizersgrachtkerk is a church of 1888, originally Reformed, on the Amsterdam Keizersgracht.

features.name: Filmhuis Cavia

facts.text: The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop is in de jaren tachtig voortgekomen uit de kraakbeweging en heeft een eenvoudige formule: er wordt gedraaid wat elders niet te zien is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement and has a simple formula: it shows what cannot be seen elsewhere.

facts.text: Special attention is given to films on gender, feminism, and sex-positive themes.
facts.sourceQuote: Het filmhuis besteedt bijzondere aandacht aan films uit niet-westerse landen en thema's als gender, seksuele identiteit, feminisme en sex-positive-porno.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The film theater pays special attention to films from non-Western countries and themes such as gender, sexual identity, feminism and sex-positive porn.

features.opening: Filmhuis Cavia is a film theater in the Van Hallstraat in the Amsterdam Staatsliedenbuurt that is run entirely by volunteers.

features.name: Museum Van Loon

facts.text: The Van Loon family resided in the building continuously from 1884 until 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1884 to 1945 the Van Loons lived in the house.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1884 to 1945 the Van Loons lived in the house.

facts.text: Thora van Loon-Egidius served as a lady-in-waiting to Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Thora van Loon-Egidius, who lived in the house, was a lady-in-waiting for Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thora van Loon-Egidius, who lived in the house, was a lady-in-waiting for Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.

facts.text: Four sculptures of Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan crown the house.
facts.sourceQuote: There are four sculptures on top of the house, representing Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are four sculptures on top of the house, representing Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan.

facts.text: Famous architect Adriaan Dortsman designed the house in 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was designed in 1672 by Adriaan Dortsman, the famous Dutch architect known for having created the Ronde Lutherse Kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was designed in 1672 by Adriaan Dortsman, the famous Dutch architect known for having created the Ronde Lutherse Kerk.

facts.text: Upstairs rooms display paintings of Roman sports figures and Italian scenes.
facts.sourceQuote: The upstairs features several paintings of Roman sports figures and a bedroom that is decorated with a Romanticism period painting of Italy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The upstairs features several paintings of Roman sports figures and a bedroom that is decorated with a Romanticism period painting of Italy.

features.opening: Museum Van Loon is a museum located in a canalside house alongside the Keizersgracht in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Amsterdam University College

facts.text: The college officially opened in 2008 with its first students arriving the following year.
facts.sourceQuote: AUC was officially founded in 2008, and took up operation with its founding class in 2009.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AUC was officially founded in 2008, and took up operation with its founding class in 2009.

facts.text: The inaugural class of graduates received their diplomas in 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: The first class of graduates received their diplomas in 2012.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first class of graduates received their diplomas in 2012.

facts.text: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.
facts.sourceQuote: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.

facts.text: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.
facts.sourceQuote: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.

features.opening: Amsterdam University College is a Liberal Arts and Sciences Bachelor's programme that is a joint initiative of the University of Amsterdam and Vrije…

features.name: Posthoornkerk

facts.text: Galleries were installed above the side aisles to maximize space since the structure could not stand free.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat de kerk niet vrijstaand kon worden gebouwd werd zij extra hoog uitgevoerd. Om de beperkte ruimte optimaal te benutten werd de kerk inwendig voorzien van galerijen boven de zijbeuken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the church could not be built free-standing, it was made extra high. In order to make the most of the limited space, the church was internally provided with galleries above the side aisles.

facts.text: After retiring from service in 1963, the building survived demolition plans until being repurposed in 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: De Posthoornkerk werd in 1963 buiten dienst gesteld. Hoewel in 1972 de status van Rijksmonument werd toegekend waren er tot 1987 sloopplannen. In 1986 ontfermde stichting de Posthoornkerk zich over het gebouw, dat sindsdien voor onder meer tentoonstellingen en concerten wordt gebruikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Posthoornkerk was retired from service in 1963. Although the status of Rijksmonument was granted in 1972, there were demolition plans until 1987. In 1986, the Posthoornkerk foundation took care of the building, which has since been used for exhibitions and concerts, among other things.

features.opening: The Posthoornkerk, official name Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, is a church building on Haarlemmerstraat in Amsterdam.

features.name: Collectie Six

facts.text: Collectie Six preserves the family name of founder Jan Six, who established it in 1922.
facts.sourceQuote: De Six Stichting werd opgericht in 1922 door prof. jhr. dr. Jan Six, heer van Hillegom en Wimmenum (1857-1926), hoogleraar esthetica en kunstgeschiedenis aan de Universiteit van Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Six Foundation was founded in 1922 by Prof. Mr. Dr. Jan Six, lord of Hillegom and Wimmenum (1857-1926), professor of aesthetics and art history at the University of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The collection once included Vermeer's The Milkmaid and Rembrandt's Doctor Bueno.
facts.sourceQuote: Een belangrijke uitbreiding was die met de verzameling Van Winter, opgebouwd door Pieter van Winter (1753-1807) en waarvan de helft terechtkwam bij dochter Lucretia Johanna van Winter (1785-1845), een verzameling die zijzelf overigens nog enorm uitbreidde. Deze verzameling bevatte onder andere Het straatje en Het melkmeisje van Johannes Vermeer, de brief van Ter Borch, Het oestereetstertje van Steen, Dokter Bueno van Rembrandt, en tientallen andere schilderijen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An important expansion was that with the Van Winter collection, built up by Pieter van Winter (1753-1807) and half of which ended up with daughter Lucretia Johanna van Winter (1785-1845), a collection that she herself expanded enormously. This collection included, among others, Johannes Vermeer's The Alley and The Milkmaid, Ter Borch's letter, Steen's The Oyster Star, Rembrandt's Doctor Bueno, and dozens of other paintings.

facts.text: Since 1987, management has been held by the oldest male descendant of Jan Six VI.
facts.sourceQuote: De stichtingen worden sedert 1987 bestuurd door de oudste mannelijke nakomeling van Jan Six VI , thans jhr. dr. Jan Six, heer van Hillegom (1947).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1987, the foundations have been managed by the oldest male descendant of Jan Six VI, now Mr. Dr. Jan Six, lord of Hillegom (1947).

facts.text: Collectie Six means the patrimony of the Six family, including portraits and archives.
facts.sourceQuote: De Collectie Six is de gemeenschappelijke naam voor het patrimonium van de familie Six dat naast de familieportretten onder andere het familie-archief en kunst- en antieke voorwerpen in relatie tot de familie omvat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family, which includes, in addition to family portraits, the family archive and art and antique objects related to the family, among other things.

facts.text: The collection holds family portraits alongside the archive of the Six family.
facts.sourceQuote: De Collectie Six is de gemeenschappelijke naam voor het patrimonium van de familie Six dat naast de familieportretten onder andere het familie-archief en kunst- en antieke voorwerpen in relatie tot de familie omvat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family, which includes, in addition to family portraits, the family archive and art and antique objects related to the family, among other things.

features.name: Monument Walraven van Hall

facts.text: Retired doctors Hans Weijers and Loek van Buchem founded the group that created this monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Initiatiefnemer voor dit plastiek was gepensioneerd huisarts Hans Weijers en gepensioneerd medicus Loek van Buchem die een stichting in het leven riepen om een monument voor verzetsman Walraven van Hall op te richten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The initiator of this plastic was retired general practitioner Hans Weijers and retired doctor Loek van Buchem who set up a foundation to establish a monument for resistance fighter Walraven van Hall.

features.opening: The Monument Walraven van Hall is a work of art and war monument in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Annick van Hardeveld

facts.text: On May 4, 1945, the German occupiers murdered Annick van Hardeveld at age twenty-one.
facts.sourceQuote: De tekst op de plaquette luidt: Op deze plek werd op 4 mei 1945 de laatste koerierster uit het verzet, Annick van Hardeveld, door de Duitse bezetter vermoord. Zij was 21 jaar oud.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The text on the plaque reads: On this place, on May 4, 1945, the last courier from the resistance, Annick van Hardeveld, was murdered by the German occupiers. She was 21 years old.

facts.text: Stories of Annick van Hardeveld appear in the booklet Christmas 1944 and Requiem for a Courierwoman.
facts.sourceQuote: Haar naam dook op in het boekwerkje Kerst 1944, waarin verhalen van mensen uit het Nederlands verzet in de Tweede Wereldoorlog en overlevenden uit concentratiekampen hun verhaal deden. Ze werd genoemd in het verhaal Requiem voor een koerierster.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Her name appeared in the booklet Christmas 1944, in which stories from people from the Dutch resistance in World War II and survivors from concentration camps told their story. She was mentioned in the story Requiem for a Courierwoman.

features.opening: The Monument for Annick van Hardeveld is a war monument in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: Luther Museum Amsterdam

facts.text: The institution was renamed Luther Museum Amsterdam in 2019 after being called the Luther Collection since 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2008 draagt de stichting, die als doelstelling het behoud van luthers erfgoed heeft, de naam Luther Collectie Amsterdam, welke in 2019 de naam gekregen heeft Luther Museum Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2008, the foundation, which aims to preserve Lutheran heritage, has been called the Luther Collection Amsterdam, which was renamed Luther Museum Amsterdam in 2019.

facts.text: Authentic interiors of the original regent's chambers are preserved as valuable art historical pieces within the collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Sommige stukken zijn vanaf de oprichting van het gebouw aanwezig in het bestuurscentrum terwijl de authentieke interieurs van de regentenkamers zelf ook een kunsthistorische waarde vertegenwoordigen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some pieces have been present in the management center since the building was founded, while the authentic interiors of the regent's chambers themselves also represent an art historical value.

facts.text: Donations from individuals and purchases by the foundation supplement items from closed orphanages and diaconates.
facts.sourceQuote: Veel onderdelen zijn afkomstig uit het Amsterdamse Evangelisch-Luthers Diaconie Weeshuis of andere lutherse instellingen die de deuren sloten of hun kunst en antiek veilig wilden onderbrengen. Ook schenkingen van particulieren maken deel uit van de collectie. Ten slotte heeft de stichting stukken aangekocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many parts come from the Amsterdam Evangelical-Lutheran Orphanage Diaconate or other Lutheran institutions that closed their doors or wanted to store their art and antiques safely. Donations from individuals also make up part of the collection. Finally, the foundation purchased pieces.

facts.text: The collection was assembled within the former regent's chambers of building Wittenberg.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is bijeengebracht in de regentenkamers van gebouw Wittenberg, gelegen aan de Nieuwe Keizersgracht te Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was brought together in the regent's chambers of building Wittenberg, located on the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam.

features.opening: The Luther Museum Amsterdam, formerly known as the Luther Collection Amsterdam, is a museum that wants to introduce the public to Lutheranism in the…

features.name: Gedenksteen

facts.text: The statue stands behind a Greek-looking gate on the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen side.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld staat aan een apart liggend deel van het plein aan de zijde van het Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen, direct achter de aldaar gesitueerde Grieks aandoende poort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue stands in a separate part of the square on the side of the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen, directly behind the Greek-looking gate located there.

facts.text: A wandering stone split into two offset parts is held together by a stainless steel anchor on a metal pole.
facts.sourceQuote: Zaanen ontwierp een zwerfkei, die in twee delen gespleten is en waarvan de twee delen ten opzichte van elkaar verschoven zijn. De twee delen worden bijeengehouden door een roestvast stalen verankering. Het geheel staat op een metalen paaltje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Zaanen designed a wandering stone, which is split into two parts and whose two parts are offset from each other. The two parts are held together by a stainless steel anchor. The whole thing is mounted on a metal pole.

features.opening: The Gedenksteen for the former Detention Center, also known as Gedenksteen 4 May, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: New Church

facts.text: The bishop of Utrecht authorized this second parish church after the Old Church became too small.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Oude Kerk ("Old Church") grew too small for the expanding population of the town, the bishop of Utrecht gave permission to build a second parish church, the Nieuwe Kerk ("New Church").
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Oude Kerk ("Old Church") grew too small for the expanding population of the town, the bishop of Utrecht gave permission to build a second parish church, the Nieuwe Kerk ("New Church").

facts.text: A fire in 1645 burned the church down almost entirely before it was rebuilt in Gothic style.
facts.sourceQuote: The church was damaged by the city fires of 1421 and 1452 and burned down almost entirely in 1645, after which it was rebuilt in Gothic style.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was damaged by the city fires of 1421 and 1452 and burned down almost entirely in 1645, after which it was rebuilt in Gothic style.

facts.text: Ownership transferred to a cultural foundation in 1979 to keep the expensive building open.
facts.sourceQuote: The second renovation proved expensive for the Dutch Reformed Church, forcing the church to be closed most of the time in order to save money on maintenance. To keep the church open, ownership was transferred in 1979 to a newly formed cultural foundation called the Nationale Stichting De Nieuwe Kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The second renovation proved expensive for the Dutch Reformed Church, forcing the church to be closed most of the time in order to save money on maintenance. To keep the church open, ownership was transferred in 1979 to a newly formed cultural foundation called the Nationale Stichting De Nieuwe Kerk.

facts.text: Dutch naval heroes like Admiral Michiel de Ruyter rest within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: The Nieuwe Kerk is a burial site for Dutch naval heroes, including Admiral Michiel de Ruyter, Commodore Jan van Galen, and lieutenant commander Jan van Speyk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Nieuwe Kerk is a burial site for Dutch naval heroes, including Admiral Michiel de Ruyter, Commodore Jan van Galen, and lieutenant commander Jan van Speyk.

features.name: Weepers' Tower

facts.text: Women did not actually weep at this tower for husbands leaving to war or the colonies.
facts.sourceQuote: Schreierstoren is incorrectly known for the fact that women wept there for their husbands, who would leave from that port, to go to war, the colonies or to fish. Most of the weeping that was done was for the fishermen who left from that port. However, this is an incorrect myth based on the confusion of the similarities of the Old Dutch word schrey meaning "sharp" and the Dutch word schreien meaning "weeping".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Schreierstoren is incorrectly known for the fact that women wept there for their husbands, who would leave from that port, to go to war, the colonies or to fish. Most of the weeping that was done was for the fishermen who left from that port. However, this is an incorrect myth based on the confusion of the similarities of the Old Dutch word schrey meaning "sharp" and the Dutch word schreien meaning "weeping".

facts.text: A 1569 tablet commemorating a heart-grieved woman helped cement the myth of constant weeping there.
facts.sourceQuote: This confusion was further supported by the "memory tablet" in the tower, dating back to 1569, which "commemorates" a woman who was so "heart-grieved" at the departure of her husband, that she went insane.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This confusion was further supported by the "memory tablet" in the tower, dating back to 1569, which "commemorates" a woman who was so "heart-grieved" at the departure of her husband, that she went insane.

facts.text: Henry Hudson departed from this tower to begin his voyage that discovered modern New York.
facts.sourceQuote: It was the location from which Henry Hudson set sail on his journey to Northern America. This expedition would lead to the discovery of the modern New York metropolitan area, which laid the foundation for Dutch colonization of the region.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the location from which Henry Hudson set sail on his journey to Northern America. This expedition would lead to the discovery of the modern New York metropolitan area, which laid the foundation for Dutch colonization of the region.

features.name: Fusillade

facts.text: On March 12, 1945, German forces executed thirty prisoners here as reprisal.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier fusilleerde het Duitse leger op 12 maart 1945 dertig politieke gevangenen als wraakactie voor een verzetsdaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here, on March 12, 1945, the German army executed thirty political prisoners as a reprisal for a resistance act.

facts.text: The bronze work was created in 1954 by sculptor Gerrit Bolhuis.
facts.sourceQuote: Fusillade, ook wel De gevallen hoornblazer, is een bronzen beeld aan het Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, in 1954 gemaakt door Gerrit Bolhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis.

facts.text: On March 10, 1945, the Sicherheitsdienst searched a house used as a resistance group's central post office.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 maart 1945 deed de Sicherheitsdienst huiszoeking in de woning Stadhouderskade 56, die als centrale post voor Groep 2000 diende.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 10, 1945, the Sicherheitsdienst conducted a search of the house at Stadhouderskade 56, which served as the central post office for Group 2000.

facts.text: A firefight broke out after resistance members broke into the house the day after the initial search.
facts.sourceQuote: Om te voorkomen dat deze gevonden zou worden, drongen verzetsleden de volgende dag het huis binnen. Er volgde een vuurgevecht, waarbij Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer van de SS, om het leven kwam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To prevent it from being found, resistance members broke into the house the next day. A firefight ensued, in which Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer of the SS, died.

facts.text: An SS Hauptscharführer named Ernst Wehner died during the ensuing shootout.
facts.sourceQuote: Er volgde een vuurgevecht, waarbij Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer van de SS, om het leven kwam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A firefight ensued, in which Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer of the SS, died.

features.opening: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis.

features.name: Gerard Dou Synagogue

facts.text: German occupiers missed the synagogue during WWII, allowing services to continue until 1943.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat is wellicht ook de reden dat de Duitse bezetter in de Tweede Wereldoorlog de synagoge niet opmerkte en de diensten tot in 1943 konden doorgaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That may also be the reason why the German occupier did not notice the synagogue during World War II and services could continue until 1943.

features.opening: The Synagoge Gerard Doustraat in the Amsterdam district of de Pijp was built in 1892 at the behest of Ashkenazi chevre Tesjoe'at Israel (Hulpe Israëls).

features.name: Rembrandt House

facts.text: The house was redesigned in the 20th century using an inventory from Rembrandt's 1656 bankruptcy.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656.

facts.text: Rembrandt's teacher Pieter Lastman and pupils Ferdinand Bol and Govert Flinck also created works displayed here.
facts.sourceQuote: In Rembrandt's old house there are also works of art from the 17th century, including by Rembrandt's teacher Pieter Lastman and his pupils Ferdinand Bol and Govert Flinck.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Rembrandt's old house there are also works of art from the 17th century, including by Rembrandt's teacher Pieter Lastman and his pupils Ferdinand Bol and Govert Flinck.

facts.text: A 1656 bankruptcy inventory of Rembrandt's assets guided the building's modern reconstruction.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656.

facts.text: Around 1627, an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment were added to the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was built around 1606 and was renovated around 1627, probably under the supervision of Jacob van Campen. It was then given an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built around 1606 and was renovated around 1627, probably under the supervision of Jacob van Campen. It was then given an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina and Prince Hendrik were the very first visitors when the museum opened in 1911.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was opened on 10 June 1911. Queen Wilhelmina and Prince Hendrik were the first visitors.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was opened on 10 June 1911. Queen Wilhelmina and Prince Hendrik were the first visitors.

features.opening: The Rembrandt House Museum (Dutch: Museum Het Rembrandthuis) is a museum located in a former house in the Jodenbreestraat, in the center of Amsterdam.

features.name: Thorbecke statue

facts.text: Sculptor Ferdinand Leenhoff created the Thorbecke statue while living in Paris.
facts.sourceQuote: De commissie gunde de opdracht aan de in Parijs woonachtige beeldhouwer Ferdinand Leenhoff.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The commission awarded the commission to the sculptor Ferdinand Leenhoff, who lives in Paris.

facts.text: A Scheveningen coachman who resembled Thorbecke served as the model for the figure.
facts.sourceQuote: De Haagse journalist Pieter Anne Haaxman schreef over het ontstaan van Leenhoff's Thorbeckebeeld in een terugblik dat een Scheveningse koetsier, die sprekend op Thorbecke leek, als model gefungeerd heeft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hague journalist Pieter Anne Haaxman wrote about the origin of Leenhoff's Thorbecke statue in a retrospective that a Scheveningen coachman, who looked strikingly like Thorbecke, had served as a model.

facts.text: Proposals to drain the Zuiderzee and rename the new polder Thorbecke never succeeded.
facts.sourceQuote: Voorstellen om een buste te sturen naar alle gemeentes in het land en om de Zuiderzee droog te leggen en de nieuwe polder naar Thorbecke te vernoemen haalden de eindstreep niet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Proposals to send a bust to all municipalities in the country and to drain the Zuiderzee and rename the new polder Thorbecke did not reach the finish line.

facts.text: The figure leans on a Greek pillar with his right hand while holding a law scroll in his left.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij leunt met zijn rechterhand op een Griekse zuil, symbool voor de democratie, en houdt in zijn linkerhand een wetsrol.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He leans on a Greek pillar, symbol of democracy, with his right hand, and holds a law scroll in his left hand.

facts.text: Inscriptions on the pedestal call him a true people's friend, loyal servant of the crown, and restorer of state government.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel zijn op de vier zijden opschriften aangebracht, waaronder OPRECHT VOLKSVRIEND, TROUWE DIENAAR der KROON, HERVORMER der STAATSREGELING
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal, inscriptions have been applied on all four sides, including TRUE PEOPLE'S FRIEND, LOYAL SERVANT of the CROWN, RESTORER of STATE GOVERNMENT

features.opening: The statue of Johan Rudolph Thorbecke, or Thorbecke monument, is a 19th-century memorial in Amsterdam to the liberal politician Thorbecke.

features.name: Pathé de Munt

facts.text: The facade uses a brick trompe l'oeil to appear deeper than it truly is.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorgevel kan gezien worden als een bakstenen Trompe l'oeil: als je vanuit de Vijzelstraat richting Munt naar de gevel kijkt (zie foto), lijkt die veel dieper dan hij in werkelijkheid is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The facade can be seen as a brick Trompe l'oeil: if you look at the facade from Vijzelstraat towards Munt (see photo), it looks much deeper than it actually is.

facts.text: Georges van Delft designed the modern building with Plan architects and Christian de Portzamparc.
facts.sourceQuote: Het moderne gebouw werd ontworpen door Georges van Delft in samenwerking met Plan architekten en de Franse architect Christian de Portzamparc.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The modern building was designed by Georges van Delft in collaboration with Plan architects and the French architect Christian de Portzamparc.

facts.text: The venue features thirteen rooms across three floors holding a total of 1829 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop heeft 13 zalen, verdeeld over drie verdiepingen, met in totaal 1829 stoelen; de grootste zaal telt 318 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has 13 rooms, spread over three floors, with a total of 1829 seats; the largest room has 318 seats.

features.opening: Pathé de Munt is a large cinema in the center of Amsterdam of cinema operator Pathé.

features.name: Vrijheidscarillon

facts.text: Bellringer Romke de Waard was the first to play the instrument.
facts.sourceQuote: Koningin Juliana der Nederlanden zette het carillon elektronisch in werking; rechter en beiaardier Romke de Waard was de eerste die het carillon bespeelde, al dan niet begeleid door de Amsterdamse Politiekapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Queen Juliana of the Netherlands put the carillon into electronic operation; right and bellringer Romke de Waard was the first to play the carillon, either accompanied by the Amsterdam Political Chapel or not.

facts.text: De Waard concluded his inaugural performance with the Wilhelmus.
facts.sourceQuote: De Waard sloot zelf af met het Wilhelmus..
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Waard himself closed with the Wilhelmus..

facts.text: The bellringer must see the conductor because orchestras often play near the carillon during May 4 celebrations.
facts.sourceQuote: De gedachte was dat bij de 4-meivieringen dikwijls orkesten zouden plaatsnemen nabij het carillon; voor samenspel was het dus noodzakelijk dat er voldoende ruimte voor een orkest was en dat de beiaardier dan ook de dirigent zou kunnen zien.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The idea was that at the May 4 celebrations, orchestras would often take place near the carillon; so for playing together, it was necessary that there was enough space for an orchestra and that the bellringer could see the conductor.

features.opening: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the…

features.name: Living by Numbers

facts.text: The counting frame uses unique red mouthblown beads to symbolize that no two people are the same.
facts.sourceQuote: Het telraam bevat rode van de kunstenaar bekende mondgeblazen kralen, allemaal verschillend ten opzichte van elkaar. Othoniel vond dit een weergave dat niemand hetzelfde is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The counting frame contains red of the artist's well-known mouthblown beads, all different from each other. Othoniel found this a representation that no one is the same.

facts.text: An aluminum bench allows visitors to reflect on those they have seen die from AIDS or leave names behind.
facts.sourceQuote: Onderdeel van het kunstwerk zijn de roze ondergrond en een aluminium bankje, waarop gebruikers van het bankje kunnen nadenken over personen die zij zelf hebben zien overlijden aan de ziekte. Eventueel kunnen mensen ook daar namen achter laten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the artwork are the pink background and an aluminum bench, on which users of the bench can think about people they have seen die from the disease themselves. People may also leave names there if desired.

features.opening: The HIV/AIDS monument is an artistic work of art on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum that was unveiled on December 1, 2016.

features.name: Jewish Museum

facts.text: In 1989 it won the Council of Europe Museum Prize for both its presentation and building appearance.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was recognized in 1989 when it received the Council of Europe Museum Prize, awarded for a combination of the presentation of the collection and the outward appearance of the buildings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was recognized in 1989 when it received the Council of Europe Museum Prize, awarded for a combination of the presentation of the collection and the outward appearance of the buildings.

facts.text: A major seven-year renovation project concluded at the site in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: A seven-year renovation of the museum was completed in 2007.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A seven-year renovation of the museum was completed in 2007.

features.opening: The Joods Museum (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌjoːts ɦɪsˈtoːris myˈzeːjʏm]; English: Jewish Museum), part of the Jewish Cultural Quarter, is a museum in Amsterdam…

features.name: Allard Pierson Museum

facts.text: On November 12, 1934, the museum officially opened its doors at Sarphatistraat 129-131 in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: On 12 November 1934, the Allard Pierson Museum was officially opened in a building at Sarphatistraat 129-131 (corner of the Roeterstraat).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 12 November 1934, the Allard Pierson Museum was officially opened in a building at Sarphatistraat 129-131 (corner of the Roeterstraat).

features.opening: The Allard Pierson Museum is the archaeological museum of the University of Amsterdam.

features.name: Ziggo Dome

facts.text: Despite its name, the Ziggo Dome contains no round shapes or actual domes.
facts.sourceQuote: Although the name 'Dome' refers to a dome, there are no round shapes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the name 'Dome' refers to a dome, there are no round shapes.

facts.text: Minimal adjustments allow the venue to host tennis, korfball, swimming pools, or ice rinks.
facts.sourceQuote: The building is designed for amplified music, but is multi-usable and can also be made suitable for tennis and korfball competitions, an Olympic-size swimming pool or an ice rink with minimal adjustments.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building is designed for amplified music, but is multi-usable and can also be made suitable for tennis and korfball competitions, an Olympic-size swimming pool or an ice rink with minimal adjustments.

facts.text: Pearl Jam became the first international act to perform here on June 26, 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: The first international act to play the Ziggo Dome was Pearl Jam on 26 June 2012.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first international act to play the Ziggo Dome was Pearl Jam on 26 June 2012.

facts.text: WWE held SmackDown Live house shows at this arena in May 2018 and November 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: On 18 May 2018, and 12 November 2019, American professional wrestling promotion WWE held two house shows at the Ziggo Dome, of which the first being a SmackDown Live house show.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 18 May 2018, and 12 November 2019, American professional wrestling promotion WWE held two house shows at the Ziggo Dome, of which the first being a SmackDown Live house show.

facts.text: Porcupine Tree's 2022 reunion concert was released as a live album titled Closure/Continuation.Live.
facts.sourceQuote: Porcupine Tree's reunion tour show at the Ziggo Dome on 7 November 2022 was released as a live album, Closure/Continuation.Live, on 8 December 2023.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Porcupine Tree's reunion tour show at the Ziggo Dome on 7 November 2022 was released as a live album, Closure/Continuation.Live, on 8 December 2023.

features.opening: The Ziggo Dome (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈzɪɡoː doːm] or [ˈzɪɣoː doːm]) is an indoor arena in Amsterdam, Netherlands, located next to the Johan Cruijff Arena.

features.name: Amsterdam Pipe Museum

facts.text: The collection moved to Leiden in 1982 and operated there as a public museum until 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1982 the Pijpenkabinet moved to Leiden, where it functioned as a public museum until 1995.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1982 the Pijpenkabinet moved to Leiden, where it functioned as a public museum until 1995.

facts.text: In 2011, the museum acquired four hundred items from Groningen's closed Niemeyer tobacco museum.
facts.sourceQuote: When the Niemeyer tobacco museum in Groningen shut down in 2011, the Amsterdam Pipe Museum acquired some four hundred items from its collection before the rest was auctioned off, stating that its acquisition preserved the "core" of the former museum's collection.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Niemeyer tobacco museum in Groningen shut down in 2011, the Amsterdam Pipe Museum acquired some four hundred items from its collection before the rest was auctioned off, stating that its acquisition preserved the "core" of the former museum's collection.

facts.text: The collection spans 25 centuries of global smoking utensils.
facts.sourceQuote: The permanent exhibition of the Amsterdam Pipe Museum displays over 2,000 items representing the variety of smoking pipes and utensils that have been used in all parts of the world over the past 25 centuries.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The permanent exhibition of the Amsterdam Pipe Museum displays over 2,000 items representing the variety of smoking pipes and utensils that have been used in all parts of the world over the past 25 centuries.

features.opening: The Amsterdam Pipe Museum (formerly Dutch: Pijpenkabinet, "pipe cabinet") is a museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, dedicated to smoking pipes, tobacco, and…

features.name: Funerary museum

facts.text: The original caretaker residence was designed by Adriaan Willem Weissman, who also designed the Stedelijk Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The original building was designed as a caretaker’s residence by Adriaan Willem Weissman (1858–1923), who was a Dutch city architect best known for designing the Stedelijk Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original building was designed as a caretaker’s residence by Adriaan Willem Weissman (1858–1923), who was a Dutch city architect best known for designing the Stedelijk Museum.

facts.text: An online exhibition called The Last Image allows anyone to submit digital content about death and dying.
facts.sourceQuote: One of the museum’s exhibitions is “The Last Image,” which is a digital, online exhibition to which anyone can submit content.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the museum’s exhibitions is “The Last Image,” which is a digital, online exhibition to which anyone can submit content.

facts.text: Four themes structure the museum: rituals, the body, mourning and remembrance, and memento mori.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum explores death and funerary practices along four themes: rituals, the body, mourning and remembrance, and memento mori.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum explores death and funerary practices along four themes: rituals, the body, mourning and remembrance, and memento mori.

features.opening: The Nederlands Uitvaart Museum Tot Zover (Dutch Funeral Museum So Far) is a museum in Amsterdam, Netherlands that displays the various funerary practices of…

features.name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial

facts.text: Stonemason Joseph Glatt, who specialized in Jewish gravestones, created the monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het verzetsmonument is het werk van de steenhouwer/steenhouwerij Joseph Glatt aan de Putseweg 21-23 te Putte, die gespecialiseerd was in Joodse grafstenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The resistance monument is the work of the stonemason/stonyware Joseph Glatt at Putseweg 21-23 in Putte, who specialized in Jewish gravestones.

facts.text: Since 1992, this site has served as the central location for annual Kristallnacht commemorations.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1992 is de locatie van het monument (bij het Amsterdamse stadhuis) de centrale plek voor de jaarlijkse Kristallnachtherdenking.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1992, the location of the monument (at the Amsterdam City Hall) has been the central place for the annual Kristallnacht commemoration.

features.opening: The Monument to Jewish Resistance 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the…

features.name: Levensboom

facts.text: Annual ceremonies for the National Day of Awareness have been held at this site since 1993.
