facts.sourceQuote: To commemorate this, people have gathered annually since 1993 at Surinameplein in Amsterdam on June 30 for a ceremony called the National Day of Awareness.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To commemorate this, people have gathered annually since 1993 at Surinameplein in Amsterdam on June 30 for a ceremony called the National Day of Awareness.

facts.text: The location was chosen because Oosterpark was deemed unsuitable for the annual commemoration.
facts.sourceQuote: The Comité 30 juni/1 juli Amsterdam found the location in Oosterpark unsuitable and thus worked towards establishing the Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness at Surinameplein, where the annual commemoration had already been held for ten years.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Comité 30 juni/1 juli Amsterdam found the location in Oosterpark unsuitable and thus worked towards establishing the Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness at Surinameplein, where the annual commemoration had already been held for ten years.

facts.text: The trunk represents ethnic diversity while foliage shows countries and their connections.
facts.sourceQuote: The trunk of the tree represents the ethnic diversity of the community, and the foliage symbolizes the respective countries and their interconnectedness.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The trunk of the tree represents the ethnic diversity of the community, and the foliage symbolizes the respective countries and their interconnectedness.

facts.text: On Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed with speeches and wreaths.
facts.sourceQuote: On the Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed, speeches are given, and wreaths are laid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed, speeches are given, and wreaths are laid.

features.opening: The Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness (Bon Fu Gron Prakseri) is a monument located at Surinameplein in Amsterdam-West, commemorating the history of slavery,…

features.name: Het Nieuwe Verbond

facts.text: A planned tower was cancelled because the parish lacked 100,000 guilders.
facts.sourceQuote: Granpré Molière had aanvankelijk ook een kerktoren ingetekend; echter, de financiële situatie van de parochie was onvoldoende om nog extra circa 100.000 gulden vrij te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Granpré Molière had also initially drawn up a church tower; however, the financial situation of the parish was insufficient to free up an additional approximately 100,000 guilders.

features.opening: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdes church, today the Church of Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city Slotermeer in Amsterdam…

features.name: 1936-1939 No Pasaran

facts.text: The ground features concentric circles in red, yellow, and purple representing the International Brigades flag.
facts.sourceQuote: De eeuwige beweging van het beeld vond haar weerspiegeling in de ondergrond met concentrische cirkels rondom het beeld, ontworpen door Harm van Weerden. Die cirkels waren origineel in de kleuren rood, geel en paars (de kleuren van de vlag van de Internationale Brigades).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The eternal movement of the image found its reflection in the ground with concentric circles around the image, designed by Harm van Weerden. Those circles were original in the colors red, yellow and purple (the colors of the flag of the International Brigades).

facts.text: Swampy soil at the original site forced the team to relocate the statue to Hagedoornplein near the IJtunnel.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld zou oorspronkelijk in 1985 met een bijdrage van Provinciale Staten Noord-Holland geplaatst worden op het marktplein van het Buikslotermeerplein, maar dat werd te druk bevonden. Bovendien waren er problemen omtrent de fundering van het beeld in de aldaar drassige bodem. Roos en Van Weerden gingen er zelf op uit om een nieuwe plek te vinden die geschikter was en vonden die bij een naamloze parkeerplaats naast het IJtunnel-traject aan het Hagedoornplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue was originally to be placed in 1985 on the market square of the Buikslotermeerplein with a contribution from the Provincial States of North Holland, but it was found too crowded. In addition, there were problems regarding the foundation of the statue in the swampy soil there. Roos and Van Weerden set out on their own to find a new place that was more suitable and found it at an unnamed parking space next to the IJtunnel route on Hagedoornplein.

facts.text: Dutch volunteers fought in the Spanish Civil War between 1936 and 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

facts.text: The monument honors Dutch men and women who died fighting fascism abroad.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

facts.text: Three text columns display the message in two languages: Dutch and Spanish.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

features.opening: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

features.name: Amsterdam Tulip Museum

facts.text: Three Dutch bulbmen founded the Amsterdam Tulip Museum, including a US distributor and a European supplier.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was started by three Dutch bulbsmen. One of the museum's founders is a wholesale flowerbulb distributor in the United States, Colorblends Bridgeport. One of the other founders is Fluwel, a European bulb supplier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was started by three Dutch bulbsmen. One of the museum's founders is a wholesale flowerbulb distributor in the United States, Colorblends Bridgeport. One of the other founders is Fluwel, a European bulb supplier.

facts.text: Exhibits trace tulips from the Himalayas to the court of Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent.
facts.sourceQuote: It has 2,200 sq ft (200 m2) of floor space and the exhibits in the museum trace the history of the tulip from its origins in the Himalayas to its arrival in the court of the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent (1494-1566).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has 2,200 sq ft (200 m2) of floor space and the exhibits in the museum trace the history of the tulip from its origins in the Himalayas to its arrival in the court of the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent (1494-1566).

facts.text: Visitors can buy Dutch flower bulbs directly from the museum shop.
facts.sourceQuote: The Tulip Museum shop sells Dutch flower bulbs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Tulip Museum shop sells Dutch flower bulbs.

features.opening: Amsterdam Tulip Museum (2004) ATM is a small museum in Amsterdam.

features.name: Royal Palace

facts.text: The yellowish sandstone has darkened considerably over time.
facts.sourceQuote: The sandstone of yellowish hue has darkened considerably in the course of time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sandstone of yellowish hue has darkened considerably in the course of time.

facts.text: Designed originally as a city hall, it lacks the grand entrance common to most royal palaces.
facts.sourceQuote: As the building was designed as a city hall, it lacks a grand entrance, which is a rather common feature of most royal palaces.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As the building was designed as a city hall, it lacks a grand entrance, which is a rather common feature of most royal palaces.

facts.text: Originally built as a city hall, it became a royal palace in 1808 under Napoleon.
facts.sourceQuote: The palace was originally built in the mid-seventeenth century as the new city hall for the city of Amsterdam, and only became a royal palace in 1808 when the Netherlands were part of the First French Republic and First Empire under Napoleon Bonaparte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was originally built in the mid-seventeenth century as the new city hall for the city of Amsterdam, and only became a royal palace in 1808 when the Netherlands were part of the First French Republic and First Empire under Napoleon Bonaparte.

features.opening: The Royal Palace of Amsterdam in Amsterdam (Dutch: Koninklijk Paleis van Amsterdam or Paleis op de Dam) is one of three palaces in the Netherlands which are at…

features.name: Sloterkerk

facts.text: The second Sloterkerk was largely destroyed by the Gueux in 1573 during the Siege of Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuote: De tweede Sloterkerk werd in 1573 door de Geuzen grotendeels werd verwoest tijdens het Beleg van Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The second Sloterkerk was largely destroyed by the Gueux in 1573 during the Siege of Haarlem.

facts.text: A large clock cast in 1516 by brothers Willem and Jaspar Moer remains inside the tower.
facts.sourceQuote: De grote klok dateert uit 1516 en is gegoten door de gebroeders klokgieters Willem en Jaspar Moer (die ook verantwoordelijk waren voor de grootste klok in de Amsterdamse Zuiderkerkstoren).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The large clock dates back to 1516 and was cast by the clockmakers brothers Willem and Jaspar Moer (who were also responsible for the largest clock in the Amsterdam Zuiderkerkstoren).

facts.text: During a 1960 restoration, the entire tower was demolished and subsequently rebuilt.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de restauratie van 1960 is de toren afgebroken en herbouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the 1960 restoration, the tower was demolished and rebuilt.

facts.text: Falling debris during a 1964 tower restoration damaged the organ.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de restauratie van de kerktoren in 1964 is, door vallend puin, het orgel beschadigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the restoration of the church tower in 1964, the organ was damaged by falling debris.

facts.text: Hermanus Knipscheer II constructed the original instrument in 1851.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is in 1851 gebouwd door Hermanus Knipscheer (II) .
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was built in 1851 by Hermanus Knipscheer (II).

facts.text: The manual includes a Cornet V forte stop and a Mixture III-V forte.
facts.sourceQuote: Dispositie: Manuaal: Prestant 8', Bourdon 8', Gemshoorn 8', Viool à di Gamba 8', Octaaf 4', Octaaf 2', Cornet V sterk (discant), Mixtuur III-V sterk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instrumentation: Manual: Prestant 8', Bourdon 8', Gemshoorn 8', Violin à di Gamba 8', Octave 4', Octave 2', Cornet V forte (discant), Mixture III-V forte.

features.opening: The Sloterkerk is a Protestant church in Sloten, North Holland.

features.name: Gemeenlandshuis

facts.text: Carpenter master Cornelis van der Does designed this meeting location for dyke monitoring.
facts.sourceQuote: Het rechthoekige vrijstaande gebouw werd aan de zeedijk opgetrokken naar ontwerp van timmermansbaas Cornelis van der Does en opgeleverd in 1727, eigenlijk als vergaderlocatie en uitvalsbasis bij dijkbewaking.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rectangular detached building was built on the seafront according to the design of carpenter master Cornelis van der Does and completed in 1727, actually as a meeting location and base for dyke monitoring.

facts.text: A chronogram on the entrance translates to securing lands by taming the Batavian Sea.
facts.sourceQuote: De ingang aan de dijk wordt benadrukt door middel van een chronogram. Het vermeldt Hic de freti batavi furore arcendo agris tuendis agitur, te lezen als Hier wordt gehandeld over het beveiligen van de landerijen door het temmen van de Bataafse Zee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The entrance at the dike is emphasized by means of a chronogram. It mentions Hic de freti batavi furore arcendo agris tuendis agitur, read as Here is talk about securing the lands by taming the Batavian Sea.

features.opening: The Gemeenlandshuis of Diemen stands at Diemerzeedijk 27 in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: Sint Olofskapel

facts.text: Sint Olofskapel honors Olaf II, the Norwegian king and patron saint of sailors.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is gewijd aan Sint-Olof (Olaf II), de patroonheilige der zeevaarders, die tevens koning van Noorwegen was en het christendom in dat land had verspreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is dedicated to Sint-Olof (Olaf II), the patron saint of sailors, who was also king of Norway and had spread Christianity in that country.

facts.text: Poet Vondel celebrated the chapel in a 1655 poem dedicated to the new town hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Niet alleen in de geschiedenisboeken uit de Gouden Eeuw staat dit expliciet vermeld, ook Vondel maakte er gewag van in zijn gedicht voor het nieuwe stadhuis in 1655 (Daer d’Aemstelheer, van outs, de zeekapelle wydde, Ter eere van Godts Helt, Sint Olof, die zijn’ troon in ’t Noorden had gebouwt, en wien de martelkroon met recht wert toegekeurt).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is explicitly mentioned not only in the history books of the Golden Age, but Vondel also made mention of it in his poem for the new town hall in 1655 (Daer d'Aemstelheer, van outs, de zeekapelle wydde, Ter eere van Godts Helt, Sint Olof, die zijn' troon in 't Noorden had gebouwd, en wien de martelkroon met recht waard toegekeurd).

facts.text: Merchants used the empty chapel for markets starting in 1586 after the 1578 Alteration.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de Alteratie (omwenteling) van Amsterdam, in 1578, stond het gebouw een tijd leeg. Vanaf 1586 mochten kooplieden ervan gebruikmaken om beurs te houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Alteration (revolution) of Amsterdam, in 1578, the building stood empty for a while. From 1586, merchants were allowed to use it to hold markets.

facts.text: The municipality bought the ruin in 1991 for a symbolic gold coin.
facts.sourceQuote: Redding kwam in 1991 toen de gemeente de kapel kocht voor een symbolische gulden en het in erfpacht met restauratieverplichting aan de Stichting Restauratie Monumenten gaf, die op haar beurt een gebruiksovereenstemming na voltooiing sloot met het Barbizonhotel van de NH Hotel Group.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Rescue came in 1991 when the municipality bought the chapel for a symbolic gold and gave it on lease with a restoration obligation to the Foundation for the Restoration of Monuments, which in turn concluded a use agreement after completion with the Barbizonhotel of the NH Hotel Group.

facts.text: Architect Boudewijn de Court Onderwater died during the restoration work.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de restauratie overleed een van de architecten: Boudewijn de Court Onderwater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the restoration, one of the architects died: Boudewijn de Court Onderwater.

features.opening: The Sint-Olofkapel, or Oudezijds Kapel, is a building in the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

features.name: H'ART Museum

facts.text: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev helped open the museum alongside Dutch Queen Beatrix in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: On 20 June 2009, the museum was opened by Dutch Queen Beatrix and Russian president Dmitry Medvedev.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 20 June 2009, the museum was opened by Dutch Queen Beatrix and Russian president Dmitry Medvedev.

features.opening: H'ART Museum is an art museum located on the banks of the Amstel river in Amsterdam.

features.name: Shadow quay

facts.text: Twelve local residents initiated the monument after discovering plaques for the murdered Kok family in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: De oprichting van het monument was een initiatief van twaalf bewoners van de Nieuwe Keizersgracht. Aanleiding was de onthulling in 2009 van enkele plaquettes op nummer 24 ter herdenking van leden van de vermoorde familie Kok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The establishment of the monument was an initiative of twelve residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. The reason was the revelation in 2009 of several plaques on number 24 in memory of members of the murdered Kok family.

facts.text: A sign on house number 58 specifically references the Jewish Council that coordinated the deportations.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het bordje van huisnummer 58 staat een verwijzing naar de Joodse Raad, van waaruit de deportaties gecoördineerd werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the signboard of house number 58 there is a reference to the Jewish Council, from which the deportations were coordinated.

facts.text: Shadow quay honors two hundred Jewish residents murdered in World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De Schaduwkade is een monument voor tweehonderd Joodse bewoners van de Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog vermoord zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Schaduwkade is a monument to two hundred Jewish residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam who were murdered in World War II.

features.opening: De Schaduwkade is a monument to two hundred Jewish residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam who were murdered in the Second World War.

features.name: Huis van de wijk Lydia

facts.text: The Amsterdam chess club Caïssa maintains its dedicated playing room within the complex.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amsterdamse schaakvereniging Caïssa heeft haar speellokaal in Huize Lydia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam chess club Caïssa has its playing room in Huize Lydia.

facts.text: Jan Boterenbrood designed the U-shaped structure in the Amsterdam School style.
facts.sourceQuote: Het U-vormige gebouw is ontworpen door architect Jan Boterenbrood en gebouwd in de stijl van de Amsterdamse school.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The U-shaped building was designed by architect Jan Boterenbrood and built in the style of the Amsterdam School.

features.opening: Huize Lydia or Buurthuis Lydia is a multifunctional center located at the corner of Roelof Hartplein, Joh.

features.name: Olympiahuis

facts.text: Architect Jan Wils designed both this structure and the adjacent Olympic Stadium.
facts.sourceQuote: Net als het Olympisch Stadion is het ontworpen door architect Jan Wils.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Like the Olympic Stadium, it was designed by architect Jan Wils.

facts.text: In 2003, the building was physically moved a few meters to make way for new housing.
facts.sourceQuote: In verband met nieuwbouw van woningen in de omgeving werd het huisje in 2003 enige meters verplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the construction of new houses in the area, the cottage was moved a few meters in 2003.

facts.text: Visitors could get their mail stamped with a unique Olympic mark at this temporary location.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze werden in het tijdelijke postkantoor op het Olympisch terrein afgestempeld met een speciaal stempel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These were stamped with a special stamp at the temporary post office on the Olympic grounds.

features.opening: The Olympic House (the house on Stadionplein nr. 18), also known as the Gatekeeper's House, or Northern Service House, is a former gatekeeper's house on the…

features.name: Church of England

facts.text: The interior expanded in 1827 when the ceiling was raised after integrating a former meeting room.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1827 werd het kerkinterieur uitgebreid door de vergaderkamer in de kerkruimte te integreren. Ook het plafond werd verhoogd; het voormalige Zijdewindhuis gebruikte tot die tijd de ruimte boven de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1827, the church interior was expanded by integrating the meeting room into the church space. The ceiling was also raised; the former Zijdewindhuis used the space above the church until then.

facts.text: Before becoming an Anglican church, this location functioned as a linen hall.
facts.sourceQuote: De Christ Church in Amsterdam is een tot Anglicaanse kerk omgebouwde voormalige lakenhal aan de Groenburgwal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Christ Church in Amsterdam is a former linen hall converted into an Anglican church on the Groenburgwal.

features.opening: Christ Church in Amsterdam is a former cloth hall on the Groenburgwal converted into an Anglican church.

features.name: Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten

facts.text: Jan Willem Pieneman served as the first director before becoming Rijksmuseum director in 1844.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste directeur van de Koninklijke Akademie was Jan Willem Pieneman, die later in 1844 directeur van het Rijksmuseum zou worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first director of the Koninklijke Akademie was Jan Willem Pieneman, who later became director of the Rijksmuseum in 1844.

features.opening: The Royal Academy of Fine Arts (also Royal Academy of Fine Arts) in Amsterdam was the highest art training institution in the Kingdom of the Netherlands from…

features.name: Bellevue

facts.text: Writer Jacob van Lennep served as the first president of Sociëteit Bellevue.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste voorzitter van Sociëteit Bellevue was de schrijver Jacob van Lennep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first president of Sociëteit Bellevue was the writer Jacob van Lennep.

facts.text: Max Euwe became world chess champion here after accepting a draw offer from Alexander Alekhine.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 15 december 1935 vond de laatste partij van het Wereldkampioenschap schaken 1935 plaats in Theater Bellevue. Aleksandr Aljechin bood bij de 40e zet remise aan. Max Euwe stond weliswaar 2 pionnen voor in een gewonnen stelling, maar Euwe accepteerde het aanbod en kroonde zich daarmee tot de nieuwe wereldkampioen schaken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 15, 1935, the last round of the 1935 World Chess Championship took place in Theater Bellevue. Aleksandr Aljechin offered a draw at the 40th move. Max Euwe was indeed 2 pawns ahead in a won position, but Euwe accepted the offer and thus crowned himself the new world chess champion.

facts.text: During World War I, the army used the venue as a transit barracks for one year.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij het uitbreken van de Eerste Wereldoorlog eiste het leger in 1914 Bellevue gedurende een jaar op als doorgangskazerne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When World War I broke out in 1914, the army demanded Bellevue as a transit barracks for a year.

facts.text: Lunch shows have been produced for the Paloni Hall for over 25 years.
facts.sourceQuote: Speciaal voor de Paloni Zaal worden al ruim 25 jaar lunchvoorstellingen geproduceerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Lunch shows have been produced specially for the Paloni Hall for more than 25 years.

facts.text: The theater organizes an annual Pop Arts Festival featuring puppet and object theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Samen met Ostade A'dam en Jeugdtheater De Krakeling organiseert Theater Bellevue het jaarlijkse Pop Arts Festival, een festival met een programmering van poppen- en objecttheater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with Ostade A'dam and Youth Theater De Krakeling, Theater Bellevue organizes the annual Pop Arts Festival, a festival with a programming of puppet and object theater.

facts.text: Regular programs include a cabaret try-out stage, a talk show, and improvisational theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Theater Bellevue brengt daarnaast een aantal regelmatig terugkerende programma's, zoals BIES (het cabaret try-out podium in Klein Bellevue), Fluisterende olifanten (talkshow door Theodor Holman en Gijs Groenteman in Klein Bellevue), Het Nieuwe Lied (Nederlandstalig muziekprogramma in Klein Bellevue), Nachtgasten (improvisatietheater in de Grote Zaal) en Tekstsmederij (nieuwe Nederlandse toneelteksten in de Grote Zaal).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Theater Bellevue also brings a number of regularly recurring programs, such as BIES (the cabaret try-out stage in Klein Bellevue), Whispering Elephants (talk show by Theodor Holman and Gijs Groenteman in Klein Bellevue), Het Nieuwe Lied (Dutch music program in Klein Bellevue), Nachtgasten (improvisational theater in the Great Hall) and Tekstsmederij (new Dutch stage texts in the Great Hall).

features.opening: Theater Bellevue is a theater with three rooms on Leidsekade in Amsterdam.

features.name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center

facts.text: The former Sint-Lucaskerk was declared a municipal monument in November 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: Naar aanleiding van een aanvraag van Heemschut werd het gebouw op 22 november 2017 gemeentelijk monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Following a request from Heemschut, the building was declared a municipal monument on November 22, 2017.

facts.text: Construction on the final church building began on November 4, 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 4 november 1963 startte de bouw van het definitieve kerkgebouw van architect Th.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On November 4, 1963, construction began on the final church building by architect Th.

facts.text: Seats were arranged in three groups on three sides of the altar to encourage participation.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de inrichting van de kerk werd rekening gehouden met de nieuwe liturgie waarin de gemeenschap geen toeschouwer is van de liturgie, maar deelnemer. De zitplaatsen werden verdeeld in drie groepen die aan drie zijden van het altaar werden geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When designing the church, consideration was given to the new liturgy in which the community is not a spectator of the liturgy, but a participant. The seats were divided into three groups that were placed on three sides of the altar.

facts.text: The complex was sold to SGI Netherlands in March 2020 for prayer and cultural activities.
facts.sourceQuote: In maart 2020 is het complex verkocht aan de boeddhistische organisatie SGI Nederland, die het onder de benaming 'Ikeda Centrum voor Vriendschap en Vrede' gebruikt voor gebed en culturele activiteiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2020, the complex was sold to the Buddhist organization SGI Netherlands, which uses it under the name 'Ikeda Center for Friendship and Peace' for prayer and cultural activities.

facts.text: A formal online presentation occurred on May 2, 2021, following renovations during the pandemic.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 2 mei 2021 is het centrum na verbouwing formeel, in verband met de COVID-19-pandemie, online gepresenteerd aan de leden van de organisatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 2, 2021, the center was formally presented online to the members of the organization after renovation, in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic.

facts.text: The entire complex received its physical inauguration in June 2022 after an online parish opening.
facts.sourceQuote: De opening van het parrochiegedeelte is online gehouden op 10 oktober 2021, terwijl het gehele complex fysiek ingehuldigd is in juni 2022.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The opening of the parish section was held online on October 10, 2021, while the entire complex was physically inaugurated in June 2022.

features.opening: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church building of the Roman Catholic Sint-Lucas parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp.

features.name: Mahatma Gandhi

facts.text: Winston Churchill once called Mahatma Gandhi a half-naked fakir yet sent condolences after his death.
facts.sourceQuote: Wrang detail bij de plaats van het beeld is dat Winston Churchill Gandhi ooit eens "halfnaakte fakir" had genoemd; bij het overlijden van Gandhi stuurde hij echter wel een condoleance.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A strange detail about the location of the statue is that Winston Churchill once called Gandhi a "half-naked fakir"; however, when Gandhi died, he did send a condolence.

facts.text: Vandals have repeatedly broken and removed the statue's fragile walking stick and glasses.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld kent in de wandelstaf en bril twee fragiele onderdelen, die keer op keer door vandalen afgebroken en verwijderd werden en worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image has two fragile parts in the walking stick and glasses, which have been broken and removed by vandals again and again and continue to be.

features.opening: Mahatma Gandhi is a work of art in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Groote Museum

facts.text: The space originally housed the Zoological Museum Amsterdam before closing in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk fungeerde deze ruimte als het Zoölogisch Museum Amsterdam, waar natuurhistorische objecten werden tentoongesteld. In 1947 werd het museum gesloten en de collectie overgebracht naar Naturalis in Leiden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, this space served as the Zoological Museum Amsterdam, where natural history objects were exhibited. In 1947 the museum was closed and the collection transferred to Naturalis in Leiden.

facts.text: Queen Máxima officially reopened the museum on May 10, 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 mei 2022 werd het museum officieel heropend door Koningin Máxima.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 10, 2022, the museum was officially reopened by Queen Máxima.

facts.text: A renewed concept now invites visitors to explore relationships between all forms of life.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit markeerde de terugkeer van het museum in het gerestaureerde hoofdgebouw, met een vernieuwd concept dat bezoekers uitnodigt om de relatie tussen alle vormen van leven op aarde te verkennen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This marked the return of the museum to the restored main building, with a renewed concept that invites visitors to explore the relationship between all forms of life on earth.

facts.text: Visitors can explore the museum on the first floor without needing to enter the adjacent zoo.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is gevestigd op de eerste verdieping van het voormalig hoofdgebouw van Artis en wordt beheerd door Artis, maar is onafhankelijk van de dierentuin te bezoeken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is located on the first floor of the former main building of Artis and is managed by Artis, but can be visited independently of the zoo.

facts.text: The collection examines the complex connections between humans, animals, plants, microbes, and the earth.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Groote Museum is een museum aan de Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam dat de samenhang tussen mens, dier, plant, microbe en de aarde onderzoekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Groote Museum is a museum on Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam that explores the relationship between man, animal, plant, microbe and the earth.

features.opening: The Groote Museum is a museum on the Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam exploring the connections between people, animals, plants, microbes and the earth.

features.name: Maarten Lutherkerk

facts.text: Architect F Jantzen designed this church for the Evangelical-Lutheran community.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit kerkgebouw is voor de Evangelisch-Lutherse kerk in de bouwstijl van de Amsterdamse School ontworpen door de architect F Jantzen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This church building was designed for the Evangelical-Lutheran church in the style of the Amsterdam School by the architect F Jantzen.

features.opening: The Maarten Luther Kerk is a church building in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Zeeburgia

facts.text: Zeeburgia lost 6–1 to Ajax in the first round of the 1956–57 National Dutch Cup.
facts.sourceQuote: On 26 August 1956 it lost 6–1 to Ajax in the first round of the 1956–57 National Dutch Cup.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 26 August 1956 it lost 6–1 to Ajax in the first round of the 1956–57 National Dutch Cup.

facts.text: The club's male first squad competed in the Hoofdklasse from 1980 through 1984.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1980 through 1984, the male first squad played in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1980 through 1984, the male first squad played in the Hoofdklasse.

facts.text: Many Dutch professional footballers began their careers in Zeeburgia's youth teams.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been dubbed "royal supplier" as many Dutch professional footballers started at Zeeburgia youth teams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been dubbed "royal supplier" as many Dutch professional footballers started at Zeeburgia youth teams.

features.opening: The Amsterdamse Voetbalvereniging Zeeburgia is a football club from Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Vincentiuskerk

facts.text: The Vincentiuskerk honors patron saint Vincentius a Paulo.
facts.sourceQuote: De Sint-Vincentiuskerk, vernoemd naar beschermheilige Vincentius a Paulo, was een katholiek kerkgebouw in Amsterdam Oud-West.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West.

features.opening: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West.

features.name: Torture Museum

facts.text: Many exhibits like iron maidens are literary inventions from the 19th century rather than real historical tools.
facts.sourceQuote: Like many other "Torture Museums", it exhibits fake items, devices which were seldom or never used in real history, particularly in the "Middle Age", such as Scold's bridle, iron maidens (a literary invention of the 19th century) or "breast rippers" which may have been used only in the ancient Roman empire.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Like many other "Torture Museums", it exhibits fake items, devices which were seldom or never used in real history, particularly in the "Middle Age", such as Scold's bridle, iron maidens (a literary invention of the 19th century) or "breast rippers" which may have been used only in the ancient Roman empire.

facts.text: A Daily Telegraph report called this location one of the world's most unusual museums.
facts.sourceQuote: The Daily Telegraph noted the museum as "one of the world's most unusual museums." The museum is popular among tourists.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Daily Telegraph noted the museum as "one of the world's most unusual museums." The museum is popular among tourists.

facts.text: Narrow, dimly lit rooms each display one or two torture devices.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum consists of narrow and dimly lit rooms. Each room features one or two torture devices.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum consists of narrow and dimly lit rooms. Each room features one or two torture devices.

facts.text: Enlarged images show devices in use alongside descriptions of their application.
facts.sourceQuote: Each device is accompanied with an enlarged image from a book or article featuring that device in use and a description of that device and how and why it was used.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Each device is accompanied with an enlarged image from a book or article featuring that device in use and a description of that device and how and why it was used.

facts.text: Explanatory articles are available in six languages including Italian and Spanish.
facts.sourceQuote: The articles are translated into English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The articles are translated into English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

features.opening: The Torture Museum, Amsterdam is located in Amsterdam, near the Bloemenmarkt overlooking the Singel.

features.name: Tobacco Theater

facts.text: The Tobacco Theater was originally a tobacco factory where plants grew under slanted windows.
facts.sourceQuote: Het pand was oorspronkelijk, evenals andere gebouwen in de Nes zoals het Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak en Frascati, een tabaksfabriek. Door de scheef opgestelde raampartijen viel er veel licht in het gebouw wat de groei van de tabaksplanten bevorderde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was originally, as well as other buildings in the Nes such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, a tobacco factory. The slanted window panes allowed a lot of light into the building, which promoted the growth of the tobacco plants.

facts.text: Tobacco auctions were held in north-facing rooms to let buyers inspect leaf quality by light.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook was er in de panden in het begin van de twintigste eeuw de tabaksveiling gevestigd in een van de grote ruimtes waarvan de ramen op het noorden gericht zijn zodat de potentiële kopers de beste lichtval hadden om de kwaliteit van de tabaksbladeren te kunnen beoordelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of the twentieth century, there was also the tobacco auction held in one of the large rooms in the buildings, whose windows faced north so that potential buyers had the best lighting to assess the quality of the tobacco leaves.

facts.text: After the industry vanished, auctioneer Mak van Waay used the site until the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadat de tabaksindustrie verdween vestigde het veilingbedrijf Mak van Waay zich in het pand en organiseerde er veilingen tot in de jaren zestig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the tobacco industry disappeared, the auction company Mak van Waay settled in the building and organized auctions there until the 1960s.

features.opening: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument, located on the "theaterstraat" Nes in Amsterdam (odd house numbers 75 to 87).

features.name: Fort bij Uitermeer

facts.text: The tower featured twelve rooms with ten beds each and three gun ports per room.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de verdieping waren 12 kamers met 10 britsen per kamer. Iedere kamer, ook op de begane grond, had drie schietgaten in de buitenmuur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the floor there were 12 rooms with 10 beds per room. Every room, even on the ground floor, had three gun ports in the outer wall.

facts.text: A cannon depot was added in 1874 to store artillery and ammunition.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1874 werd een kanonremise bijgebouwd. Het gebouw bood ruimte voor de opslag van kanonnen, munitie en de bemanning.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1874, a cannon depot was added. The building provided space for the storage of cannons, ammunition and the crew.

facts.text: The fort was built to block land crossings between the Naardermeer and the Vecht river.
facts.sourceQuote: Het fort had als doel het beschermen van de landdoorgangen tussen het Naardermeer en de Vecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fort's purpose was to protect the land crossings between the Naardermeer and the Vecht.

features.opening: Fort Uitermeer is an old fort that was included in the New Holland Water Line and later the Stelling of Amsterdam.

features.name: Mor Sharbil

facts.text: A new St. Catherine's Church was built in 1954 after the old one was demolished in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1954 verrees op deze plek een nieuwe Sint-Catharinakerk, nadat de oude kerk in 1939 was gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1954, a new St. Catherine's Church was built on this site, after the old church was demolished in 1939.

features.opening: The building Burgemeester Eliasstraat 72-74 in Amsterdam-Slotermeer Amsterdam has been a municipal monument since 2011.

features.name: Stadhuis

facts.text: Architects Jacob Otten Husly and Leendert Viervant the Younger designed this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was designed by the architects Jacob Otten Husly (1738-1796) and his assistant Leendert Viervant the Younger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was designed by the architects Jacob Otten Husly (1738-1796) and his assistant Leendert Viervant the Younger.

facts.text: Construction of the Stadhuis took place between 1772 and 1776.
facts.sourceQuote: They built it during the years 1772-1776.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They built it during the years 1772-1776.

facts.text: The municipal council met here until Weesp joined Amsterdam in March 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: The main body of the municipality, the municipal council, convened in the Raadzaal (Council Hall) until 24 March 2022 when Weesp became part of the municipality of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main body of the municipality, the municipal council, convened in the Raadzaal (Council Hall) until 24 March 2022 when Weesp became part of the municipality of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Weddings and official proceedings still occur in the former Vierschaar and Burgerzaal halls.
facts.sourceQuote: The administrative offices have moved, but the former Vierschaar and Burgerzaal (Civic Hall) are still used for weddings and other official proceedings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The administrative offices have moved, but the former Vierschaar and Burgerzaal (Civic Hall) are still used for weddings and other official proceedings.

facts.text: While offices moved, the rest of the structure now serves as the local museum of Weesp.
facts.sourceQuote: The rest of the building is in use as the local museum of Weesp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rest of the building is in use as the local museum of Weesp.

features.opening: The Weesp City Hall is the former city hall of Weesp, Netherlands.

features.name: Noorderkerk

facts.text: The Noorderkerk served common people while the Westerkerk catered to the middle and upper classes.
facts.sourceQuote: The Noorderkerk became the church for the common people, while the Westerkerk was used mainly by the middle and upper classes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Noorderkerk became the church for the common people, while the Westerkerk was used mainly by the middle and upper classes.

facts.text: Organisers of the 1941 February Strike held illicit meetings on the square around this church.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1941, organisers of the February Strike held illicit public meetings on Noordermarkt, the square around the church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1941, organisers of the February Strike held illicit public meetings on Noordermarkt, the square around the church.

facts.text: Noorderkerk means "northern church" in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: The Noorderkerk (Dutch for "northern church") is a 17th-century Protestant church in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Noorderkerk (Dutch for "northern church") is a 17th-century Protestant church in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

facts.text: Hendrick de Keyser designed the church before his son Pieter finished it.
facts.sourceQuote: The architect was Hendrick de Keyser, who also designed the Zuiderkerk and Westerkerk, among others. After de Keyser's death in 1621, his son Pieter de Keyser took over and oversaw the completion.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Hendrick de Keyser, who also designed the Zuiderkerk and Westerkerk, among others. After de Keyser's death in 1621, his son Pieter de Keyser took over and oversaw the completion.

facts.text: Other Dutch towns like The Hague also have churches named Noorderkerk.
facts.sourceQuote: A number of other towns in the Netherlands also have a Noorderkerk church, including The Hague, Hoorn and Kampen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of other towns in the Netherlands also have a Noorderkerk church, including The Hague, Hoorn and Kampen.

features.opening: The Noorderkerk (Dutch for "northern church") is a 17th-century Protestant church in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Dutch Resistance Museum

facts.text: The Netherlands endured Nazi occupation from May 14, 1940 until May 5, 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: From 14 May 1940 to 5 May 1945, the Netherlands were occupied by Nazi Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 14 May 1940 to 5 May 1945, the Netherlands were occupied by Nazi Germany.

facts.text: Exhibits use old posters, films, and sounds to recreate occupied Amsterdam streets.
facts.sourceQuote: Permanent exhibits of the museum recreate the atmosphere of the streets of Amsterdam during the German occupation of World War II. Big photographs, old posters, objects, films and sounds from that time, help to recreate the scene.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Permanent exhibits of the museum recreate the atmosphere of the streets of Amsterdam during the German occupation of World War II. Big photographs, old posters, objects, films and sounds from that time, help to recreate the scene.

facts.text: The Jewish singing society Oefening Baart Kunst built this structure in 1876.
facts.sourceQuote: The building bearing the Star of David and the name of Petrus Plancius (1550-1622), the Renaissance Amsterdam clergyman and geographer, was built in 1876 by the Jewish singing society Oefening Baart Kunst (practice makes perfect).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building bearing the Star of David and the name of Petrus Plancius (1550-1622), the Renaissance Amsterdam clergyman and geographer, was built in 1876 by the Jewish singing society Oefening Baart Kunst (practice makes perfect).

facts.text: Since 1999, a renovated version of this building has housed the Dutch Resistance Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1999, after its renovation, it is the seat of the Verzetsmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1999, after its renovation, it is the seat of the Verzetsmuseum.

features.opening: The Resistance Museum (Dutch: Verzetsmuseum) is a museum located in the Plantage neighbourhood in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Anton de Kom

facts.text: Residents and a jury selected Van Loon's design in 2005 after an exhibition of proposals.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze waren te zien in een tentoonstelling eind 2004. In 2005 kozen de bewoners en een jury voor het ontwerp van Van Loon, leidend tot een beeld dat niet alleen een fysieke gelijkenis moest hebben, maar ook verbeelding moest geven aan zijn karakter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They were seen in an exhibition at the end of 2004. In 2005, the residents and a jury chose Van Loon's design, leading to an image that not only had to have a physical resemblance, but also had to give imagination to his character.

facts.text: The De Kom family criticized the statue, telling opponents to discard that slave mentality.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de familie De Kom kwam met de opmerking: "Schud die slavenmentaliteit af".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The De Kom family also made the remark: "Get rid of that slave mentality".

facts.text: An internet vote secretly held during creation chose a different design than the official committee's winner.
facts.sourceQuote: Zonder medeweten van het organisatiecomité werd echter ook een internetstemming gehouden, waarbij Van Loon won.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, without the knowledge of the organizing committee, an internet vote was also held, in which Van Loon won.

facts.text: Artoteek Zuidoost supported the image by highlighting its pride and vulnerability despite the nudity.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder de voorstanders van het beeld was Artoteek Zuidoost/Centrum Beeldende Kunst Zuidoost, die bij monde van haar woordvoerster wees op de trots en kwetsbaarheid die het beeld uitstraalt en ook op de uitgebreide stemming.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the supporters of the image was Artoteek Zuidoost/Centrum Beeldende Kunst Zuidoost, which, through its spokeswoman, pointed out the pride and vulnerability that the image exudes and also on the extensive mood.

features.opening: The Monument voor Anton de Kom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Christelijke Gereformeerde Kerk - Amstelkerk

facts.text: Christelijke Gereformeerde Kerk - Amstelkerk was originally built as a wooden emergency church in 1662.
facts.sourceQuote: The church was designed by Daniël Stalpaert and was originally intended as a wooden emergency church, erected to provide for church services in the fourth Golden Age extension of Amsterdam laid out in 1662, but it was never replaced by a more permanent building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was designed by Daniël Stalpaert and was originally intended as a wooden emergency church, erected to provide for church services in the fourth Golden Age extension of Amsterdam laid out in 1662, but it was never replaced by a more permanent building.

facts.text: Hendrik Springer replaced the modest interior with a neogothic design in 1842.
facts.sourceQuote: The interior originally had a very modest appearance, but was replaced by a neogothic design by Hendrik Springer in 1842.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The interior originally had a very modest appearance, but was replaced by a neogothic design by Hendrik Springer in 1842.

facts.text: Plans to build the Dutch Mint next to Christelijke Gereformeerde Kerk - Amstelkerk were never executed.
facts.sourceQuote: In the early 19th century, plans were drawn up, but never executed, to build the Dutch Mint in the square next to church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the early 19th century, plans were drawn up, but never executed, to build the Dutch Mint in the square next to church.

features.opening: The Amstelkerk (English: Amstel Church) is a Reformed church building in central Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Uilenburger Synagoge

facts.text: Beyond religious services, the venue regularly hosts music performances and other gatherings.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast vinden er muziekuitvoeringen en andere bijeenkomsten plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, music performances and other gatherings take place.

facts.text: For centuries, the Uilenburger Synagoge was accessible only via corridors and stairs to rear buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was eeuwenlang alleen bereikbaar via gangen (stegen naar achterliggende gebouwen).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For centuries it was only accessible via corridors (stairs to rear buildings).

facts.text: World War II brought a dark period where the community was largely killed and the synagogue plundered.
facts.sourceQuote: Een zwarte periode volgde in de Tweede Wereldoorlog waarbij de bijbehorende Joodse gemeenschap grotendeels tijdens de Holocaust werd omgebracht en de synagoge zelf geplunderd werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A dark period followed in World War II during which the associated Jewish community was largely killed during the Holocaust and the synagogue itself was plundered.

facts.text: Uilenburgerstraat merged with Batavierstraat to become Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: De Uilenburgerstraat werd samengetrokken met de Batavierstraat en kreeg de naam Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Uilenburgerstraat was combined with the Batavierstraat and was renamed Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat.

features.opening: The Uilenburger Synagoge or Uilenburgersjoel is a synagogue on the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat on the island of Uilenburg in the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter.

features.name: Chinatown

facts.text: Yong Sau Dun became the first Chinese entrepreneur to settle on Zeedijk in 1959 with his still existing toko.
facts.sourceQuote: Yong Sau Dun was in 1959 de eerste Chinese ondernemer die zich, met zijn nog altijd bestaande toko Dun Yong, op de Zeedijk vestigde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Yong Sau Dun was the first Chinese entrepreneur to settle in the Zeedijk in 1959, with his still existing toko Dun Yong.

facts.text: Dragon dances, lion dances, and fireworks annually celebrate New Year's Day and Chinese New Year in this neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuote: Nieuwjaarsdag en Chinees nieuwjaar wordt in deze buurt jaarlijks gevierd met drakendans, leeuwendans en knalvuurwerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: New Year's Day and Chinese New Year are celebrated in this neighborhood annually with dragon dance, lion dance and fireworks.

features.opening: Chinatown is the Chinese quarter of Amsterdam.

features.name: AMHC Westerpark

facts.text: The club maintains five fields at Spieringhorn sports park.
facts.sourceQuote: AMHC Westerpark heeft vijf eigen velden op sportpark Spieringhorn, en sinds 2016 een eigen clubhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AMHC Westerpark has five own fields on sports park Spieringhorn, and since 2016 a own clubhouse.

facts.text: AMHC Westerpark opened its own clubhouse in 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: AMHC Westerpark heeft vijf eigen velden op sportpark Spieringhorn, en sinds 2016 een eigen clubhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AMHC Westerpark has five own fields on sports park Spieringhorn, and since 2016 a own clubhouse.

features.opening: Amsterdamsche Mixed Hockey Club Westerpark is a hockey club from Amsterdam in the West district.

features.name: Museum Weesp

facts.text: Iron Age settlement finds from Aetsveld are displayed here.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn vondsten te zien die werden aangetroffen bij het onderzoek van de ijzertijdnederzettingen bij Aetsveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are finds to be seen that were found during the research of the Iron Age settlements near Aetsveld.

facts.text: A 13th or 14th century liturgical chalice used by priests is a top piece.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot de topstukken behoort een liturgische schenkkan uit de 13e of 14e eeuw, een kannetje dat priesters gebruikten bij het toedienen van sacramenten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The top pieces include a liturgical chalice from the 13th or 14th century, a chalice that priests used when administering sacraments.

facts.text: A porcelain donation from Baron F. van Heeckeren van Waliën's estate transformed it into a museum in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1974 werd dit tot museum na een schenking porselein, die werd verkregen uit de nalatenschap van Baron F. van Heeckeren van Waliën.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1974, this was turned into a museum after a donation of porcelain, which was obtained from the estate of Baron F. van Heeckeren van Waliën.

features.opening: Museum Weesp is located on the second floor of the Weesp Town Hall in the Dutch province of North Holland.

features.name: Haarlemmerpoort

facts.text: The fourth gate was built in 1615 on the newly constructed Haarlemmerplein.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de Derde Uitleg, de uitbreiding tot de Singelgracht vanaf 1610, verrees er in 1615 een nieuwe, vierde, Haarlemmerpoort op het nieuw aangelegde Haarlemmerplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the Third Explanation, the extension to the Singelgracht from 1610, a new, fourth, Haarlemmerpoort was built in 1615 on the newly constructed Haarlemmerplein.

facts.text: The first gate stood near Haringpakkerssteeg while the second sat at the Old Haarlemmersluis.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste 'Haarlemmerpoort' stond in de 14e eeuw ter hoogte van de Haringpakkerssteeg. Omstreeks 1397 verrees de tweede Haarlemmerpoort, deze stond op de (Oude) Haarlemmersluis in de Nieuwendijk (hier is nu de Martelaarsgracht).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first 'Haarlemmerpoort' stood in the 14th century near the Haringpakkerssteeg. Around 1397, the second Haarlemmerpoort was built, it stood at the (Old) Haarlemmersluis in the Nieuwendijk (this is now the Martelaarsgracht).

facts.text: Eight Corinthian columns made of Bentheimer sandstone line the passageway.
facts.sourceQuote: In de doorgang zijn acht Korinthische zuilen geplaatst, gemaakt van Bentheimer zandsteen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eight Corinthian columns are placed in the passageway, made of Bentheimer sandstone.

features.opening: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called Willemspoort but is never called that in the city.

features.name: Rijksmuseum

facts.text: Napoleon's stolen collection returned in 1815 but stayed in The Hague instead of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Napoleon had carried off the stadholder's collection to Paris; the paintings were returned to The Netherlands in 1815 but housed in the Mauritshuis in The Hague rather than the Rijksmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Napoleon had carried off the stadholder's collection to Paris; the paintings were returned to The Netherlands in 1815 but housed in the Mauritshuis in The Hague rather than the Rijksmuseum.

facts.text: In 2019, the museum displayed all its Rembrandt works together for the first time.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2019, to mark the 350th anniversary of the artist's death, the museum mounted an exhibition of all the works by Rembrandt in its collection. Consisting of 22 paintings, 60 drawings and over 300 prints, this was the first time they had all been exhibited together.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2019, to mark the 350th anniversary of the artist's death, the museum mounted an exhibition of all the works by Rembrandt in its collection. Consisting of 22 paintings, 60 drawings and over 300 prints, this was the first time they had all been exhibited together.

facts.text: The exhibition included over 300 prints alongside 22 paintings and 60 drawings.
facts.sourceQuote: Consisting of 22 paintings, 60 drawings and over 300 prints, this was the first time they had all been exhibited together.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Consisting of 22 paintings, 60 drawings and over 300 prints, this was the first time they had all been exhibited together.

facts.text: Marten Soolmans and Oopjen Coppit marriage portraits were principal features of the show.
facts.sourceQuote: Principal features were the marriage portraits of Marten Soolmans and Oopjen Coppit along with the presentation of the Night Watch immediately before its planned restoration.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Principal features were the marriage portraits of Marten Soolmans and Oopjen Coppit along with the presentation of the Night Watch immediately before its planned restoration.

features.opening: The Rijksmuseum (Dutch: [ˈrɛiksmyˌzeːjʏm] ) is the national museum of the Netherlands dedicated to Dutch arts and history, located at the Museum Square in the…

features.name: Rozenoord

facts.text: Rozenoord (rose garden) was the name of a teahouse established in the 1930s.
facts.sourceQuote: Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord is a World War II memorial in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. 'Fusilladeplaats' might be translated into English as 'firing squad place'. 'Rozenoord' was originally a rose garden, whose name was adopted during the 1930s by a teahouse by the Amsteldijk, a dyke in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord is a World War II memorial in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. 'Fusilladeplaats' might be translated into English as 'firing squad place'. 'Rozenoord' was originally a rose garden, whose name was adopted during the 1930s by a teahouse by the Amsteldijk, a dyke in Amsterdam.

facts.text: German forces executed over 100 Dutch civilians at this site between January and April 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 18 January and 14 April 1945, German occupation forces shot dead more than 100 Dutch civilians at Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord (at least that many have been identified, several of them resistance fighters).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 18 January and 14 April 1945, German occupation forces shot dead more than 100 Dutch civilians at Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord (at least that many have been identified, several of them resistance fighters).

facts.text: Ram Katzir designed a memorial featuring empty chairs on concrete plates for known victims.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2014, Dutch artist and sculptor Ram Katzir designed another memorial (Monument Rozenoord) for Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord. It consists of an arrangement of empty chairs on concrete plates with the names of the known victims.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2014, Dutch artist and sculptor Ram Katzir designed another memorial (Monument Rozenoord) for Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord. It consists of an arrangement of empty chairs on concrete plates with the names of the known victims.

features.opening: Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord is a World War II memorial in the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

features.name: Monument voor gefusilleerde verzetstrijders

facts.text: On October 24, 1944, German occupiers executed 29 prisoners here as reprisal for a resistance attack.
facts.sourceQuote: Op die plek werden op 24 oktober 1944 29 gevangenen uit het Huis van Bewaring aan de Weteringschans door de Duitse bezetter naar deze plek gebracht om vervolgens zonder vorm van proces gefusilleerd te worden. De bezettingsmacht deed dit als represaille voor plaatsgevonden actie van het verzet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On that place, on October 24, 1944, 29 prisoners from the Detention Center at the Weteringschans were brought to this place by the German occupiers to be then executed without any form of trial. The occupying force did this as a reprisal for actions taken by the resistance.

facts.text: The executed victims had no connection to the resistance murder that triggered their execution.
facts.sourceQuote: Het verzet had op 23 oktober 1944 SD-er Herbert Oelenschläger vermoord. De gefusilleerden hadden met die aanslag niets van doen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The resistance had murdered SD member Herbert Oelenschläger on October 23, 1944. The executed had nothing to do with that attack.

facts.text: The sculpture symbolically references the death scene of Jesus flanked by two thieves on Golgotha.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zou terugvoeren op de sterfscène van Jezus aan het kruis, met aan zijn zijde de goede en de slechte moordenaar. Het zou daarbij niet alleen verwijzen naar de gebeurtenis op de Golgotha, maar ook naar verlossing uit de dood in het algemeen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It would return to the death scene of Jesus on the cross, with the good and the bad murderer on his side. It would not only refer to the event on Golgotha, but also to redemption from death in general.

features.opening: The Resistance Monument Apollolaan is a work of art in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: De Nieuwe Stad

facts.text: Originally a Reformed faith center, it was located under the Gliphoeve garage on the Ganzenhoef shopping center.
facts.sourceQuote: De Nieuwe Stad was eerst een gereformeerd geloofscentrum gesitueerd onder garage van Gliphoeve op winkelcentrum Ganzenhoef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Nieuwe Stad was originally a Reformed faith center located under the garage of Gliphoeve on the Ganzenhoef shopping center.

features.opening: Kerkcentrum De Nieuwe Stad is a church in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (Bijlmermeer), built in 1992/1993 and designed by the architects Lafour and Wijk.

features.name: Amsterdam

facts.text: The replica measures 48 meters from bowsprit to mirror and displaces 1,100 tons.
facts.sourceQuote: Scheepsgegevens van de replica: Lengte van de kiel: 42,5 m Lengte van boegspriet tot spiegel: 48 m Breedte: 11,5 m Diepgang: 5,5 m Hoogte: 56 m Waterverplaatsing: 1.100 ton Aantal kanonnen: 16
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Ship details of the replica: Length of the keel: 42.5 m Length of bowsprit to mirror: 48 m Width: 11.5 m Draft: 5.5 m Height: 56 m Displacement: 1,100 tons Number of guns: 16

facts.text: In 1990 the foundation sold the vessel to the Maritime Museum for one guilder.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990 werd de "NV Amsterdam bouwt Oost-Indiëvaarder" door het Stichtingsbestuur "verkocht" aan het Scheepvaartmuseum met het schip als eigendom voor ƒ 1 en trad het stichtingsbestuur af.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, the "NV Amsterdam bouwt Oost-Indiëvaarder" was "sold" by the Foundation Board to the Maritime Museum with the ship as property for ƒ 1 and the Foundation Board resigned.

facts.text: Piet van de Werf resisted extensive financial and legal work required for the project.
facts.sourceQuote: Heel veel werk op het gebied van financiën, vergunningen, contracten, etc. werd verzet door Piet van de Werf, vicevoorzitter, destijds directeur bij ABNAMRO in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A lot of work in the field of finance, permits, contracts, etc. was resisted by Piet van de Werf, vice-chairman, then director at ABNAMRO in Amsterdam.

features.opening: The Amsterdam of 1990 is a replica of the mirror return ship of the same name of the Dutch East India Company (VOC).

features.name: Het Huis met den Hoofden

facts.text: Het Huis met den Hoofden means House with the Heads, referencing six Roman gods on its façade.
facts.sourceQuote: However, the ornaments are said to be images of six Roman gods: Apollo with the laurel wreath (the arts); Ceres with the grain (agriculture); Mercury with the winged helmet (trade); Minerva (wisdom); Bacchus with the grapes (wine); and Diana with the half moon (hunt).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the ornaments are said to be images of six Roman gods: Apollo with the laurel wreath (the arts); Ceres with the grain (agriculture); Mercury with the winged helmet (trade); Minerva (wisdom); Bacchus with the grapes (wine); and Diana with the half moon (hunt).

facts.text: Pieter de Keyser likely executed the Renaissance façade after his father Hendrick died in 1621.
facts.sourceQuote: The renaissance façade is attributed to architect Hendrick de Keyser, but was probably executed and completed by his son Pieter de Keyser, as Hendrick had already died in 1621.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The renaissance façade is attributed to architect Hendrick de Keyser, but was probably executed and completed by his son Pieter de Keyser, as Hendrick had already died in 1621.

facts.text: A local legend claims the heads represent thieves beheaded by a maid rather than Roman deities.
facts.sourceQuote: As for the heads in the façade, there is a legend that they refer to six thieves who had tried to break in the house and were then beheaded by the maid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As for the heads in the façade, there is a legend that they refer to six thieves who had tried to break in the house and were then beheaded by the maid.

facts.text: The house served as the Conservatorium van Amsterdam from 1909 until 1931.
facts.sourceQuote: After a restoration in 1907 by the municipality, it served the Conservatorium van Amsterdam from 1909 to 1931.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After a restoration in 1907 by the municipality, it served the Conservatorium van Amsterdam from 1909 to 1931.

facts.text: In 2006, art collector Joost Ritman purchased the building for his library museum.
facts.sourceQuote: At the end of February 2006 it was announced that the Huis met de Hoofden had been sold to businessman and art collector Joost Ritman. Today the building is home to museum The Embassy of the Free Mind, which comprises part of the Bibliotheca Philosophica Hermetica.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the end of February 2006 it was announced that the Huis met de Hoofden had been sold to businessman and art collector Joost Ritman. Today the building is home to museum The Embassy of the Free Mind, which comprises part of the Bibliotheca Philosophica Hermetica.

facts.text: Anthoni Grill rented the property between 1752 and 1775 before its sale in 1779.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 1752 en 1775 Anthoni Grill rented the house from the inheritants, who sold it in 1779.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1752 en 1775 Anthoni Grill rented the house from the inheritants, who sold it in 1779.

features.opening: The House with the Heads (known as 'Huis met de Hoofden' in Dutch) is a large canal house on the Keizersgracht 123 in Amsterdam, named after the six ornaments…

features.name: Huis De Pinto

facts.text: David de Pinto inherited the house and bought its neighbor in 1686.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1651 they were sold by the Burch heirs to Isaack de Pinto (who died 1681) Inherited by his only son David de Pinto, who bought the neighboring house in 1686 and ordered the double facade designed by Elias Bouman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1651 they were sold by the Burch heirs to Isaack de Pinto (who died 1681) Inherited by his only son David de Pinto, who bought the neighboring house in 1686 and ordered the double facade designed by Elias Bouman.

facts.text: David de Pinto ordered a double facade designed by Elias Bouman.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1651 they were sold by the Burch heirs to Isaack de Pinto (who died 1681) Inherited by his only son David de Pinto, who bought the neighboring house in 1686 and ordered the double facade designed by Elias Bouman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1651 they were sold by the Burch heirs to Isaack de Pinto (who died 1681) Inherited by his only son David de Pinto, who bought the neighboring house in 1686 and ordered the double facade designed by Elias Bouman.

facts.text: Huis De Pinto was almost demolished during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Sold in 1756 by Aron de David de Pinto Almost demolished during WWII Restored in 1975 Public library 1975-2012 Offices and community hall
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Sold in 1756 by Aron de David de Pinto Almost demolished during WWII Restored in 1975 Public library 1975-2012 Offices and community hall

facts.text: Huis De Pinto honors a dynasty of Portuguese-Jewish merchant bankers.
facts.sourceQuote: It was originally built in 1605 and is named after a leading Amsterdam family dynasty of Portuguese-Jewish merchant bankers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was originally built in 1605 and is named after a leading Amsterdam family dynasty of Portuguese-Jewish merchant bankers.

facts.text: Isaack de Pinto, originally from Antwerp, purchased the house in 1651.
facts.sourceQuote: The founder of this dynasty was Isaack de Pinto, from Antwerp, who bought the house in 1651.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The founder of this dynasty was Isaack de Pinto, from Antwerp, who bought the house in 1651.

facts.text: Grandson Isaac de Pinto grew up within these historic walls.
facts.sourceQuote: His son commissioned the unusual facade, and his grandson Isaac de Pinto grew up there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His son commissioned the unusual facade, and his grandson Isaac de Pinto grew up there.

features.opening: Huis De Pinto is a former Amsterdam city mansion on the Sint Antoniesbreestraat near the Rembrandthuis.

features.name: De Hallen

facts.text: The tram depot operated until 1996 before becoming a hub for various tenants.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrum is gevestigd in de voormalige Remise Tollensstraat van de Gemeentetram Amsterdam, gebouwd in 1902-'05 en is tot 1996 in gebruik geweest bij het Gemeentevervoerbedrijf Amsterdam, daarna waren de gebouwen nog in gebruik bij diverse huurders, waaronder tot 2005 het Amsterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The center is located in the former Remise Tollensstraat of the Municipal Tramway Amsterdam, built in 1902-'05 and was in use until 1996 with the Municipal Transport Company Amsterdam, after which the buildings were still in use by various tenants, including until 2005 the Amsterdam Public Transport Museum.

facts.text: The Amsterdam Public Transport Museum occupied the site until 2005.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrum is gevestigd in de voormalige Remise Tollensstraat van de Gemeentetram Amsterdam, gebouwd in 1902-'05 en is tot 1996 in gebruik geweest bij het Gemeentevervoerbedrijf Amsterdam, daarna waren de gebouwen nog in gebruik bij diverse huurders, waaronder tot 2005 het Amsterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The center is located in the former Remise Tollensstraat of the Municipal Tramway Amsterdam, built in 1902-'05 and was in use until 1996 with the Municipal Transport Company Amsterdam, after which the buildings were still in use by various tenants, including until 2005 the Amsterdam Public Transport Museum.

facts.text: One Filmhallen room recreates the interior of the former Cinema Parisien from Nieuwendijk.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Filmhallen is een zaal is ingericht met het interieur van de vroegere Cinema Parisien, die aan de Nieuwendijk stond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Filmhallen, one room is decorated with the interior of the former Cinema Parisien, which stood on Nieuwendijk.

facts.text: A public passage connects all spaces and hosts markets, exhibitions, and children's activities.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze passage verbindt alle ruimtes in het gebouwencomplex. De openbare passage wordt daarnaast gebruikt voor markten, tentoonstellingen, optredens, activiteiten voor kinderen en andere publieksactiviteiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This passage connects all the spaces in the building complex. The public passage is also used for markets, exhibitions, performances, activities for children and other public activities.

facts.text: All organizations except the hotel line the Hannie Dankbaarpassage running parallel to Kinkerstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: Met uitzondering van het hotel liggen alle organisaties en bedrijven in De Hallen aan de openbare Hannie Dankbaarpassage die evenwijdig aan de Kinkerstraat loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the exception of the hotel, all organizations and companies in De Hallen are located on the public Hannie Dankbaarpassage that runs parallel to Kinkerstraat.

features.opening: The Hallen is a cultural center in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam-West, with more than two million visitors per year.

features.name: Walloon Church

facts.text: A north gate designed by Hendrick de Keyser features skulls honoring funeral processions passing through.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1616, a new entrance was added on the north side of the church, with a gate designed by city architect Hendrick de Keyser. The gate, which gave access to Oude Hoogstraat street, was decorated with skulls, a nod to the funeral processions which passed through this gate.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1616, a new entrance was added on the north side of the church, with a gate designed by city architect Hendrick de Keyser. The gate, which gave access to Oude Hoogstraat street, was decorated with skulls, a nod to the funeral processions which passed through this gate.

facts.text: So many tombstones were found during restoration that the concrete floor was replaced with a self-supporting one.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990-1992, the church was restored, whereby the foundations were restored to stop the church from sinking, caused by the front facade installed in 1885. During this restoration, so many tombstones were found that a decision was made to replace the concrete floor with a new, self-supporting floor with its own foundation.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990-1992, the church was restored, whereby the foundations were restored to stop the church from sinking, caused by the front facade installed in 1885. During this restoration, so many tombstones were found that a decision was made to replace the concrete floor with a new, self-supporting floor with its own foundation.

facts.text: Painter Bartholomeus van der Helst and scientist Jan Swammerdam are both interred within this church.
facts.sourceQuote: The painter Bartholomeus van der Helst (1613-1670) and the scientist Jan Swammerdam (1637-1680) are interred in the church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The painter Bartholomeus van der Helst (1613-1670) and the scientist Jan Swammerdam (1637-1680) are interred in the church.

facts.text: Elizabeth Timothy, the first female American newspaper editor, was most likely christened here.
facts.sourceQuote: Elizabeth Timothy (1702-1757), the first female American newspaper editor and publisher, was most likely christened there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Elizabeth Timothy (1702-1757), the first female American newspaper editor and publisher, was most likely christened there.

facts.text: Vincent van Gogh regularly attended sermons delivered by his uncle Johannes Paulus Stricker in the 1870s.
facts.sourceQuote: The painter Vincent van Gogh visited the church regularly in the 1870s to attend sermons delivered by his uncle Johannes Paulus Stricker.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The painter Vincent van Gogh visited the church regularly in the 1870s to attend sermons delivered by his uncle Johannes Paulus Stricker.

features.opening: The Walloon Church (Dutch: Waalse Kerk; French: Église Wallonne) is a Protestant church building in Amsterdam, along the southern stretch of the Oudezijds…

features.name: University of Amsterdam

facts.text: Mathematician Luitzen Brouwer was a former professor at this university.
facts.sourceQuote: Notable former professors include winner of the Nobel Peace Prize in 1911 Tobias Asser, mathematician Luitzen Egbertus Jan Brouwer, winner of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1901 Jacobus Henricus van 't Hoff, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1910 Johannes Diderik van der Waals, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1902 Pieter Zeeman, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1953 Frits Zernike, and scholar of religion, C.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Notable former professors include winner of the Nobel Peace Prize in 1911 Tobias Asser, mathematician Luitzen Egbertus Jan Brouwer, winner of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1901 Jacobus Henricus van 't Hoff, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1910 Johannes Diderik van der Waals, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1902 Pieter Zeeman, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1953 Frits Zernike, and scholar of religion, C.

facts.text: Municipal authorities established the University of Amsterdam in 1632.
facts.sourceQuote: Established in 1632 by municipal authorities, it is the fourth-oldest academic institution in the Netherlands still in operation.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Established in 1632 by municipal authorities, it is the fourth-oldest academic institution in the Netherlands still in operation.

features.opening: The University of Amsterdam (abbreviated as UvA; Dutch: Universiteit van Amsterdam) is a public research university located in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Voormalige Schouwburgpoort

facts.text: Jacob van Campen coined the Dutch word Schouwburg for this theatre.
facts.sourceQuote: The theatre was built in 1637, by Jacob van Campen, who coined the word Schouwburg for it.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theatre was built in 1637, by Jacob van Campen, who coined the word Schouwburg for it.

facts.text: Vondel wrote the architrave inscription: The world is a theatre, Everyone plays his role and gets his part.
facts.sourceQuote: Vondel had also written the text in the architrave of the theatre's entrance: De weereld is een speeltoneel Elck speelt zijn rol en krijght zijn deel (The world is a theatre, Everyone plays his role and gets his part) This entrance still survives from the original building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vondel had also written the text in the architrave of the theatre's entrance: De weereld is een speeltoneel Elck speelt zijn rol en krijght zijn deel (The world is a theatre, Everyone plays his role and gets his part) This entrance still survives from the original building.

facts.text: The Calvinist church council tried to stop the opening but failed temporarily.
facts.sourceQuote: The Calvinist kerkeraad (church council) of the municipality, however, attempted to stop the theatre opening, but were only temporarily successful, for the theatre was in the end still opened on 3 January 1638, with Vondel's play.
