facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Meanwhile the Dutch resistance (Binnenlandse Strijdkrachten) had successfully disarmed most of the Germans, without much trouble. By midday they had taken possession of three key locations: the Royal Palace, the main money office and the main post office (Operation Three Castles).

facts.text: Plaquette 7 mei 1945 marks the date of a tragic shooting during Amsterdam's liberation.
facts.sourceQuote: The 1945 shooting on Dam square took place during the liberation of Amsterdam on 7 May 1945, in the last days of World War II in Europe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 1945 shooting on Dam square took place during the liberation of Amsterdam on 7 May 1945, in the last days of World War II in Europe.

facts.text: German soldiers fired machine guns into celebrating crowds on Dam Square on that day.
facts.sourceQuote: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.

facts.text: Over thirty people died when German troops opened fire on the celebration crowd.
facts.sourceQuote: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.

features.opening: The 1945 shooting on Dam square took place during the liberation of Amsterdam on 7 May 1945, in the last days of World War II in Europe.

features.name: Heineken Experience

facts.text: Production moved to a larger facility on the city outskirts in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: The industrial facility was built as the first Heineken brewery in 1867, serving as the company's primary brewing facility until 1988 when a more modern, larger facility was constructed on the outskirts of the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The industrial facility was built as the first Heineken brewery in 1867, serving as the company's primary brewing facility until 1988 when a more modern, larger facility was constructed on the outskirts of the city.

facts.text: The visitor centre changed its name to Heineken Experience in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: It grew to become one of Amsterdam's most popular tourist attractions and by 2001 the visitor centre changed its name to "Heineken Experience".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It grew to become one of Amsterdam's most popular tourist attractions and by 2001 the visitor centre changed its name to "Heineken Experience".

features.opening: The Heineken Experience, located in Amsterdam, is a historic brewery and corporate visitor centre for the internationally distributed Dutch pilsner, Heineken…

features.name: Museum of the Canals

facts.text: A dollhouse inside uses the Pepper's ghost technique to show the canal house rooms.
facts.sourceQuote: Een poppenhuis toont de kamers van het grachtenhuis met behulp van de Pepper's ghost-techniek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A dollhouse shows the rooms of the canal house using the Pepper's ghost technique.

facts.text: Interactive displays include maquettes, animations, and 3D wall projections about the canal belt.
facts.sourceQuote: Een interactieve en multimediale tentoonstelling in het museum maakt de ontstaansgeschiedenis van de grachtengordel duidelijk. Er zijn onder meer maquettes, animaties, 3D- en wandprojecties.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An interactive and multimedia exhibition in the museum makes the history of the canal belt's creation clear. There are among other things maquettes, animations, 3D and wall projections.

facts.text: Banker Jan Willink once lent the US government over 30 million guilders during their revolution.
facts.sourceQuote: De bankier heeft tijdens de Amerikaanse Onafhankelijkheidsoorlog (1775-1790) de Amerikanen vele jaren gesteund met kredieten en aandelen. Tot 1794 leenden de Verenigde Staten van Willink en andere bankiers ruim 30 miljoen gulden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the American Revolutionary War (1775-1790), the banker supported the Americans with loans and shares for many years. Until 1794, the United States borrowed more than 30 million guilders from Willink and other bankers.

facts.text: A back room preserves 1776 wallpaper by Jurriaen Andriessen depicting idealized Dutch landscapes.
facts.sourceQuote: De achterkamer heeft behangsels van Jurriaen Andriessen uit 1776 met schilderingen van geïdealiseerde Hollandse landschappen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The back room has wallpaper by Jurriaen Andriessen from 1776 with paintings of idealized Dutch landscapes.

features.opening: Grachtenmuseum Amsterdam (Museum of the Canals) is a museum on the Herengracht in Amsterdam dedicated to the 17th-century Amsterdam canal belt and the history…

features.name: De Kleine Komedie

facts.text: Orangist Henry Hope took over management only to flee the country himself when Napoleon's army approached in 1794.
facts.sourceQuote: The 'Patriotic' or 'Anti-Orange' sympathies of the directors Henry Fizeaux and Jean Alexander Botereau resulted in their stepping down in 1787 when the House of Orange was re-established. Orangist Henry Hope took over the running of the establishment until he fled the country before Napoleon's army in 1794.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Patriotic' or 'Anti-Orange' sympathies of the directors Henry Fizeaux and Jean Alexander Botereau resulted in their stepping down in 1787 when the House of Orange was re-established. Orangist Henry Hope took over the running of the establishment until he fled the country before Napoleon's army in 1794.

facts.text: Both emerging and established Dutch talents perform on its stage.
facts.sourceQuote: Situated on the Amstel near the Halvemaansteeg, the building offers a stage for both upcoming and established Dutch talents.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Situated on the Amstel near the Halvemaansteeg, the building offers a stage for both upcoming and established Dutch talents.

features.opening: De Kleine Komedie is today the oldest theatre in Amsterdam, dating from 1788.

features.name: Westertoren

facts.text: The tower's upper lanterns are made of wood covered in lead, while the base uses sandstone.
facts.sourceQuote: De romp van de toren is van baksteen, de bovenbouw bestaat uit drie, in grootte afnemende verdiepingen; de zogenaamde lantaarns. Het eerste deel is van zandsteen. De twee bovenste delen zijn van hout, bekleed met lood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The body of the tower is made of brick, the upper structure consists of three floors, decreasing in size; the so-called lanterns. The first part is made of sandstone. The top two parts are made of wood, covered with lead.

facts.text: At its crown, the Westertoren leans 88 centimeters off the vertical plumb line.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren staat scheef. Ter hoogte van de kroon gemeten staat de toren 88 cm uit het lood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower is crooked. At the height of the crown measured, the tower is 88 cm off the plumb.

facts.text: The tower underwent a major restoration lasting from February 2023 until early 2025.
facts.sourceQuote: Van februari 2023 tot begin 2025 werd de toren gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was restored from February 2023 to the beginning of 2025.

features.opening: The Westertoren in Amsterdam is the tower of the Westerkerk, at Prinsengracht 279 by the Westermarkt in Amsterdam-Centrum.

features.name: De Rode Hoed

facts.text: Brick over frame construction created arched windows and a small rose window for this two-story structure.
facts.sourceQuote: It is a two-story building with arched windows and even a small rose window made of brick over frame.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a two-story building with arched windows and even a small rose window made of brick over frame.

features.opening: Vrijburg is a historic clandestine church concealed behind a row of houses fronting on the Keizersgracht, Amsterdam.

features.name: Filmhallen

facts.text: The cinema opened on September 4, 2014, debuting with the Dutch film Nena.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop draait sinds 4 september 2014, met op 8 september de première van de Nederlandse speelfilm Nena van Saskia Diesing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has been open since September 4, 2014, with the premiere of the Dutch feature film Nena by Saskia Diesing on September 8.

facts.text: Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies operate this movie theater.
facts.sourceQuote: De exploitanten zijn Kadir Selçuk en Alex Rutten van The Movies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The operators are Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies.

facts.text: Filmhallen participates in the Cineville partnership connecting various cinemas.
facts.sourceQuote: De Filmhallen doet mee aan het samenwerkingsverband Cineville van filmhuizen en bioscopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Filmhallen participates in the Cineville partnership of film theaters and cinemas.

facts.text: The Cinema Parisien interior was installed in the Film Museum building in 1991 by architect Joop van Stigt.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit interieur was eerder geïnstalleerd in een zaal van het Filmmuseum toen dat in het Vondelparkpaviljoen was gevestigd. Het werd in 1991 door architect Joop van Stigt ingebouwd in het gebouw van het Filmmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This interior was previously installed in a room of the Filmmuseum when it was located in the Vondelpark pavilion. It was installed in 1991 by architect Joop van Stigt in the building of the Film Museum.

facts.text: After being stored following the 2012 museum move, the historic hall reopened at Filmhallen on October 22, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen het Filmmuseum in 2012 verhuisde naar het nieuwe EYE-gebouw in Amsterdam-Noord, werd het Parisien interieur ontmanteld en opgeslagen. In het najaar van 2014 kreeg het oude interieur van Cinema Parisien een derde leven als filmzaal in de Filmhallen. De zaal werd in gebruik genomen op 22 oktober 2014.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Filmmuseum moved to the new EYE building in Amsterdam-North in 2012, the Parisian interior was dismantled and stored. In the fall of 2014, the old interior of Cinema Parisien received a third life as a cinema in the Filmhallen. The hall was put into use on October 22, 2014.

facts.text: Room 7 features an art deco interior with Amsterdam School accents originally built for a cinema in 1924.
facts.sourceQuote: In zaal 7 is het art-deco-interieur met Amsterdamse School-accenten uit 1924 ingebouwd van de vroegere Cinema Parisien, die tot 1987 op de Nieuwendijk gevestigd was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In room 7, the art deco interior with Amsterdam School accents from 1924 is built into the former Cinema Parisien, which was located on Nieuwendijk until 1987.

features.opening: The Filmhallen, also known as FilmHallen, is a movie theater in the De Hallen complex in the former tram depot Tollensstraat in Amsterdam-West.

features.name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond

facts.text: The name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond refers to the brackish groundwater created by mixing Amstel and IJ waters.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam "de Brakke Grond" verwijst naar het drassige gebied dat zich oorspronkelijk op deze plek bevond. De mengeling van het zoet water van de Amstel en het zeewater van het IJ maakte het grondwater hier brak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name "de Brakke Grond" refers to the marshy area that originally existed in this place. The mixture of the sweet water of the Amstel and the seawater of the IJ made the groundwater here brackish.

facts.text: The Flemish government opened this center in 1981 to profile Flemish identity in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: De Brakke Grond werd geopend door de Vlaamse overheid in 1981 met het doel de Vlaamse culturele identiteit te profileren in Nederland, Vlaams-Nederlandse culturele uitwisseling te bevorderen en Vlaamse artiesten een podium in Nederland te bieden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Brakke Grond was opened by the Flemish government in 1981 with the aim of profiling the Flemish cultural identity in the Netherlands, promoting Vlaams-Dutch cultural exchange and providing Flemish artists with a stage in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Architect Arthur Staal designed the current building that houses the cultural activities today.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige gebouw is een ontwerp van architect Arthur Staal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal.

facts.text: Visitors can enjoy a terrace café serving mainly Flemish dishes on the square outside.
facts.sourceQuote: Het cultuurhuis heeft een café-restaurant, met een terras op het pleintje, waar voornamelijk Vlaamse gerechten geserveerd worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cultural center has a café-restaurant, with a terrace on the square, where mainly Flemish dishes are served.

features.opening: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam.

features.name: Houseboat Museum

facts.text: Resident Vincent van Loon founded the museum after noticing tourists peering curiously inside.
facts.sourceQuote: The idea for the museum arose in the 1990s with then-houseboat resident Vincent van Loon. Because he noticed that passersby and tourists on the canals frequently peered curiously inside, he decided to establish a museum to provide insight into life on the water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The idea for the museum arose in the 1990s with then-houseboat resident Vincent van Loon. Because he noticed that passersby and tourists on the canals frequently peered curiously inside, he decided to establish a museum to provide insight into life on the water.

facts.text: A 2008 restoration returned the historic skipper's cabin at the rear to its original condition.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2008, the ship was restored. During the renovations, the historic skipper's cabin (the authentic quarters of the skipper at the rear) was restored to its original condition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2008, the ship was restored. During the renovations, the historic skipper's cabin (the authentic quarters of the skipper at the rear) was restored to its original condition.

facts.text: New owners later redecorated the living quarters in a 1970s style to reflect houseboat culture.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2024, the museum changed ownership. The new owners redecorated the residential section of the ship in a 1970s style to reflect the heyday of Amsterdam's houseboat culture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2024, the museum changed ownership. The new owners redecorated the residential section of the ship in a 1970s style to reflect the heyday of Amsterdam's houseboat culture.

facts.text: Woonbootmuseum translates directly to Houseboat Museum in English.
facts.sourceQuote: The Woonbootmuseum (also known as the Houseboat Museum) is a museum in Amsterdam entirely dedicated to the history and culture of living on the water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Woonbootmuseum (also known as the Houseboat Museum) is a museum in Amsterdam entirely dedicated to the history and culture of living on the water.

features.opening: The Woonbootmuseum (also known as the Houseboat Museum) is a museum in Amsterdam entirely dedicated to the history and culture of living on the water.

features.name: Fo Guang Shan He Hua Tempel

facts.text: Dutch architect Fred Greven traveled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples for this project.
facts.sourceQuote: Despite Greven's lack of experience in designing Buddhist temples, he was appointed and travelled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Despite Greven's lack of experience in designing Buddhist temples, he was appointed and travelled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix attended the opening ceremony of the Fo Guang Shan He Hua Tempel in September 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: After several years of construction, the He Hua Temple was officially completed in September 2000. On September 15 of the same year, Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands attended the opening ceremony.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After several years of construction, the He Hua Temple was officially completed in September 2000. On September 15 of the same year, Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands attended the opening ceremony.

facts.text: Architect Fred Greven initially failed because his measurements were wrong, but the second design succeeded using the sacred unit of 32 centimeters.
facts.sourceQuote: The leaders of the Fo Guang Shan dismissed the first temple design by architect Fred Greven as too small with incorrect measurements. For the second design he applied the Buddhist sacred measurement unit of 32 centimeters and everything fell in place.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The leaders of the Fo Guang Shan dismissed the first temple design by architect Fred Greven as too small with incorrect measurements. For the second design he applied the Buddhist sacred measurement unit of 32 centimeters and everything fell in place.

features.opening: Fo Guang Shan He Hua Temple (Chinese: 佛光山荷華寺; pinyin: Fó Guāng Shān Hé Huá Sì; lit.

features.name: Opstandingskerk

facts.text: The Opstandingskerk earned the nickname Kolenkit because its 48-meter bell tower resembles a coal kit.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze kreeg al tijdens de bouw de bijnaam Kolenkit vanwege de gelijkenis van de 48 meter hoge klokkentoren met een kolenkit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She already got the nickname Kolenkit during construction because of the similarity of the 48-meter-high bell tower to a coal kit.

facts.text: The surrounding neighborhood adopted the church's nickname, becoming known as the Kolenkitbuurt.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam werd zo doorgewinterd dat de omliggende buurt naar die bijnaam vernoemd werd: Kolenkitbuurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name became so well-established that the surrounding neighborhood was named after that nickname: Kolenkitbuurt.

facts.text: Visibility vanished as massive new structures and urban densification rose around the intersection.
facts.sourceQuote: Die goede zichtbaarheid ging steeds meer verloren, eerst door de bouw van het massieve GAK-gebouw, daarna de (verhoogde) ongelijkvloerse kruising van de Bos en Lommerweg met de Rijksweg 10 en in de 21e eeuw door stadsverdichting rondom die kruising.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That good visibility was increasingly lost, first due to the construction of the massive GAK building, then the (increased) staggered intersection of the Bos and Lommerweg with the Rijksweg 10 and in the 21st century due to urban densification around that intersection.

facts.text: Architect Marius Duintjer designed this church alongside other Reformed municipality projects.
facts.sourceQuote: Duintjer had het destijds druk met het ontwerpen voor de hervormde gemeente; van zijn hand kwamen bijvoorbeeld ook de Kruiskerk in Amstelveen en de Koningskerk in Amsterdam-Oost.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Duintjer was busy designing for the Reformed municipality at the time; for example, he also designed the Kruiskerk in Amstelveen and the Koningskerk in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.opening: The Opstandingskerk is a church in Amsterdam West, at Bos en Lommerplein 325 on the western part of the square.

features.name: Anne Frank

facts.text: The statue was created in 1994 by artist Jet Schepp but initially lacked municipal approval.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld is in 1994 gemaakt door beeldend kunstenaar Jet Schepp, oorspronkelijk om het te plaatsen op het Merwedeplein, maar dat kreeg destijds geen bijval van de gemeente.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sculpture was made in 1994 by visual artist Jet Schepp, originally to be placed on the Merwedeplein, but it did not receive approval from the municipality at the time.

facts.text: A replica of the statue was installed in Buenos Aires in December 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Een replica van het beeld is in december 2014 in Buenos Aires geplaatst, op initiatief van de Nederlandse ambassade in Argentinië en het Argentijnse ministerie van onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A replica of the statue was placed in Buenos Aires in December 2014, at the initiative of the Dutch embassy in Argentina and the Argentine Ministry of Education.

features.opening: The image of Anne Frank on Merwedeplein in Amsterdam is a statue of the German-Jewish girl Anne Frank who died at the age of fifteen during the Holocaust.

features.name: Rasphuispoort

facts.text: Detainees rasped brazilwood into powder, giving the Rasphuispoort its name.
facts.sourceQuote: The detainees in the Rasphuis were made to shave wood from the brazilwood tree (Caesalpinia echinata or pernambuco), rasping it into powder using an eight to twelve bladed rasp, hence the name.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The detainees in the Rasphuis were made to shave wood from the brazilwood tree (Caesalpinia echinata or pernambuco), rasping it into powder using an eight to twelve bladed rasp, hence the name.

facts.text: The prison closed in 1815 before the building was demolished in 1892.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1815 it was closed, and in 1892 the building was demolished to make way for a swimming pool.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1815 it was closed, and in 1892 the building was demolished to make way for a swimming pool.

features.opening: The Rasphuis was a "tuchthuis" or prison in Amsterdam that was established in 1596 in the former Convent of the Poor Clares on the Heiligeweg.

features.name: The National Maritime Museum

facts.text: Daniël Stalpaert designed the building as a naval storehouse in 1656.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is housed in a former naval storehouse, 's Lands Zeemagazijn or Admiraliteits Magazijn, designed by the Dutch architect Daniël Stalpaert and constructed in 1656.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is housed in a former naval storehouse, 's Lands Zeemagazijn or Admiraliteits Magazijn, designed by the Dutch architect Daniël Stalpaert and constructed in 1656.

facts.text: The National Maritime Museum was formerly called Nederlands Scheepvaartmuseum Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was formerly called Nederlands Scheepvaartmuseum Amsterdam (Netherlands Maritime Museum Amsterdam).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was formerly called Nederlands Scheepvaartmuseum Amsterdam (Netherlands Maritime Museum Amsterdam).

facts.text: After renovation from 2007 to 2011, the museum reopened on October 2, 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: After an extensive renovation in 2007–2011, Het Scheepvaartmuseum reopened on 2 October 2011.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After an extensive renovation in 2007–2011, Het Scheepvaartmuseum reopened on 2 October 2011.

facts.text: In 2013, this museum ranked as the twelfth most visited in all of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: It ranked as 12th most visited museum in the Netherlands in 2013.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It ranked as 12th most visited museum in the Netherlands in 2013.

features.opening: The Maritime Museum (Dutch: Het Scheepvaartmuseum, pronounced [ət ˈsxeːpfaːrtmyˌzeːjʏm]) is a maritime museum in Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

features.name: Academie voor Theater en Dans

facts.text: The institution began in 1874 as the Amsterdamse Toneelschool at Marnixstraat 150.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdamse Toneelschool was set up in 1874 and was at first established in the Marnixstraat 150.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdamse Toneelschool was set up in 1874 and was at first established in the Marnixstraat 150.

facts.text: Anna Sablariolles was the first pupil while Maria Gartman became an early instructor.
facts.sourceQuote: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.

facts.text: The institution kept the name de Theaterschool until September 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.

facts.text: About sixty instructors work there, nearly all active in theatre or dance.
facts.sourceQuote: The staff of instructors and guest instructors amounts to about sixty persons, nearly all also in active in the theatrical and dance field.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The staff of instructors and guest instructors amounts to about sixty persons, nearly all also in active in the theatrical and dance field.

features.opening: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.

features.name: Kerk van Zunderdorp

facts.text: A fire in 1824 required a restoration of the wooden barrel vault inside the building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkinterieur wordt overdekt door een houten tongewelf met trekbalken op geprofileerde sleutelstukken en korbelen (volgens de V.L. herbouwd 1711 en 1824; het eerste jaartal is waarschijnlijk, het tweede betreft een herstelling na een brand).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church interior is covered by a wooden barrel vault with trusses on profiled keystones and corbels (rebuilt according to the V.L. in 1711 and 1824; the first year is probably, the second refers to a restoration after a fire).

facts.text: Flentrop Orgelbouw restored the instrument in Zaandam during the year 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 is het instrument gerestaureerd door Flentrop Orgelbouw te Zaandam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, the instrument was restored by Flentrop Orgelbouw in Zaandam.

features.opening: The Kerk van Zunderdorp is the Reformed Dutch Kerk van Zunderdorp in Amsterdam-North.

features.name: Museum Het Schip

facts.text: The original 102 homes were reduced to 82 units over time within this working-class complex.
facts.sourceQuote: It originally contained 102 homes (now 82) for the working class, a small meeting hall, a post office, and an elementary school.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It originally contained 102 homes (now 82) for the working class, a small meeting hall, a post office, and an elementary school.

facts.text: Since 2001, the former school and post office have operated as a museum dedicated to the Amsterdam School style.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2001, the former school and post office are used as a museum about the Amsterdam School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2001, the former school and post office are used as a museum about the Amsterdam School.

facts.text: Architect Michel de Klerk designed this entire complex in the year 1919.
facts.sourceQuote: The complex in the architectural style of the Amsterdam School was designed by Michel de Klerk in 1919.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex in the architectural style of the Amsterdam School was designed by Michel de Klerk in 1919.

facts.text: Socialist group Eigen Haard commissioned architect Michel de Klerk to design this proletarian housing project.
facts.sourceQuote: One such group was Eigen Haard, or "our own hearth," a socialist group that commissioned Michel de Klerk to design and build three blocks of proletarian housing, including Het Schip.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One such group was Eigen Haard, or "our own hearth," a socialist group that commissioned Michel de Klerk to design and build three blocks of proletarian housing, including Het Schip.

features.opening: Het Schip (English: The Ship) is a building complex in the Spaarndammerbuurt neighbourhood of Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: DeLaMar

facts.text: The Dutch resistance bombed the site in 1944, causing part of it to burn down.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch resistance bombed the building on 7 January 1944, causing part of the building to burn down.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch resistance bombed the building on 7 January 1944, causing part of the building to burn down.

facts.text: Wim Sonneveld bought the venue in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Wim Sonneveld bought the theatre in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater (English: New de la Mar Theatre).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wim Sonneveld bought the theatre in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater (English: New de la Mar Theatre).

facts.text: During WWII occupation, Germans stored forced labor data inside this building.
facts.sourceQuote: During the German occupation of the Netherlands in World War II, the Germans stored data relating to forced labour in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German occupation of the Netherlands in World War II, the Germans stored data relating to forced labour in the building.

features.opening: DeLaMar is a theatre near Leidseplein in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with two auditoriums containing 601 and 939 seats.

features.name: Middenstip Stadion De Meer

facts.text: The artwork features a half football protruding from the street stones within concentric circles.
facts.sourceQuote: Harald Vlugt ontwierp voor een plein in die wijk een middenstip met daaromheen een reeks concentrische cirkels. De middenstip bestaat daarbij uit een "halve voetbal".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Harald Vlugt designed a central point for a square in that district with a series of concentric circles around it. The center spot consists of a "half football".

facts.text: The ball sticking out of the pavement has already caused several people to fall.
facts.sourceQuote: De uit de straatstenen omhoog stekende bal heeft al diverse valpartijen veroorzaakt, ze ligt er onopvallend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ball protruding from the street stones has already caused several falls, it is lying there inconspicuously.

features.opening: Middenstip is a work of art by Harald Vlugt, placed in Amsterdam-Oost, the Watergraafsmeer.

features.name: Zimmerterrein

facts.text: Frits Bottelier, nicknamed Uncle Kick, saved the area from construction and organized children's activities there.
facts.sourceQuote: Frits Bottelier (1925-2011), bijgenaamd Ome Kick, zette zich in de jaren 70 en 80 in tegen bebouwing en organiseerde activiteiten voor kinderen, waardoor voor veel buurtbewoners dit nog het "Landje van Ome Kick" is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Frits Bottelier (1925-2011), nicknamed Uncle Kick, campaigned against construction in the 1970s and 80s and organized activities for children, so that for many neighborhood residents this is still the "Land of Uncle Kick".

features.opening: The Zimmerterrein, also known as the Landje van Ome Kick, is a small park in the Bellamy neighborhood in Amsterdam-West.

features.name: Bellamyplein

facts.text: City architect Ko Mulder replaced the original fountain with a pier bath featuring a new fountain on the site.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de plaats van de oude fontein kwam een pierenbad met fonteintje van stadsarchitecte Ko Mulder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the site of the old fountain, a pier bath with fountain was built by city architect Ko Mulder.

facts.text: Two massive winged nut trees stand at the square's southern end, reaching heights of 15 to 18 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zuidpunt van het plantsoen staan twee reusachtige bomen (boomnummers 504239 en 504235, niet monumentaal), beide van het type gewone vleugelnoot (Pterocarya fraxinifolia). Ze stammen uit 1933/1934 en worden 15 tot 18 meter hoog gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the southern end of the park are two enormous trees (tree numbers 504239 and 504235, not monumental), both of the type common winged nut (Pterocarya fraxinifolia). They date back to 1933/1934 and are kept 15 to 18 meters high.

features.opening: The Bellamyplein is a triangular square in the Bellamy neighborhood in Amsterdam-West, between the Bilderdijkkade and the Ten Katestraat.

features.name: Amsterdamse Bos

facts.text: The city council officially approved the park's creation in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam city council decided in 1928 to create a major public park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam city council decided in 1928 to create a major public park.

facts.text: Van Eesteren and Mulder developed the Boschplan for the municipal Public Works Department.
facts.sourceQuote: Van Eesteren and Mulder developed the Boschplan within Amsterdam's municipal Public Works Department.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Van Eesteren and Mulder developed the Boschplan within Amsterdam's municipal Public Works Department.

facts.text: Four camps in Amsterdamse Bos held Jewish men for forced labour before many were deported.
facts.sourceQuote: Four camps in the Amsterdamse Bos were specifically used for Jewish men, who were subjected to forced labour. These camps formed part of the persecution of Dutch Jews and, for many of those imprisoned there, preceded deportation to concentration and extermination camps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Four camps in the Amsterdamse Bos were specifically used for Jewish men, who were subjected to forced labour. These camps formed part of the persecution of Dutch Jews and, for many of those imprisoned there, preceded deportation to concentration and extermination camps.

facts.text: Young woodland strips were cleared near Schiphol to install German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights.
facts.sourceQuote: Because of the proximity of Schiphol, German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights were installed, and strips of young woodland were cleared.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because of the proximity of Schiphol, German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights were installed, and strips of young woodland were cleared.

features.opening: The Amsterdamse Bos (Dutch for "Amsterdam Forest") is a large urban forest and landscape park south-west of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Gaasperpark

facts.text: Construction began in 1977 specifically for the 1982 Floriade exhibition.
facts.sourceQuote: De aanleg van het park startte in 1977 voor de Floriade van 1982.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of the park began in 1977 for the 1982 Floriade.

facts.text: Six steel boxes from the original event remain near the former entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: Een kunstwerk bestaande uit zes stalen dozen bij de voormalige ingang staat er nog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A work of art consisting of six steel boxes still stands near the former entrance.

facts.text: A former planetarium building now houses a convention center.
facts.sourceQuote: In het gebouw van het vroegere planetarium, dat in 1988 naar Artis is verhuisd, werd een congrescentrum gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A convention center was established in the building of the former planetarium, which moved to Artis in 1988.

features.opening: The Gaasperpark is a park in Gaasperdam, Amsterdam-Zuidoost district, on the northern bank of the Gaasperplas, an artificial recreation lake, created by sand…

features.name: Gaasperzoom

facts.text: Gaasperzoom was developed in the early 1980s alongside the Gein district.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied is in het begin van de jaren tachtig aangelegd, gelijktijdig met het gereedkomen van de wijk Gein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area was developed at the beginning of the 1980s, at the same time as the completion of the Gein district.

facts.text: A bicycle path runs north to south through the area at an angle to another route.
facts.sourceQuote: Een fietspad doorkruist het gebied van noord naar zuid. Haaks hierop loopt een fietspad langs de Ruwelswal naar het riviertje het Gein langs de woonwijken Gein en Reigersbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A bicycle path crosses the area from north to south. At an angle to this, a bicycle path runs along the Ruwelswal to the stream the Gein along the residential areas Gein and Reigersbos.

features.opening: The Gaasperzoom is a park and nature reserve in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Hortusplantsoen

facts.text: A plaque unveiled in 2007 honors Jewish students from a nursing school seized during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 19 april 2007 onthulde de Amsterdamse burgemeester Job Cohen een plaquette bij de Academie ter herinnering aan de Joodse leerlingen van de J.C. Ammanschool die tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog werden opgepakt en naar de concentratiekampen gestuurd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 19, 2007, the mayor of Amsterdam, Job Cohen, unveiled a plaque at the Academy in memory of the Jewish students of the J.C. Nursing school that was seized during World War II and sent to the concentration camps.

facts.text: Two national monument bridges span the pond: a 1877 stone vault bridge and a 1903 iron arch bridge.
facts.sourceQuote: De twee bruggen in de vijver zijn beide aangewezen als rijksmonument: een natuurstenen welfbrug met zware gietijzeren leuningen uit 1877 (brug nr. 233) en een ijzeren boogbrug uit 1903.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both of the bridges in the pond have been designated as a national monument: a natural stone vault bridge with heavy cast iron railings from 1877 (bridge no. 233) and an iron arch bridge from 1903.

facts.text: The Reinwardt Academy of the Amsterdam School of Arts has occupied buildings one through three since the 2015 school year.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf het schooljaar 2015-'16 is de Reinwardt Academie van de Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten gevestigd in het gebouwencomplex Hortusplantsoen 1-3.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the 2015-'16 school year, the Reinwardt Academy of the Amsterdam School of Arts has been located in the Hortusplantsoen 1-3 building complex.

features.opening: The Hortusplantsoen is a park and street in the center of Amsterdam.

features.name: Wachterliedplantsoen

facts.text: The name Wachterliedplantsoen honors late medieval guard songs where a warning guard bid farewell to lovers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen is vernoemd bij een gemeenteraadsbesluit van 26 juli 1939 naar de wachterliederen, een laatmiddeleeuws soort minnelied waarbij afscheid genomen werd door de waarschuwende wachter op een muur van een minnend paar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is named after a municipal council decision of July 26, 1939 after the guard songs, a late medieval kind of love song in which farewell was said by the warning guard on a wall of a loving couple.

facts.text: A new pavilion was constructed specifically to serve the needs of the local neighborhood community.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook kwam er een nieuw verenigingsgebouw (het Wachterliedpaviljoen) voor de buurt, een kinderboerderij, een speeltuin en enkele sportveldjes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A new club building (the Wachterliedpaviljoen) was also built for the neighborhood, a children's farm, a playground and several sports fields.

facts.text: Benches were strategically placed so parents could watch their children playing in the adjacent playground.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook werd het zitmeubilair volledig vernieuwd en zodanig geplaatst dat ouders hun kinderen in de speeltuin goed in de gaten kunnen houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The seating furniture was also completely renewed and placed in such a way that parents can keep a close eye on their children in the playground.

features.opening: The Wachterliedplantsoen is a park in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West.

features.name: Hoeckelingsdam

facts.text: Construction occurred between 2003 and 2005 to compensate for the IJburg district.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hoeckelingsdam is tussen 2003 en 2005 aangelegd als natuurcompensatie voor de aanleg van de Amsterdamse wijk IJburg, die aan de overzijde van het IJmeer ligt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hoeckelingsdam was built between 2003 and 2005 as a nature compensation for the construction of the Amsterdam district of IJburg, which is located across the IJmeer.

facts.text: Engineers designed it to partially submerge underwater and occasionally flood.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hoeckelingsdam werd ontworpen om deels onder water te verdwijnen en af en toe te overstromen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hoeckelingsdam was designed to partially disappear underwater and occasionally flood.

facts.text: Staatsbosbeheer originally sought nature compensation opportunities along the Waterland coast.
facts.sourceQuote: Voorafgaand aan de aanleg van de dam zocht Staatsbosbeheer naar mogelijkheden voor natuurcompensatie langs de Waterlandse kust.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prior to the construction of the dam, Staatsbosbeheer was looking for opportunities for nature compensation along the Waterland coast.

facts.text: By 2005, the IJsselmeer Area Directorate of Rijkswaterstaat owned and technically managed the site.
facts.sourceQuote: Gegevens uit 2005 noemen de directie IJsselmeergebied van Rijkswaterstaat als eigenaar en technisch beheerder, en Staatsbosbeheer als natuurbeheerder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Data from 2005 name the IJsselmeer Area Directorate of Rijkswaterstaat as the owner and technical manager, and Staatsbosbeheer as the nature manager.

features.opening: The Hoeckelingsdam is a low, 1.6 kilometer long dam in the IJmeer, intended to create calm water between the dam and the Uitdammerdijk and thereby increase the…

features.name: Sarphatipark

facts.text: Painter Mommie Schwarz lived near this park until his deportation and execution at Auschwitz in 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch painter Mommie Schwarz and his wife Else Berg lived adjacent to the park from 1927 until their deportation to, and execution at, the Auschwitz concentration camp in 1942.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch painter Mommie Schwarz and his wife Else Berg lived adjacent to the park from 1927 until their deportation to, and execution at, the Auschwitz concentration camp in 1942.

facts.text: Some of Mommie Schwarz's final artworks were landscape paintings depicting the park itself.
facts.sourceQuote: Some of their last works were landscape paintings of the park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some of their last works were landscape paintings of the park.

features.opening: The Sarphatipark (Dutch pronunciation: [sɑrˈfaːtiˌpɑr(ə)k]) is a public urban park located in the stadsdeel Amsterdam Oud-Zuid in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Park Somerlust

facts.text: Park Somerlust and Bella Vistapark both take their names from former country estates along the Amstel.
facts.sourceQuote: Zowel Park Somerlust als het Bella Vistapark ontlenen hun naam aan voormalige buitenplaatsen langs de Amstel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both Park Somerlust and the Bella Vistapark derive their names from former country estates along the Amstel.

facts.text: Stacked natural stone blocks form swimming stairs where people can easily access the water for a dip.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een oever van gestapelde natuurstenen blokken ('zwemtrappen') is het een van de weinige recreatielocaties in de stad waar natuurwater eenvoudig toegankelijk is om te zwemmen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a bank of stacked natural stone blocks ('swimming stairs'), it is one of the few recreational locations in the city where natural water is easily accessible for swimming.

facts.text: Until 2019, the park included territory that later became part of the neighboring Bella Vistapark.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 2019 was het park iets groter, want het omvatte toen ook een deel van het grondgebied dat bij het Bella Vistapark werd gevoegd toen dat opgericht werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 2019, the park was slightly larger, because it also included part of the territory that was added to Bella Vistapark when it was established.

facts.text: A 1966 landmark for rowing club RIC features a sloping river section and screened terrace.
facts.sourceQuote: Een daarvan is een gezichtsbepalend gebouw aan de Amstel uit 1966 ontworpen door architecten Ab Gmelig Meyling en Piet Zanstra voor roeivereniging RIC. Opvallend is het schuin oplopend gedeelte aan de rivier en de afscherming van een terras.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of these is a landmark building on the Amstel from 1966 designed by architects Ab Gmelig Meyling and Piet Zanstra for rowing club RIC. Notable is the sloping section on the river and the screening of a terrace.

facts.text: Architects Ab Gmelig Meyling and Piet Zanstra designed the 1966 building for the rowing club.
facts.sourceQuote: Een daarvan is een gezichtsbepalend gebouw aan de Amstel uit 1966 ontworpen door architecten Ab Gmelig Meyling en Piet Zanstra voor roeivereniging RIC.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of these is a landmark building on the Amstel from 1966 designed by architects Ab Gmelig Meyling and Piet Zanstra for rowing club RIC.

facts.text: The former Zuidergasfabriek engineering house was renovated into restaurant tHUIS on the Amstel.
facts.sourceQuote: De voormalige ingenieurswoning van de Zuidergasfabriek is gerenoveerd tot restaurant tHUIS aan de AMSTEL.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former engineering house of the Zuidergasfabriek has been renovated into a restaurant tHUIS on the AMSTEL.

features.opening: Park Somerlust is a park in Amsterdam-Oost

features.name: Beatrixpark

facts.text: Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder designed the park's oldest section.
facts.sourceQuote: The design for the oldest part of the park was by the Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design for the oldest part of the park was by the Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder.

facts.text: Beatrixpark honors former Dutch Queen Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuote: The park was named after the former Dutch Queen Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was named after the former Dutch Queen Beatrix.

facts.text: In 1972, part of the park hosted the Floriade exhibition.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1972, part of the park, together with the Amstelpark, was the site of the Floriade garden and agricultural exhibition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1972, part of the park, together with the Amstelpark, was the site of the Floriade garden and agricultural exhibition.

features.opening: The Beatrixpark is a park in the Amsterdam-Zuid borough and is located in the "Prinses Irenebuurt" residential area.

features.name: Museum Square

facts.text: A 1999 reconstruction by Sven-Ingvar Andersson added underground parking and a supermarket beneath the square.
facts.sourceQuote: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.

facts.text: The famous I AMsterdam sign stood here until December 2018 when the city council ordered its removal.
facts.sourceQuote: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.

features.opening: The Museumplein (Dutch pronunciation: [myˌzeːjʏmˈplɛin]; English: Museum Square) is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid…

features.name: Professor Joop van Stigtpark

facts.text: The surrounding flats were designed by architect Joop van Stigt around 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze verzameling flats werd rond 1974 gebouwd naar ontwerp van architect Joop van Stigt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This collection of flats was built around 1974 according to the design of architect Joop van Stigt.

facts.text: A district council member unveiled the street sign alongside the architect's son in December 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Het “straatnaambord” werd op 13 december 2013 onthuld door een van de stadsdeelraadsleden in aanwezigheid van zoon André van Stigt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The "street sign" was unveiled on December 13, 2013 by one of the borough council members in the presence of son André van Stigt.

features.opening: Professor Joop van Stigtpark is the unofficial name of a park-like environment in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Bijlmerweide

facts.text: Bijlmerweide contains only a single house number, which belongs to the Bird and Mammal Shelter De Toevlucht.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bijlmerweide kent slechts één huisnummer. Op nummer 1 is gevestigd "Vogel- en zoogdierenopvang De Toevlucht", dat gevestigd is op een eiland in het park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bijlmerweide only has one house number. Number 1 is home to "Bird and Mammal Shelter De Toevlucht", which is located on an island in the park.

facts.text: A bicycle and pedestrian bridge named Veeneik connects the park to Diemerbos across the Gaasp river.
facts.sourceQuote: De Veeneikbrug, een fiets- en voetgangersbrug, verbindt de Bijlmerweide over de Gaasp met het Diemerbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Veeneik Bridge, a bicycle and pedestrian bridge, connects the Bijlmerweide over the Gaasp to the Diemerbos.

facts.text: The Veeneik Bridge serves as a dedicated crossing for cyclists and pedestrians over the Gaasp stream.
facts.sourceQuote: De Veeneikbrug, een fiets- en voetgangersbrug, verbindt de Bijlmerweide over de Gaasp met het Diemerbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Veeneik Bridge, a bicycle and pedestrian bridge, connects the Bijlmerweide over the Gaasp to the Diemerbos.

features.opening: The Bijlmerweide is a park in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Botanical Garden Zuidas

facts.text: Widespread protests in 2010 saved the garden from removal by a hospital expansion plan.
facts.sourceQuote: The garden's existence was threatened in 2009, when plans for an expansion of the university hospital called for it to be removed. In 2010, after widespread popular protest, the VU announced the garden could remain.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden's existence was threatened in 2009, when plans for an expansion of the university hospital called for it to be removed. In 2010, after widespread popular protest, the VU announced the garden could remain.

facts.text: The garden houses roughly 10,000 species including carnivorous plants and orchids.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection includes about 10,000 species, such as varieties of hardy ferns, cacti and succulents. There is also a collection of carnivorous plants and orchids.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection includes about 10,000 species, such as varieties of hardy ferns, cacti and succulents. There is also a collection of carnivorous plants and orchids.

facts.text: Botanical Garden Zuidas adopted its current name in 2016 to reflect the surrounding development area.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the garden changed its name from Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (which was often abbreviated to VU-Hortus) to its current name, after the better known Zuidas development area it is in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the garden changed its name from Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (which was often abbreviated to VU-Hortus) to its current name, after the better known Zuidas development area it is in.

features.opening: The Botanic Garden Zuidas (Dutch: Botanische tuin Zuidas) is a botanical garden belonging to Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Julianapark

facts.text: A section of the original grounds once featured grazing cows on grassland.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van het park bleef weidelandschap met grazende koeien.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the park remained grassland with grazing cows.

features.opening: The Julianapark, named in 1939 after Princess Juliana, was a park but is now a residential area in Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer.

features.name: Park De Kuil

facts.text: Engineers drained sewage-leaking dikes and excavated wet spots to create ponds.
facts.sourceQuote: Er waren veel problemen bij de aanleg omdat de dijk die om het park loopt kwelwater lekte. De grond moest gedraineerd worden en de natte plekken werden uitgegraven, daarmee ontstonden er vijvers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were many problems during construction because the dike that runs around the park was leaking sewage. The ground had to be drained and the wet spots were excavated, creating ponds.

facts.text: Hans Mantje created the two-part artwork Plastic in landscape standing in the park's center.
facts.sourceQuote: Midden in het park staat/ligt het tweedelige kunstwerk Plastiek in landschap van Hans Mantje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the middle of the park stands/lies the two-part artwork Plastic in landscape by Hans Mantje.

facts.text: The Tower Gate Bridge from 1995 was designed by Gert Vos and counts as both a bridge and artwork.
facts.sourceQuote: Een kunstwerk wat in beide categorieën geplaatst is, is brug 1828, de zogenaamde Torenpoortbrug uit 1995 geplaatst naar een ontwerp van Gert Vos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A work of art that is placed in both categories is bridge 1828, the so-called Tower Gate Bridge from 1995 placed according to a design by Gert Vos.

facts.text: Small bridges numbered 2382 and 2396 are also situated within the park grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park liggen voorts de kleine bruggen 2382 en 2396.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park are also the small bridges 2382 and 2396.

features.opening: Park de Kuil is a park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

features.name: Rietlandpark

facts.text: Rietlandpark was named in 2005 after the Stads Rietlanden, meaning City Reeds.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Rietlandpark in Amsterdam-Oost kreeg zijn naam in 2005 en is vernoemd naar de Stads Rietlanden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Rietlandpark in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 2005 and is named after the Stads Rietlanden.

facts.text: Until 1880, this area was an uninhabited swamp covered in reeds outside the dikes.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit was tot omstreeks 1880 een buitendijks onbebouwd, deels moerassig en met riet begroeid gebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until around 1880, this was an uninhabited, partly swampy and reed-covered area outside the dikes.

features.opening: The Rietlandpark in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 2005 and is named after the Stads Rietlanden.

features.name: Snodenhoekpark

facts.text: Construction occurred in the mid-1980s alongside the Reigersbos district.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park is midden jaren 80 aangelegd, gelijktijdig met de wijk Reigersbos, onderdeel van Gaasperdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was built in the mid-1980s, at the same time as the Reigersbos district, part of Gaasperdam.

features.opening: The Snodenhoekpark is a small park and a street in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Staalmanpark

facts.text: Abraham Staalman is the namesake for both the square and the adjacent park located nearby.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park ligt 200 meter ten westen van het Abraham Staalmanplein met dezelfde naamgever: Abraham Staalman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is located 200 meters west of the Abraham Staalmanplein with the same namesake: Abraham Staalman.

facts.text: Two 2008 buildings by Architects Bureau Onix house the Einstein School.
facts.sourceQuote: Staalmanpark 10 en 12, ontworpen door Architectenbureau Onix uit Groningen en gebouwd in 2008/2009 biedt onderdak aan de Einsteinschool.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Staalmanpark 10 and 12, designed by Architects Bureau Onix from Groningen and built in 2008/2009, provide accommodation for the Einstein School.

facts.text: Groningen architects designed the school accommodation built in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: Staalmanpark 10 en 12, ontworpen door Architectenbureau Onix uit Groningen en gebouwd in 2008/2009 biedt onderdak aan de Einsteinschool.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Staalmanpark 10 and 12, designed by Architects Bureau Onix from Groningen and built in 2008/2009, provide accommodation for the Einstein School.

features.opening: The Staalmanpark is a city park in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

features.name: Lutkemeerpark

facts.text: Straight ditches and plots mark the northern part as former arable land.
facts.sourceQuote: Het noordelijk deel is meer gestructureerd als een voormalig akkerbouwgebied (rechte sloten en kavels).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northern part is more structured as a former arable land area (straight ditches and plots).

facts.text: The long-distance Noord-Hollandpad walking route runs directly through this green space.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Noord-Hollandpad, wandelroute van Texel tot Huizen voert door het park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Noord-Hollandpad, walking route from Texel to Huizen, runs through the park.

facts.text: Unpaved paths, grit trails, and elevated grassland cross the watery area.
facts.sourceQuote: Het waterig gebied wordt doorsneden door meest onverharde wandelpaden, soms bestrooid met grit, soms onbestrooid en soms ook gewoon bestaand uit verhoogd grasland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The watery area is crossed by mostly unpaved walking paths, sometimes covered with grit, sometimes unpaved and sometimes simply consisting of elevated grassland.

features.opening: The Lutkemeerpark is the unofficial name of a park in the west of the Lutkemeerpolder.

features.name: Amstelpark

facts.text: In 1968, the earlier northern site known as Amstelpark was renamed Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuote: An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.

facts.text: The Amsterdam City Archives label historical images of the old northern site as 'Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark'.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam City Archives consequently describes historical images of that site as "Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam City Archives consequently describes historical images of that site as "Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark".

facts.text: The name Amstelpark was subsequently transferred to the new park developed in Buitenveldert for the Floriade.
facts.sourceQuote: The name was subsequently given to the new park developed for the Floriade in Buitenveldert.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name was subsequently given to the new park developed for the Floriade in Buitenveldert.

facts.text: Amstelpark was built quickly for a major international exhibition, leaving visible broad routes and specialized gardens.
facts.sourceQuote: Unlike many older Amsterdam parks, the Amstelpark was largely designed and constructed within a relatively short period for a major international exhibition. Its Floriade origins remain visible in its broad circulation routes, sequences of specialised gardens, open lawns, ponds and dense belts of trees and shrubs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike many older Amsterdam parks, the Amstelpark was largely designed and constructed within a relatively short period for a major international exhibition. Its Floriade origins remain visible in its broad circulation routes, sequences of specialised gardens, open lawns, ponds and dense belts of trees and shrubs.

facts.text: A Roman garden with classical columns survives as a clear example of the original international section.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the most important surviving elements identified in heritage research are the woodland margins, the principal path system, sightlines, the Rhododendron Valley and a group of gardens originally representing capitals of the then European Economic Community. The Roman garden is among the clearest surviving examples of this international section and includes a sequence of columns recalling a classical pergola.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the most important surviving elements identified in heritage research are the woodland margins, the principal path system, sightlines, the Rhododendron Valley and a group of gardens originally representing capitals of the then European Economic Community. The Roman garden is among the clearest surviving examples of this international section and includes a sequence of columns recalling a classical pergola.

features.opening: The Amstelpark is a 45-hectare (110-acre) urban park in Buitenveldert-Oost, in the borough of Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

features.name: Hollandse Tuin

facts.text: Four central paths lead to a circular enclosure surrounded by hedges and decorative vases.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin kreeg een vierkante opzet, met vier middenpaden die naar een centraal rond perk leidden, heggetjes en siervazen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden was laid out in a square shape, with four central paths leading to a central circular enclosure, hedges and decorative vases.

facts.text: Sculptor Bart van Hove created an eight-meter monument for director Westerman's successor.
facts.sourceQuote: Het acht meter hoge gedenkteken werd gemaakt door beeldhouwer Bart van Hove in opdracht van Westermans opvolger Coenraad Kerbert. De vrouwenfiguur en leeuw onderaan lijken te verwijzen naar de bekende allegorie van de Hollandse maagd en de 'Leo Belgicus'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The eight-meter-high monument was made by sculptor Bart van Hove at the request of Westermans' successor Coenraad Kerbert. The female figure and lion at the bottom seem to refer to the well-known allegory of the Hollandse virgin and the 'Leo Belgicus'.

facts.text: A female figure and lion at the base reference the allegory of the Hollandse virgin and Leo Belgicus.
facts.sourceQuote: De vrouwenfiguur en leeuw onderaan lijken te verwijzen naar de bekende allegorie van de Hollandse maagd en de 'Leo Belgicus'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The female figure and lion at the bottom seem to refer to the well-known allegory of the Hollandse virgin and the 'Leo Belgicus'.

facts.text: The garden was originally twice as large with four axles leading to a central enclosure.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hollandse Tuin was aanvankelijk een stuk groter, met vier assen die leidden naar een centraal rond perk. De huidige tuin is ongeveer half zo groot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hollandse Tuin was initially much larger, with four axles leading to a central circular enclosure. The current garden is about half the size.

facts.text: Marble statues of the four seasons stand in corners on natural stone bases.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de hoeken, aan weerszijden van de middenas, staan 19e-eeuwse marmeren beelden, allegorische voorstellingen van de vier seizoenen, op natuurstenen sokkels met profielen en spaarvelden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the corners, on either side of the central axis, stand 19th-century marble statues, allegorical representations of the four seasons, on natural stone bases with profiles and recessed fields.

facts.text: Original benches featured cast iron legs shaped like tree branches.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tuin staan stonden oorspronkelijk tuinbanken met gietijzeren poten in de vorm van takken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the garden there were originally garden benches with cast iron legs in the shape of branches.

features.opening: The Hollandse Tuin is a 19th-century monumental garden within the Amsterdam zoo Artis.

features.name: Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark

facts.text: Elevated rope bridges allow red squirrels to cross roads between the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.
facts.sourceQuote: Wildlife crossings have been installed across several roads cutting through the corridor. These include elevated rope bridges that allow red squirrels to move between trees on opposite sides of the roads and between the larger habitats of the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wildlife crossings have been installed across several roads cutting through the corridor. These include elevated rope bridges that allow red squirrels to move between trees on opposite sides of the roads and between the larger habitats of the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.

features.opening: The Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark is a linear urban park in Buitenveldert, in the borough of Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

features.name: Vondelpark

facts.text: Songs by Acda en De Munnik, Omar Rodríguez-López, and John Craigie all feature Vondelpark in their titles.
facts.sourceQuote: The park is referenced in Acda en De Munnik's song "Vondelpark vannacht" from the album Acda en De Munnik (1997), in Omar Rodríguez-López's song "Vondelpark bij nacht" from the album Omar Rodriguez (2005) and in John Craigie's song "Vondelpark" from the album Working On My Farewell (2015).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is referenced in Acda en De Munnik's song "Vondelpark vannacht" from the album Acda en De Munnik (1997), in Omar Rodríguez-López's song "Vondelpark bij nacht" from the album Omar Rodriguez (2005) and in John Craigie's song "Vondelpark" from the album Working On My Farewell (2015).

facts.text: The English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name directly from the park.
facts.sourceQuote: The English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name from the park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name from the park.

facts.text: Since the 1970s, a growing population of feral rose-ringed parakeets has inhabited the area.
facts.sourceQuote: English Indie musician Jess Kemp has a single titled 'Vondelpark' Since the 1970s the park has a growing population of feral rose-ringed parakeets.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: English Indie musician Jess Kemp has a single titled 'Vondelpark' Since the 1970s the park has a growing population of feral rose-ringed parakeets.

facts.text: Vondelpark honors Joost van den Vondel, a 17th-century playwright and poet.
facts.sourceQuote: The park was opened in 1865 and originally named Nieuwe Park (English: New Park), but later renamed Vondelpark, after the 17th-century playwright and poet Joost van den Vondel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was opened in 1865 and originally named Nieuwe Park (English: New Park), but later renamed Vondelpark, after the 17th-century playwright and poet Joost van den Vondel.

facts.text: Approximately ten million people visit this urban green space every year.
facts.sourceQuote: The park has around 10 million visitors annually.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park has around 10 million visitors annually.

facts.text: An open-air theatre sits within the park alongside playgrounds and food facilities.
facts.sourceQuote: Within the park is an open-air theatre, a playground and several food service facilities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Within the park is an open-air theatre, a playground and several food service facilities.

features.opening: The Vondelpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈvɔndəlˌpɑr(ə)k]) is a public urban park of 47 hectares (120 acres) in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Deutzenhofje

facts.text: Agneta Deutz founded the hofje for her old servants and poor relations using her own bequest.
facts.sourceQuote: The hofje was built in 1692 from the proceeds of the bequest by Agneta Deutz, who had purchased the land and named the regents before her death. She intended it to be used by old servants and poor relations.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hofje was built in 1692 from the proceeds of the bequest by Agneta Deutz, who had purchased the land and named the regents before her death. She intended it to be used by old servants and poor relations.

facts.text: An old pump remains in the garden alongside flowers planted during summer months.
facts.sourceQuote: The garden has an old pump and is planted with flowers in the summer months.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden has an old pump and is planted with flowers in the summer months.

facts.text: Only the richly ornamented middle gate was used by pensioners, while outer houses served as rentals.
facts.sourceQuote: Three double canal mansions on the Prinsengracht are part of the hofje, but only the richly ornamented middle gate was used by the hofje pensioners. The two outer double houses are rental homes that add to the hofje's income.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three double canal mansions on the Prinsengracht are part of the hofje, but only the richly ornamented middle gate was used by the hofje pensioners. The two outer double houses are rental homes that add to the hofje's income.

facts.text: Three double canal mansions on the Prinsengracht form part of this hofje complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Three double canal mansions on the Prinsengracht are part of the hofje, but only the richly ornamented middle gate was used by the hofje pensioners.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three double canal mansions on the Prinsengracht are part of the hofje, but only the richly ornamented middle gate was used by the hofje pensioners.

features.opening: The Deutzen Hofje or Deutzenhofje is a 17th-century hofje on the Prinsengracht 857 in Amsterdam.

features.name: Sloterpark

facts.text: Construction of the area occurred between 1958 and 1974 under the General Enlargement Plan.
facts.sourceQuote: It is the heart of the Westelijke Tuinsteden ("Western Garden Cities"), built between 1958 and 1974 as part of the implementation of the General Enlargement Plan of 1935 (Algemeen Uitbreidingsplan). it is based on the organizational logic desired by Cornelis van Eesteren for his garden cities, built around four axes: housing, employment, leisure and transport.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the heart of the Westelijke Tuinsteden ("Western Garden Cities"), built between 1958 and 1974 as part of the implementation of the General Enlargement Plan of 1935 (Algemeen Uitbreidingsplan). it is based on the organizational logic desired by Cornelis van Eesteren for his garden cities, built around four axes: housing, employment, leisure and transport.

facts.text: The layout follows four axes for housing, employment, leisure, and transport designed by Cornelis van Eesteren.
facts.sourceQuote: It is the heart of the Westelijke Tuinsteden ("Western Garden Cities"), built between 1958 and 1974 as part of the implementation of the General Enlargement Plan of 1935 (Algemeen Uitbreidingsplan). it is based on the organizational logic desired by Cornelis van Eesteren for his garden cities, built around four axes: housing, employment, leisure and transport.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the heart of the Westelijke Tuinsteden ("Western Garden Cities"), built between 1958 and 1974 as part of the implementation of the General Enlargement Plan of 1935 (Algemeen Uitbreidingsplan). it is based on the organizational logic desired by Cornelis van Eesteren for his garden cities, built around four axes: housing, employment, leisure and transport.

facts.text: Skaters can use a dedicated skatepark along the lake's walking and cycling trail.
facts.sourceQuote: There is a trail for walkers, joggers, cyclists and skaters called the 'Rondje Sloterplas' around the lake. Along the route is exercise equipment, a skatepark and a football pitch.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a trail for walkers, joggers, cyclists and skaters called the 'Rondje Sloterplas' around the lake. Along the route is exercise equipment, a skatepark and a football pitch.

facts.text: The lake features a beach area adjacent to a swimming pool with a paddling section.
facts.sourceQuote: The lake has a beach with a nearby swimming pool which includes an outdoor pool, a paddling pool, a sunbathing area and a playground.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lake has a beach with a nearby swimming pool which includes an outdoor pool, a paddling pool, a sunbathing area and a playground.

features.opening: Sloterpark is an urban park in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Rembrandtpark

facts.text: Observers have recorded 37 distinct bird species here.
facts.sourceQuote: In the park, 37 bird species including the common buzzard (Buteo buteo), 35 bee species including the orange-horned nomad bee (Nomada fulvicornis), and 6 bat species including the pond bat (Myotis dasycneme) have been observed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park, 37 bird species including the common buzzard (Buteo buteo), 35 bee species including the orange-horned nomad bee (Nomada fulvicornis), and 6 bat species including the pond bat (Myotis dasycneme) have been observed.

facts.text: Jan van Galenstraat, Postjesweg, and Cornelis Lelylaan cross the park east to west.
facts.sourceQuote: The elongated park is crossed from east to west by the streets Jan van Galenstraat, Postjesweg, and Cornelis Lelylaan, which divides the park into four sections.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The elongated park is crossed from east to west by the streets Jan van Galenstraat, Postjesweg, and Cornelis Lelylaan, which divides the park into four sections.

features.opening: Rembrandtpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈrɛmbrɑntˌpɑr(ə)k]) is an urban park in Nieuw-West, Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen

facts.text: The garden was laid out in 1972 on the site of a demolished church whose foundation remains are still visible.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen is in 1972 aangelegd op het terrein van de in 1968 gesloopte Maria Magdelenakerk, waarvan de funderingsresten nog in het park terug te vinden zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden was laid out in 1972 on the site of the Maria Magdalenakerk, which was demolished in 1968, whose foundation remains can still be found in the park.

facts.text: Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen received its name in 1972 because Ferdinand Domela Nieuwenhuis once lived nearby on the Haarlemmerdijk.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen kreeg op 20 december 1972 op verzoek van de bewoners deze naam omdat Domela Nieuwenhuis in de nabijheid op de Haarlemmerdijk had gewoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was given this name on December 20, 1972 at the request of the residents because Domela Nieuwenhuis had lived nearby on the Haarlemmerdijk.

facts.text: Renovations added reproduced arcades to complement the original boundary markers.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen nagebootste oude boogmuren die de oorspronkelijke aanvulden als terreinafscheiding.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Reproduced old arcades were added to complement the original ones as a boundary marker.

facts.text: A historic blue postbox designed by Anton Kurvers in Amsterdam School style stands within the garden.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is tevens een historische blauwe gemeentegirobus te vinden, ontworpen door Anton Kurvers in de stijl van de Amsterdamse School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a historic blue municipal postbox to be found, designed by Anton Kurvers in the style of the Amsterdam School.

features.opening: The Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen is a small garden in the shape of a triangle in the Spaarndammerbuurt neighborhood in Amsterdam-West.

features.name: Diemerpark

facts.text: Engineers wrapped the polluted soil underground with sheet piles and covered it with bentonite clay and foil.
facts.sourceQuote: Because of the extent of the pollution, the area was "wrapped" underground by sheet piles and covered with a waterproof top layer consisting of bentonite clay and foil. The park was built on top of that.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because of the extent of the pollution, the area was "wrapped" underground by sheet piles and covered with a waterproof top layer consisting of bentonite clay and foil. The park was built on top of that.

facts.text: Amsterdam avoided legal prosecution by paying 100,000 euros to the Dutch state regarding the illegal dumping.
facts.sourceQuote: The chemical waste was dumped illegally for years. The municipality of Amsterdam was able to avoid legal prosecution in a settlement procedure (Dutch: "schikking") by paying 100,000 euros to the Dutch state.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chemical waste was dumped illegally for years. The municipality of Amsterdam was able to avoid legal prosecution in a settlement procedure (Dutch: "schikking") by paying 100,000 euros to the Dutch state.

features.opening: Diemerpark is the largest urban park in Amsterdam with an area of around 90 hectares, making it about twice as large as the famous Vondelpark in…

features.name: Naardermeer

facts.text: The Vecht river's regular flooding created the Naardermeer's outlines roughly 4000 years ago.
facts.sourceQuote: De meeste andere huidige wateren in West-Nederland zijn pas enkele eeuwen geleden door turfwinning ontstaan, maar de eerste contouren van het Naardermeer ontstonden al ongeveer 4000 jaar geleden doordat de Vecht, die voor de twaalfde eeuw via moerasgebieden en binnenmeren naar een uitgestrekt Waddengebied stroomde, geregeld buiten zijn oevers trad en daarbij grote stukken uit de venige oevers sloeg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Most other current waters in western the Netherlands were only created by peat mining a few centuries ago, but the first outlines of the Naardermeer already existed about 4000 years ago because the Vecht, which flowed through swamp areas and inland lakes to an extensive Wadden Sea area before the twelfth century, regularly overflowed its banks and cut large sections off the marshy banks.

facts.text: An 1383 dam at Uitermeer cut off tidal influence from the Zuiderzee completely.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1383 werd de verbinding tussen de Vecht en het Naardermeer nabij het gehucht Uitermeer afgedamd door de bouw van de Uitermeerse dam. Hierdoor werd de invloed van de Zuiderzee uitgebannen en was er niet langer sprake van eb en vloed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1383, the connection between the Vecht and the Naardermeer near the hamlet of Uitermeer was dammed by the construction of the Uitermeerse dam. This eliminated the influence of the Zuiderzee and there was no longer any ebb and flow.

features.opening: The Naardermeer is a protected nature reserve on the northwestern border of the Gooi, located between Muiderberg, Naarden, Hilversumse Meent and Weesp, in the…

features.name: Natuurpark Vrije Geer

facts.text: Original landscape remnants vanished after Western Garden Cities construction in the 1950s.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de bouw van de Westelijke Tuinsteden in de jaren vijftig bleef er van het oorspronkelijke landschap weinig over.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the construction of the Western Garden Cities in the 1950s, little remained of the original landscape.

facts.text: A tram line was planned to connect Nieuw Sloten with the new district De Aker.
facts.sourceQuote: Tevens zou er een tramverbinding komen van Nieuw Sloten naar de Middelveldsche Akerpolder, waar de nieuwe wijk De Aker werd gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There would also be a tram connection from Nieuw Sloten to the Middelveldsche Akerpolder, where the new district De Aker was built.

features.opening: The Natuurpark Vrije Geer is a small green area near the village of Sloten with an area of more than 4 hectares.

features.name: Heemtuin Sloterpark

facts.text: The terrain was elevated in the 1950s before remaining untouched for a long time.
facts.sourceQuote: Na ophoging van het terrein in de jaren vijftig bleef dit gebied lange tijd onaangeroerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the elevation of the terrain in the 1950s, this area remained untouched for a long time.

facts.text: Wild plants, reeds, and willows spontaneously developed on this rough area.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier ontwikkelde zich spontaan een ruig gebied met wilde planten, riet en wilgen.
