facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here a rough area with wild plants, reeds and willows spontaneously developed.

facts.text: Construction of the community garden began in 1975 when the first trees were planted.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de aanleg van de heemtuin werd in 1975 begonnen, toen de eerste bomen werden geplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the community garden began in 1975, when the first trees were planted.

facts.text: Soil from elsewhere including peat, sand, clay and chalk was brought in to create varied conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna werden er hoogteverschillen in het terrein gemaakt en ook grond van elders werd aangevoerd, zoals veen, zand, klei en mergelkalk, zodat in zeer gevarieerde milieuomstandigheden een keur aan plantensoorten kon worden ingezaaid en geplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, height differences were made in the terrain and soil from elsewhere was also brought in, such as peat, sand, clay and chalk, so that a variety of plant species could be sown and planted in very varied environmental conditions.

facts.text: Special species found here include purple burdock, yellow-white ox tongue and elderberry.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tuin komen bijzondere soorten voor zoals de paarse schubwortel, geelwitte ossentong en de eenbes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Special species occur in the garden such as the purple burdock, yellow-white ox tongue and the elderberry.

facts.text: A Nature and Environment Education Center called 'Floating Ice' was built in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de heemtuin is in 2006 een Natuur en Milieu Educatiecentrum (NME) verrezen, de 'Drijfsijs'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the community garden, a Nature and Environment Education Center (NME) was built in 2006, the 'Floating Ice'.

features.opening: The Heemtuin Sloterpark is located in the Sloterpark west of the Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

features.name: Frederik Hendrikplantsoen

facts.text: Recent extensive investment and redevelopment occurred after consultation with the local community.
facts.sourceQuote: The park is located in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt Neighbourhood and has recently undergone extensive investment and redevelopment in consultation with the local community.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is located in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt Neighbourhood and has recently undergone extensive investment and redevelopment in consultation with the local community.

features.opening: Frederik Hendrikplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam West, on the edge of the Jordaan in one of the greenest historic neighbourhoods of Amsterdam.

features.name: Park Frankendael

facts.text: Izaak Balde named the estate Frankendael after his grandfather's refuge in Frankenthal.
facts.sourceQuote: Balde named the estate Frankendael, a name derived from Frankenthal, a place of refuge for Protestants near Worms, where his grandfather had found hospitality.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Balde named the estate Frankendael, a name derived from Frankenthal, a place of refuge for Protestants near Worms, where his grandfather had found hospitality.

facts.text: The gardens hosted open-air theatre performances between 1927 and 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 1927 and 1956, the gardens of the villa hosted open-air theatre performances in the summer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1927 and 1956, the gardens of the villa hosted open-air theatre performances in the summer.

facts.text: Only two buitenplaats country estates remain in all of Amsterdam today.
facts.sourceQuote: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).

facts.text: The historic house now operates as a restaurant and event venue.
facts.sourceQuote: The building houses a restaurant and rooms that are used for various events.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building houses a restaurant and rooms that are used for various events.

features.opening: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).

features.name: Westerpark

facts.text: The city ended the gas concession in 1898 and added a coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuote: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.

facts.text: Architect Isaac Gosschalk designed the buildings under director Pazzani's supervision.
facts.sourceQuote: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.

facts.text: The current neighborhood and former borough share the park's name, Westerpark.
facts.sourceQuote: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.

facts.text: The verdant space of the former gasworks now hosts cultural avant-garde businesses and events.
facts.sourceQuote: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.

features.opening: The Westerpark (English: Western Park) is a public urban park in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: De Krommert

facts.text: A tram bridge over the ditch, numbered 249, was built in 1904 when tracks were laid.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen de tramlijn Amsterdam - Haarlem - Zandvoort in 1904 door de ESM werd aangelegd kwam er een brug over De Krommert; deze kreeg brugnummer 249.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Amsterdam - Haarlem - Zandvoort tram line was laid by the ESM in 1904, a bridge was built over De Krommert; this was given bridge number 249.

facts.text: Two sections of the Admiraal de Ruijterweg stand next to each other at almost a right angle.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarbij staan twee delen van de Admiraal de Ruijterweg in een bijna rechte hoek op elkaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Two parts of the Admiraal de Ruijterweg are standing next to each other at almost a right angle.

facts.text: Tram lines 12 and 14 were replaced by line 19 on July 22, 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 22 juli 2018 verdwenen de tramlijnen 12 en 14 en kwam tramlijn 19 er voor in de plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On July 22, 2018, tram lines 12 and 14 disappeared and tram line 19 took their place.

facts.text: A left turn prohibition onto the Admiraal de Ruijterweg lasted from 1966 until 1982.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 14 november 1966 tot 18 mei 1982 was er vanuit de Jan Evertsenstraat in verband met de beschikbare ruimte en onoverzichtelijke situatie een linksafverbod naar de Admiraal de Ruijterweg waarbij buslijn 15 richting Sloterdijk over de oostelijke kade van de Admiralengracht reed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From November 14, 1966 to May 18, 1982, there was a left turn prohibition onto the Admiraal de Ruijterweg from Jan Evertsenstraat due to the available space and unclear situation, where bus line 15 ran over the eastern quay of the Admiralengracht towards Sloterdijk.

features.opening: De Krommert (also known as De Krommerdt) is a neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, named after the De Krommert waterway.

features.name: Siegerpark

facts.text: Anna Laura Doris de Greeff, Sieger's wife, opened the grounds with a garden and playground.
facts.sourceQuote: Siegers vrouw, Anna Laura Doris de Greeff opende het terrein met een siertuin, bijentuin, proeftuin en speeltuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Siegers' wife, Anna Laura Doris de Greeff, opened the grounds with a garden, bee garden, tasting garden and playground.

facts.text: A 1941 magazine noted the location was safe because Amsterdam would never reach this place.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1941 constateerde het weekblad Panorama dat de plek een “veilige” was, want de stad Amsterdam zou deze plek nooit bereiken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1941, the weekly magazine Panorama noted that the place was a "safe" one, because the city of Amsterdam would never reach this place.

facts.text: The Sieger family sold the land to Amsterdam in 1950 for tax value.
facts.sourceQuote: De grond werd in 1950 door de familie Sieger voor de taxatiewaarde aan de Gemeente Amsterdam verkocht, op voorwaarde dat het terrein altijd de functie van park zou behouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The land was sold in 1950 by the Sieger family to the Municipality of Amsterdam for the tax assessment value, provided that the site would always retain the function of a park.

facts.text: The youth series SpangaS filmed scenes here between 2011 and 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Siegerpark was van 2011 tot en met 2014 een aantal keren het decor voor de jeugdserie SpangaS.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Siegerpark was the setting for the youth series SpangaS several times from 2011 to 2014.

facts.text: The Hortus Botanicus used this park as a test garden for tree cultivation.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam gebruikte het als proeftuin en voor het kwekerij van bomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam used it as a test garden and for the cultivation of trees.

features.opening: The Siegerpark is a small city park on the Sloterweg in the Riekerpolder in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

features.name: Noorderpark

facts.text: West 8 designed a maple leaf motif appearing on railings, paths, and concrete to unify the combined park.
facts.sourceQuote: West 8 ontwierp ook een thema voor het park bestaande uit een hederabladerenmotief dat in het park op verschillende plekken terugkomt, waaronder in metalen brugleuningen en hekwerken, versiering op de paden en als 3D-motief in beton.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: West 8 also designed a theme for the park consisting of a maple leaf motif that recurs in the park in various places, including in metal bridge railings and fencing, decoration on the paths and as a 3D motif in concrete.

facts.text: The Noorderparkbad replaced the outdated Floraparkbad in the former Florapark area.
facts.sourceQuote: In het parkdeel ten westen van het Noordhollandsch Kanaal (voormalig Florapark) is ter vervanging van het gedateerde Floraparkbad een nieuw openbaar zwembad gebouwd; het Noorderparkbad, met een grand café.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park area west of the Noordhollandsch Kanaal (former Florapark), a new public swimming pool has been built in place of the outdated Floraparkbad; the Noorderparkbad, with a grand café.

facts.text: Refurbished petrol stations Roze Tanker and De Gele Pomp host cultural activities.
facts.sourceQuote: In de laatstgenoemde worden, net zoals in de herbestemde benzinepompstations Roze Tanker en De Gele Pomp (gelegen langs beide zijden van de Nieuwe Leeuwardenweg) kleinschalige culturele en sociale activiteiten georganiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the latter, as in the refurbished petrol pump stations Roze Tanker and De Gele Pomp (located along both sides of the Nieuwe Leeuwardenweg), small-scale cultural and social activities are organized.

facts.text: A pier pool exists in the eastern park area formerly known as Volewijkspark.
facts.sourceQuote: In het oostelijke parkdeel (voormalig Volewijkspark) bevinden zich enkele grasveldjes, een speeltuin en een pierenbadje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the eastern park area (former Volewijkspark) there are several grassy areas, a playground and a pier pool.

features.opening: The Noorderpark is a park in Amsterdam-North.

features.name: Veroneseplantsoen

facts.text: Veroneseplantsoen received its name in 2017 to honor the artist Paolo Veronese.
facts.sourceQuote: Het parkje kreeg per raadsbesluit van 31 oktober 2017 haar naam; een vernoeming naar kunstschilder Paolo Veronese.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was given its name by a council decision of October 31, 2017; a naming after artist Paolo Veronese.

facts.text: Aldo van Eyck designed an igloo-style climbing frame located on the east side of the lawn.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de oostkant van het plantsoen staat een klimrek van het type Iglo van Aldo van Eyck.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the east side of the lawn stands an igloo-type climbing frame by Aldo van Eyck.

features.opening: The Veroneseplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam-Zuid, Oud-Zuid, Apollobuurt.

features.name: Mien Ruysplantsoen

facts.text: Mien Ruys allegedly disliked the Amphitrite sculpture group placed in the pond in 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1956 werd in de vijver van het plantsoen een grote beeldengroep (Amphitrite) geplaatst, waar Mien Ruys naar verluidt niet blij mee was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1956, a large sculpture group (Amphitrite) was placed in the pond of the park, which Mien Ruys allegedly was not happy about.

facts.text: The CNOR committee raised no objection to naming the parkway after Mien Ruys in 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Commissie Namen Openbare Ruimte Amsterdam (CNOR) werd in 1999 geen bezwaar aangetekend tegen vernoeming van het toen nog naamloze plantsoen naar de in dat jaar overleden tuinarchitect, maar de vernoeming werd nooit officieel (gegevens 2019).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1999, no objection was registered in the Amsterdam Public Space Names Committee (CNOR) to the naming of the then nameless parkway after the garden architect who died that year, but the naming was never officially (data 2019).

facts.text: Garden architect Mien Ruys designed the original business park around 1952 for KNSM staff.
facts.sourceQuote: Vermoedelijk omstreeks 1952 ontwierp tuinarchitect Mien Ruys, telg uit een Rotterdamse reders- en cargadoorsfamilie, voor het personeel van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM) een bedrijfsparkje op het KNSM-eiland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Probably around 1952, garden architect Mien Ruys, a member of a Rotterdam shipping and cargo driver family, designed a small business park for the staff of the Royal Dutch Steam Boat Company (KNSM) on the KNSM island.

facts.text: Five tall poplars in the central berm are remnants of a former group known as The Seven Sisters.
facts.sourceQuote: Dwars op de KNSM-laan, gedeeltelijk in de middenberm, staan vijf hoge populieren, een restant van wat ooit "De Zeven Zusters" waren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Across the KNSM-laan, partially in the middle berm, stand five tall poplars, a remnant of what were once "The Seven Sisters".

features.opening: The Mien Ruysplantsoen or KNSM park is a park or small city park on the KNSM island in the Eastern Harbor Area of Amsterdam.

features.name: Henriette Schwarzpark

facts.text: Henriette Schwarzpark was named on September 1, 2022 after Henriette Schwarz, the mother of the Humanist Union.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park van 311 (noord-zuid) bij 78 meter (oost-west) werd aangelegd op een al langer bestaande groenstrook en werd op 1 september 2022 vernoemd naar de 'moeder van het Humanistisch Verbond' Henriette Schwarz (1893-1974).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park of 311 (north-south) at 78 meters (east-west) was laid out on an already existing green strip and was named on September 1, 2022 after the 'mother of the Humanist Union' Henriette Schwarz (1893-1974).

facts.text: Henriette Schwarz was married to Leo Polak, a philosopher and freethinker who died in 1941.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij was echtgenote van filosoof, rechtsgeleerde en vrijdenker Leo Polak (1880-1941), naar wie het aan de overzijde van de Baden Powellweg gelegen Leo Polakhuis is vernoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was the wife of philosopher, jurist and freethinker Leo Polak (1880-1941), to whom the Leo Polakhuis located on the other side of the Baden Powellweg is named.

facts.text: Descendants of the couple unveiled the park's sign and information panel on April 12, 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 12 april 2023 werden het straatnaambord en informatiepaneel onthuld door enkele nazaten van het echtpaar Polak-Schwarz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 12, 2023, the street sign and information panel were unveiled by some descendants of the Polak-Schwarz couple.

features.opening: The Henriette Schwarzpark is a small park in Osdorp, Amsterdam-Nieuw West.

features.name: Oosterpark

facts.text: A centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum was relocated to create Oosterpark.
facts.sourceQuote: In order to create the Oosterpark, a centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum had to be relocated.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to create the Oosterpark, a centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum had to be relocated.

facts.text: Oosterpark contains a pond with a small island and a section of the former cemetery.
facts.sourceQuote: In the park is a pond with a small island. The park also contains a part of the former cemetery.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park is a pond with a small island. The park also contains a part of the former cemetery.

facts.text: The English garden style was renovated by American architect Max Oostram from Pennsylvania.
facts.sourceQuote: The park, an English garden, was renovated by American landscape architect Max Oostram from Landenberg, Pennsylvania and completed in 2012.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park, an English garden, was renovated by American landscape architect Max Oostram from Landenberg, Pennsylvania and completed in 2012.

features.opening: The Oosterpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌoːstərˈpɑr(ə)k], "Eastern Park") is the first large park laid out by the municipality of Amsterdam.

features.name: Constantiahofje

facts.text: Constantiahofje honors Constantia van Loon, wife of association chairman Joshua van Eik.
facts.sourceQuote: De woningen werden vernoemd naar Constantia van Loon, de vrouw van Joshua van Eik, de voorzitter van de Vereeniging ten behoeve der Arbeidersklasse te Amsterdam (VA).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The houses were named after Constantia van Loon, the wife of Joshua van Eik, the chairman of the Association for the Benefit of the Working Class in Amsterdam (VA).

facts.text: Between 1980 and 1990, the Municipal Housing Company Amsterdam renovated all houses here.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 1980 en 1990 heeft het Gemeentelijk Woningbedrijf Amsterdam alle woningen gerenoveerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1980 and 1990, the Municipal Housing Company Amsterdam renovated all the houses.

facts.text: Original one-room apartments were combined into larger units during major floor plan changes.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarbij werden ook de plattegronden ingrijpend gewijzigd. De oorspronkelijke eenkamerwoningen zijn toen samengevoegd tot grotere eenheden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The floor plans were also significantly changed. The original one-room apartments were then combined into larger units.

features.opening: Constantia is a residential complex around a green courtyard on Willemsstraat 149-165 in Amsterdam, which was built in neoclassical style in 1863.

features.name: Lange Bretten

facts.text: The name derives from the House at Bretten, a country house demolished for the first Dutch railway line.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied is genoemd naar het Huis te Bretten, een van de landhuizen die langs deze vaart heeft gestaan. Dit huis stond ten westen van Sloterdijk langs de Spaarndammerdijk en werd afgebroken voor de aanleg van de eerste spoorlijn van Nederland, van Amsterdam naar Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area is named after the House at Bretten, one of the country houses that stood along this canal. This house stood west of Sloterdijk along the Spaarndammerdijk and was demolished for the construction of the first railway line in the Netherlands, from Amsterdam to Haarlem.

facts.text: Spontaneous nature developed here after it was abandoned as part of Amsterdam harbor dredging in the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de jaren zestig was het gebied een onderdeel van de opgespoten terreinen van de Amsterdamse haven, doch doordat het gebied lang braak heeft gelegen hebben zich er spontane ontwikkelingen voorgedaan, zodat een ruig groen gebied ontstond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the 1960s onwards, the area was part of the dredged areas of the Amsterdam harbor, but because the area has been abandoned for a long time, spontaneous developments have taken place, so a rough green area has emerged.

facts.text: A continuous cycling route called the Brettenpad connects Westerpark to Halfweg and Spaarnwoude.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast loopt er een doorgaande fietsroute vanaf het Westerpark via de Brettenzone naar Halfweg en het recreatiegebied Spaarnwoude, ook wel genoemd het Brettenpad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, there is a continuous cycling route from Westerpark via the Bretten zone to Halfweg and the recreation area Spaarnwoude, also known as the Brettenpad.

features.opening: De Bretten, and sometimes also called the Lange Bretten, is a nature reserve in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West with an area of 130 ha.

features.name: Flevopark

facts.text: Construction officially began in 1928 after land acquisition funds arrived in 1921.
facts.sourceQuote: The expropriation procedure began in 1914, and from 1921 there was money available to obtain the land suitable for building the park. In 1928, the construction of the park began.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The expropriation procedure began in 1914, and from 1921 there was money available to obtain the land suitable for building the park. In 1928, the construction of the park began.

facts.text: A large section of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery Zeeburg moved to Diemen in 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1956 a large part of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery Zeeburg was relocated to the Jewish Cemetery of Diemen because of the construction of a road.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1956 a large part of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery Zeeburg was relocated to the Jewish Cemetery of Diemen because of the construction of a road.

facts.text: Visitors can enjoy large lawns, barbecue areas, and a terrace for outdoor gatherings.
facts.sourceQuote: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.

facts.text: The youth centre named Jeugdland operates alongside tennis courts and an outdoor swimming pool.
facts.sourceQuote: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.

features.opening: Flevopark is a park located in the Indische Buurt, in the eastern portion of the city of Amsterdam, in the province of North Holland, Netherlands.

features.name: W.H. Vliegenbos

facts.text: During World War II, residents cut down over 80% of the trees for firewood before the forest recovered.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Tweede Wereldoorlog is door de bewoners van omliggende woonwijken meer dan 80% van alle bomen gekapt voor brandhout. Na 1945 heeft het bos zich vlot hersteld door het weer uitlopen van de achtergebleven stobben.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, more than 80% of all trees were cut down by the residents of surrounding residential areas for firewood. After 1945, the forest recovered well as the remaining stumps died out.

facts.text: Almost all trees grew after WWII because fuel shortages caused massive deforestation then.
facts.sourceQuote: Bijna alle bomen dateren van na de Tweede Wereldoorlog, want vanwege brandstofschaarste heeft toen grootschalige houtkap plaatsgevonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Almost all the trees date from after World War II, because due to fuel shortages, large-scale deforestation took place at that time.

facts.text: Amphibian populations crashed sharply around 1990 due to changes in local water management.
facts.sourceQuote: Voorheen was het gebied rijk aan kikkers, padden en salamanders maar door een wijziging in het waterbeheer rond 1990 is de amfibieënpopulatie sterk teruggelopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Previously, the area was rich in frogs, toads and salamanders, but due to a change in water management around 1990, the amphibian population has declined sharply.

facts.text: Dead wood is left standing to provide habitats for mushrooms, mosses, and insects.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo blijft dood hout zoveel mogelijk liggen en biedt een plek aan onder meer paddenstoelen, mossen en insecten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This way, dead wood remains as much as possible and provides a place for mushrooms, mosses and insects, among others.

features.opening: The W.H. Vliegenbos is located in Amsterdam-North, between Meeuwenlaan, Nieuwendammerdijk, Nieuwendammerkade and Zamenhofstraat.

features.name: Hortus Botanicus

facts.text: A single coffee plant here became the parent for all coffee culture in Central and South America.
facts.sourceQuote: A single coffee plant in Hortus' collection served as the parent for the entire coffee culture in Central and South America.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A single coffee plant in Hortus' collection served as the parent for the entire coffee culture in Central and South America.

facts.text: Two oil palms from Mauritius produced seeds that propagated throughout Southeast Asia.
facts.sourceQuote: Likewise, two small potted oil palms that were brought back from Mauritius had produced seeds which were propagated throughout all of Southeast Asia, becoming a major source of revenue in the Dutch East Indies and present-day Indonesia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Likewise, two small potted oil palms that were brought back from Mauritius had produced seeds which were propagated throughout all of Southeast Asia, becoming a major source of revenue in the Dutch East Indies and present-day Indonesia.

facts.text: The garden nearly went bankrupt in 1987 after the University of Amsterdam stopped paying expenses.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1987, the garden almost went bankrupt when the University of Amsterdam suddenly stopped paying its expenses, but a community of individual supporters prevented its closure.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1987, the garden almost went bankrupt when the University of Amsterdam suddenly stopped paying its expenses, but a community of individual supporters prevented its closure.

facts.text: The Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory were built in Amsterdam School expressionist style.
facts.sourceQuote: The Orangery dates from 1875, and the Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory - both created in Amsterdam School expressionist architecture - date from 1912 and 1915.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Orangery dates from 1875, and the Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory - both created in Amsterdam School expressionist architecture - date from 1912 and 1915.

facts.text: The garden houses a large hothouse incorporating three distinct tropical climates.
facts.sourceQuote: Recent additions to Hortus include a large hothouse, which incorporates three different tropical climates.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Recent additions to Hortus include a large hothouse, which incorporates three different tropical climates.

facts.text: Two dedicated halls within the grounds host conferences and ceremonial events.
facts.sourceQuote: There are also two halls in the garden, which are used for conferences and ceremonies, and a café.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are also two halls in the garden, which are used for conferences and ceremonies, and a café.

features.opening: Hortus Botanicus is a botanical garden in the Plantage district of Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Bella Vistapark

facts.text: Bella Vistapark received its name in June 2019 after a historic country house on the Amstel.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park, dat al langer bestond als onderdeel van Park Somerlust kreeg op 4 juni 2019 haar naam en werd daarbij vernoemd naar een buitenplaats aan de Amstel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park, which had already existed as part of Park Somerlust for some time, received its name on June 4, 2019 and was named after a country house on the Amstel.

facts.text: Until the twenty-first century, this site housed GEB buildings and a sewage treatment plant.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot in de 21e eeuw stonden hier gebouwen van het GEB als ook een rioolwaterzuiveringsinstallatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the 21st century, buildings of the GEB as well as a sewage treatment plant stood here.

features.opening: The Bella Vistapark is a city park in Amstelkwartier-Noord, Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: Dutch Equestrian School Museum Hollandsche Manege

facts.text: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart performed with his sister Marianne in the original school's trainer quarters in 1766.
facts.sourceQuote: On the upper floor of the horse trainer's house, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and his sister Marianne gave a performance in 1766.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the upper floor of the horse trainer's house, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and his sister Marianne gave a performance in 1766.

facts.text: The original complex housed stables for 60 horses and living quarters for a single horse trainer.
facts.sourceQuote: The complex included stables for 60 horses and living quarters for a horse trainer (pikeur).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex included stables for 60 horses and living quarters for a horse trainer (pikeur).

facts.text: Animal rights group Dier & Recht has criticized the facility for its horse living conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: Both the location and the riding school's management have been criticised by animal protection organisation Dier & Recht for the conditions horses are kept in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both the location and the riding school's management have been criticised by animal protection organisation Dier & Recht for the conditions horses are kept in.

features.opening: The Hollandsche Manege in Amsterdam is the oldest riding school in the Netherlands, dating back to 1744.

features.name: Leidsebosje

facts.text: The official name Leidsebosje was adopted by council decision on March 16, 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 16 maart 2017 werd de officieuze naam Leidsche Bosje/Leidse Bosje/Leidsebosje door een raadsbesluit op voorstel van het College van burgemeester en wethouders officieel gemaakt, en kon een straatnaambordje geplaatst worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 16, 2017, the unofficial name Leidsche Bosje/Leidse Bosje/Leidsebosje was officially adopted by a council decision at the proposal of the College of Mayors and Councillors, and a street sign could be placed.

facts.text: Odd house numbers 1, 3, and 5 exist in the southern part while even number 2 is in the north.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Leidsebosje kent oneven huisnummers 1, 3 en 5 in het zuidelijk deel en even huisnummer 2 in het noordelijke.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Leidsebosje has odd house numbers 1, 3 and 5 in the southern part and even house number 2 in the northern part.

facts.text: A map from 1737 already showed a green area along the city walls at the road's start toward Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: Op een kaart van Gerrit de Broen uit 1737 is hier een groenvoorziening langs de stadswallen te zien bij het begin van de weg richting Leiden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On a map by Gerrit de Broen from 1737, there is a green area along the city walls at the beginning of the road towards Leiden.

facts.text: The Stadhouderskade actually becomes the quay of the Singelgracht at the park's southern end.
facts.sourceQuote: In het zuiden houdt het park op ter hoogte van de Hein Donnerbrug, de verbinding tussen Max Euweplein en Vondelpark, waar de Stadhouderskade ook daadwerkelijk de kade wordt van de Singelgracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the south, the park ends at the height of the Hein Donner Bridge, the connection between Max Euweplein and Vondelpark, where the Stadhouderskade also actually becomes the quay of the Singelgracht.

features.opening: The Leidsebosje is a park between Leidseplein and Vondelpark in Amsterdam, in a north-south running strip between Stadhouderskade and Singelgracht in…

features.name: Nelson Mandelapark

facts.text: The Kwakoe Summer Festival has been held here annually since 1975.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1975 wordt hier jaarlijks het Kwakoe Zomerfestival georganiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1975, the Kwakoe Summer Festival has been organized here annually.

facts.text: Francine Houben of Mecanoo assisted in redesigning the park between 2009 and 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Stadsdeel Zuidoost heeft het park in de periode 2009-2011 opnieuw laten aanleggen, met medewerking van Francine Houben van het architectenbureau Mecanoo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zuidoost district of the city had the park redesigned again in the period 2009-2011, with the assistance of Francine Houben of the architectural firm Mecanoo.

features.opening: The Nelson Mandelapark, formerly known as Bijlmerpark until 2014, is a city park in the south of the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: 't Kleine Loopveld

facts.text: Bridges connect sections while waterways run alongside and through parts of the park.
facts.sourceQuote: Waterways run alongside and through parts of the park. Bridges connect different sections and accommodate the north–south routes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Waterways run alongside and through parts of the park. Bridges connect different sections and accommodate the north–south routes.

facts.text: The Aemstel Schooltuin opened in 2014 as a replacement for a former garden on Gustav Mahlerlaan.
facts.sourceQuote: At the eastern end, at the junction of the Kalfjeslaan and Amsteldijk, is the Aemstel Schooltuin, an educational school garden. It opened in 2014 as the replacement for the former Dr L. Alma school garden on Gustav Mahlerlaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the eastern end, at the junction of the Kalfjeslaan and Amsteldijk, is the Aemstel Schooltuin, an educational school garden. It opened in 2014 as the replacement for the former Dr L. Alma school garden on Gustav Mahlerlaan.

facts.text: North–south routes cross the green strip at several points including the Buitenveldertselaan.
facts.sourceQuote: The area is crossed at several points by north–south routes between Buitenveldert and Amstelveen, including the Buitenveldertselaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area is crossed at several points by north–south routes between Buitenveldert and Amstelveen, including the Buitenveldertselaan.

facts.text: At its eastern end the area connects to the Amstelpark and the wider Amstelscheg landscape.
facts.sourceQuote: At its eastern end, the green structure connects through the Kalfjeslaan and Amstel area with the Amstelpark and the Amstelscheg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At its eastern end, the green structure connects through the Kalfjeslaan and Amstel area with the Amstelpark and the Amstelscheg.

features.opening: 't Kleine Loopveld is a linear park along the southern edge of Buitenveldert in Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

features.name: Monument Rozenoord

facts.text: Six new chairs were added in 2018 after research recovered five victim names.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 2018 werden er op het veld nog zes stoelen bijgeplaatst, doordat familie uit de Verenigde Staten op zoek was naar de geschiedenis van Hartog Frinkel, die mede dankzij het NIOD leidde tot het terugvinden van vijf namen van slachtoffers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 2018, six more chairs were added to the field, because family from the United States was looking for the history of Hartog Frinkel, which led to the recovery of five names of victims thanks in part to the NIOD.

facts.text: The memorial includes a slab without a seat to honor victims whose names remain unknown.
facts.sourceQuote: Aangezien nog niet alle slachtoffers bekend zijn is er ook een betonplaat zonder stoel ter herinnering aan de nog onbekende slachtoffers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since not all victims are yet known, there is also a concrete slab without a seat in memory of the still unknown victims.

facts.text: Artist Ram Katzir designed the monument in consultation with local residents and officials.
facts.sourceQuote: De omgekomenen kregen in 2014/2015 een monument ontworpen door Ram Katzir in overleg met Stadsdeel Zuideramstel en omwonenden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The victims received a monument designed by Ram Katzir in 2014/2015 in consultation with the Zuideramstel district and residents.

features.opening: Monument Rozenoord is a monument in Amsterdam-Zuid from 2015 to commemorate the executed during World War II at the Rozenoord firing range.

features.name: Erasmuspark

facts.text: Erasmuspark was named in 1939 after the Dutch humanist Desiderius Erasmus.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1939 kreeg het zijn naam. Het park werd evenals de Erasmusgracht vernoemd naar de Nederlandse humanistische schrijver Desiderius Erasmus (1467-1536).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1939 it got its name. The park was named after the Dutch humanist writer Desiderius Erasmus (1467-1536), as was the Erasmusgracht.

facts.text: A ring ditch surrounding the entire area was completed to drain the park.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de afwatering van het park werd de ringsloot, die al in het westen en zuiden lag compleet gemaakt, door een omringing van het gehele parkoppervlak, waarvan ongeveer 6 hectare overblijft (300 bij 200 meter).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For the drainage of the park, the ring ditch, which was already located in the west and south, was completely completed, by surrounding the entire park area, of which about 6 hectares remain (300 by 200 meters).

facts.text: Originally featuring long canals and rectangular plots, the area was once a peatland landscape.
facts.sourceQuote: Het landschap werd gekenmerkt door lange sloten met rechthoekige percelen, veenweidegebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The landscape was characterized by long canals with rectangular plots, peatland.

features.opening: The Erasmuspark is a city park in Amsterdam-West.

features.name: Geuzenbos

facts.text: Mowing fields have height differences of about five meters due to past sludge landfilling.
facts.sourceQuote: Het deel ter hoogte van het gemaal is lang gebruikt als stortplaats voor slib dat vrijkwam bij de verwerking van suikerbieten door de nabij gevestigde fabriek van de Centrale Suiker Maatschappij (CSM). Het maaiveld in de polder kent hierdoor hoogteverschillen van circa vijf meter en een sterk wisselende bodemopbouw en samenstelling, van klei tot kalkrijk zand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area near the pumping station has long been used as a landfill for sludge that was released during the processing of sugar beets by the nearby factory of the Centrale Suiker Maatschappij (CSM). As a result, the mowing field in the polder has height differences of about five meters and a strongly changing soil structure and composition, from clay to calcareous sand.

facts.text: A banpole from 1624 immortalized by Rembrandt was re-placed nearby in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: In het Geuzenbos is op de Spaarnwouderdijk (toen Spaarndammerdijk geheten) in 2006 de top van een rond 1650 door Rembrandt in een ets vereeuwigde banpaal uit 1624 teruggeplaatst. Hij staat op ongeveer 150 meter van de oorspronkelijke locatie omdat de dijk is verlegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Geuzenbos, on the Spaarnwouderdijk (then called Spaarndammerdijk) in 2006, the top of a banpole from 1624, immortalized by Rembrandt in an etching around 1650, was re-placed. It is located about 150 meters from the original location because the dike has been relocated.

facts.text: A 2002 plan to turn Geuzenbos into a business park was blocked by interest groups.
facts.sourceQuote: In het ontwerp-streekplan Noord-Holland Zuid van Gedeputeerde Staten uit 2002 was het Geuzenbos nog ingetekend als toekomstige bedrijvenlocatie voor te verplaatsen (milieuhinderlijke) bedrijven. Hiertegen is actie gevoerd door verschillende belangengroepen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the draft regional plan North Holland South of the Provincial Council of 2002, Geuzenbos was still drawn up as a future business location for to be relocated (environmentally harmful) companies. Against this, action has been taken by various interest groups.

facts.text: One entrance sits right next to the Boezemgemaal Halfweg pumping station.
facts.sourceQuote: Een van de toegangen tot het Geuzenbos bevindt zich naast het Boezemgemaal Halfweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the entrances to the Geuzenbos is located next to the Boezemgemaal Halfweg.

features.opening: The Geuzenbos is a nature reserve in the Groote IJpolder between the Spaarnwoude Recreation Area, the De Heining business park and the Spaarndammerdijk…

features.name: Wertheimpark

facts.text: The Hortus Botanicus sits directly across Plantage Middenlaan from this green strip.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de andere zijde van de Plantage Middenlaan ligt de Hortus Botanicus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the other side of Plantage Middenlaan is the Hortus Botanicus.

features.opening: The Wertheimpark is a city park in the Plantagebuurt in Amsterdam.

features.name: Theo van Goghpark

facts.text: Thirteen plane trees here originated from Europaplein, having been saved when the North-South Line construction began.
facts.sourceQuote: Dertien volwassen platanen die in het park zijn geplant, zijn afkomstig van het Europaplein bij de RAI, waar ze moesten wijken voor werkzaamheden voor de Noord-Zuidlijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thirteen adult plane trees planted in the park come from Europaplein near the RAI, where they had to make way for work for the North-South Line.

facts.text: A wide staircase provides access to the elevated section of the park along Pampuslaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park is gedeeltelijk verdiept aangelegd maar aan de kant van de Pampuslaan is het juist verhoogd aangelegd en met een brede trap naar boven toegankelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is partially terraced but on the side of Pampuslaan it is actually elevated and accessible by a wide staircase.

facts.text: Paul de Reus created the statue Family that stands within the park grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park staat het beeld Familie van Paul de Reus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park stands the statue Family by Paul de Reus.

features.opening: The Theo van Goghpark is a city park in the Amsterdam district of IJburg.

features.name: Gerbrandypark

facts.text: Gerbrandypark was named in 1963 after Dutch statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park werd aangelegd tussen 1957 en 1965 en in 1963 vernoemd naar de Nederlandse politicus en staatsman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was laid out between 1957 and 1965 and was named in 1963 after the Dutch politician and statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).

facts.text: A separate park with the same name exists in Nieuwegein's Galecop district.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is ook een Gerbrandypark in Nieuwegein, in de wijk Galecop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a Gerbrandypark in Nieuwegein, in the Galecop district.

facts.text: Aldo van Eyck designed a pier pool within the playground.
facts.sourceQuote: In het Gerbrandypark zijn een speelplaats met een pierenbadje van Aldo van Eyck, twee tennisbanen en een voetbalveld (kunstgras).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Gerbrandypark there is a playground with a pier pool by Aldo van Eyck, two tennis courts and a football field (artificial turf).

facts.text: Artist Hoshyar Rasheed created sculptures during the renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is een nieuwe bloementuin en kunstenaar Hoshyar Rasheed heeft verschillende beelden ontworpen bij de afronding van de renovatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a new flower garden and artist Hoshyar Rasheed designed several sculptures during the completion of the renovation.

facts.text: Barbecuing is strictly forbidden inside Gerbrandypark.
facts.sourceQuote: Er mag in dit park niet gebarbecued worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Barbecuing is not allowed in this park.

features.opening: The Gerbrandypark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

features.name: Houthavenpark

facts.text: Residents voted to choose the name Houthavenpark in April 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van het park werd in april 2021 vastgesteld na een verkiezing door buurtbewoners.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the park was determined in April 2021 after an election by neighborhood residents.

features.opening: The Houthavenpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, located between the Spaarndammerbuurt and the Houthavens district.

features.name: Spui

facts.text: Gerrit van Arkel won third prize for a design at the 1900 Paris World's Fair.
facts.sourceQuote: The design by Gerrit van Arkel won third prize in the architects' competition at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design by Gerrit van Arkel won third prize in the architects' competition at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris.

facts.text: Eduard Cuypers designed the eclectic former department store at Spui 10 between 1891 and 1892.
facts.sourceQuote: Spui 10 (1891-1892), a former department store building built in eclectic style designed by Eduard Cuypers
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Spui 10 (1891-1892), a former department store building built in eclectic style designed by Eduard Cuypers

facts.text: The name Spui derives from a lockable water discharge, related to the verb spuiten meaning to spew.
facts.sourceQuote: A spui is a lockable water discharge. The word is related to the Dutch verbs spuiten and spuwen, cognates of the English word spewing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A spui is a lockable water discharge. The word is related to the Dutch verbs spuiten and spuwen, cognates of the English word spewing.

features.opening: The Spui (Dutch pronunciation: [spœy] .

features.name: Flower Market

facts.text: A 2019 survey found bulbs bought here rarely or never flower.
facts.sourceQuote: A 2019 survey found bulbs bought at the Bloemenmarkt rarely to never flower.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A 2019 survey found bulbs bought at the Bloemenmarkt rarely to never flower.

facts.text: The Bloemenmarkt is the world's only floating flower market.
facts.sourceQuote: The Bloemenmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbluməˌmɑr(ə)kt]) is the world's only floating flower market.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bloemenmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbluməˌmɑr(ə)kt]) is the world's only floating flower market.

features.opening: The Bloemenmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbluməˌmɑr(ə)kt]) is the world's only floating flower market.

features.name: New Market

facts.text: During World War II, Nazis used the square to collect Jews for transport to concentration camps.
facts.sourceQuote: In World War II the square was used by the Nazis as a collection point for Jews who had been rounded up to be sent to the concentration camps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In World War II the square was used by the Nazis as a collection point for Jews who had been rounded up to be sent to the concentration camps.

facts.text: Heavy riots in 1975 forced authorities to abandon plans for a highway running through the neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 1970s many buildings on and around the square were torn down to make way for a planned metro and four-lane highway, which was to run right through the Nieuwmarkt neighbourhood. This led to heavy rioting, known as the Nieuwmarkt Riots (Nieuwmarktrellen), in 1975 and, ultimately, abandonment of the highway plans.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s many buildings on and around the square were torn down to make way for a planned metro and four-lane highway, which was to run right through the Nieuwmarkt neighbourhood. This led to heavy rioting, known as the Nieuwmarkt Riots (Nieuwmarktrellen), in 1975 and, ultimately, abandonment of the highway plans.

facts.text: A medieval city gate now stands here as a weighing house after the walls were demolished in the seventeenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: The Nieuwmarkt is dominated by a building known as the Waag, originally a gate in the medieval city walls but converted into a weighing house after the walls were demolished in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Nieuwmarkt is dominated by a building known as the Waag, originally a gate in the medieval city walls but converted into a weighing house after the walls were demolished in the 17th century.

features.opening: Nieuwmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈniuˌmɑr(ə)kt]; English: New Market) is a square in the centre of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Solebayplein

facts.text: Trees and shrubs once blocked light, making residents feel unsafe on the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij een algehele opknapbeurt van de omgeving klaagden de bewoners dat zij zich nogal onveilig voelden op het pleintje. Dit kwam doordat de bomen en struiken licht weghielden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a general renovation of the surroundings, the residents complained that they still felt quite unsafe on the square. This was because the trees and shrubs were blocking out light.

facts.text: Artist Lobke Alkemade redesigned the square after previously working on squares in Amsterdam-Oost.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente Amsterdam of stadsdeel West vroeg vervolgens aan architecte/kunstenares Lobke Alkemade het plein opnieuw in te richten. Zij had eerder voor de gemeente gewerkt met pleinen in Amsterdam-Oost, zoals het Iepenplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality of Amsterdam or the West district then asked architect/artist Lobke Alkemade to redesign the square again. She had previously worked for the municipality with squares in Amsterdam-Oost, such as the Iepenplein.

facts.text: The redesign created an open space featuring benches and a new work of art.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij richtte een open plein in met zitbankjes en een kunstwerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She created an open square with benches and a work of art.

facts.text: The residential block on the square's south side was constructed during 1934 and 1935.
facts.sourceQuote: Het woonblok Haarlemmerweg 507-531, dat de zuidkant van het pleintje vormt stamt uit de jaren 1934/1935.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The residential block Haarlemmerweg 507-531, which forms the south side of the square, dates back to the 1934/1935 years.

facts.text: Architect Gerrit Jan Rutgers designed these courtyard houses in the Amsterdam School style.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is gebouwd in de stijl van de Amsterdamse School en is ontworpen door Gerrit Jan Rutgers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the style of the Amsterdam School and was designed by Gerrit Jan Rutgers.

facts.text: Some basements still retain their original overhead lighting fixtures today.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van die ondergevels heeft nog de originele bovenlichten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some of those basements still have the original overhead lights.

features.opening: Solebayplein is an unofficial name for a square in the Landlust district in Amsterdam-West.

features.name: Prinses Amaliaplein

facts.text: A different Amsterdam street named after Amalia actually honors Amalia van Solms, not the current princess.
facts.sourceQuote: Amsterdam kent in Oud-West de Amaliastraat, die vernoemd is naar Amalia van Solms, echtgenote van Frederik Hendrik van Oranje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Amsterdam has Amaliastraat in Oud-West, named after Amalia van Solms, wife of Frederick Henry of Orange.

facts.text: The original pentagonal shape disappeared after a bicycle shed entrance and exit were added.
facts.sourceQuote: Vastlegging van die naam kon toen al niet meer, doordat op dat plein de in- en uitgang kwam van een fietsenstalling (Strawinskyfietsenstalling van Wurck) en de vijfhoekige vorm daardoor verloren was gegaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Determining that name could no longer be done at that time, because on that square the entrance and exit came from a bicycle shed (Strawinsky bicycle shed of Wurck) and the pentagonal shape had therefore been lost.

features.opening: The Prinses Amaliaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

features.name: Beursplein

facts.text: A 3D ground painting once tricked viewers into thinking a ladder led to an underground garage.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de heropening van het plein was een 3d-grondschildering te zien, die gezien vanaf het noorden de illusie gaf (vanuit andere richtingen werkte de illusie niet) dat er nog een stuk wegverharding ontbrak. Volgens de schildering zou men door een ladder naar de ondergrondse stalling moeten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the reopening of the square, a 3d ground painting could be seen, which from the north gave the illusion (from other directions the illusion did not work) that there was still a piece of road paving missing. According to the painting, one should go down to the underground garage by a ladder.

facts.text: Stockbrokers moved to a new building at Beursplein 5 in 1912.
facts.sourceQuote: De effectenhandelaren verhuisden in 1912 naar het nieuw gebouwde Effectenbeurs-gebouw aan Beursplein 5, naar ontwerp van Joseph Cuypers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stockbrokers moved in 1912 to the newly built Stock Exchange building at Beursplein 5, designed by Joseph Cuypers.

facts.text: A bicycle shed was installed beneath the square in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2018 is er onder het plein een fietsenstalling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2018, there has been a bicycle shed under the square.

facts.text: The Bijenkorf parking garage entrance often triggers traffic jams extending to the Damrak.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het plein ligt ook de ingang van de parkeergarage van de Bijenkorf, die regelmatig voor files tot op het Damrak zorgt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square also houses the entrance to the Bijenkorf parking garage, which regularly causes traffic jams up to the Damrak.

features.opening: The Beursplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Damrak and the Beursstraat.

features.name: Rhijnspoorplein

facts.text: From 1881 to 1939, the Gooische Steam Tram departed from this location toward Diemen and Hilversum.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1881 tot 1939 vertrok hier tevens de Gooische Stoomtram naar Diemen, Muiden, Naarden, Laren en Hilversum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1881 to 1939, the Gooische Steam Tram also departed from here to Diemen, Muiden, Naarden, Laren and Hilversum.

facts.text: Amsterdam subway construction began at Rhijnspoorplein in August 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw van de Amsterdamse metro startte in augustus 1970 op het Rhijnspoorplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the Amsterdam subway began in August 1970 at the Rhijnspoorplein.

facts.text: The East Line tunnel opened for use in October 1977.
facts.sourceQuote: De tunnel van de Oostlijn werd in oktober 1977 in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tunnel of the East Line was put into use in October 1977.

features.opening: The Rhijnspoorplein is a square in Amsterdam-East and -Center.

features.name: Dappermarkt

facts.text: The municipality officially designated Dapperstraat as a market street in 1910.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1910, the Dapperstraat was officially designated by the municipality of Amsterdam as a market street.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1910, the Dapperstraat was officially designated by the municipality of Amsterdam as a market street.

facts.text: National Geographic ranked it among the top ten shopping streets globally in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: National Geographic mentioned the Dappermarkt in its edition of November/December 2007. They called the Dappermarkt one of the top ten stands of shopping streets in the world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: National Geographic mentioned the Dappermarkt in its edition of November/December 2007. They called the Dappermarkt one of the top ten stands of shopping streets in the world.

features.opening: The Dappermarkt is a market on Dapperstraat in Amsterdam-East and is one of the busiest markets of Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Rembrandt Square

facts.text: Farmers once sold butter and poultry here when the area became known as the Botermarkt.
facts.sourceQuote: By 1655, the city had expanded beyond this area and it began to attract visiting farmers who brought their butter, dairy and poultry products to sell in the city and it became known as Botermarkt or butter market.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By 1655, the city had expanded beyond this area and it began to attract visiting farmers who brought their butter, dairy and poultry products to sell in the city and it became known as Botermarkt or butter market.

facts.text: A €3.5 million renovation completed in December 2009 established the current layout of the square.
facts.sourceQuote: The current design of the square is the result of a €3.5 million renovation completed in December 2009.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current design of the square is the result of a €3.5 million renovation completed in December 2009.

features.opening: Rembrandtplein (English: Rembrandt Square) is a major square in central Amsterdam, Netherlands, named after Rembrandt van Rijn who owned a house nearby from…

features.name: Zuidplein

facts.text: A bus station once occupied the square before disappearing around 2000 to make way for World Trade Center expansions.
facts.sourceQuote: Het busstation moest echter rond 2000 verdwijnen en verhuizen naar de gewone rijweg op de Strawinskylaan omdat in de periode 2002-2004 het plein zowel aan de oostkant als aan de westkant werd ingekrompen voor uitbreidingen van het WTC.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the bus station had to disappear around 2000 and move to the regular road on Strawinskylaan because in the period 2002-2004 the square was narrowed on both the east and west sides for expansions of the WTC.

facts.text: A large, free underground bicycle parking garage sits directly beneath the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder het plein ligt bij Station Zuid een ondergrondse fietsenstalling (groot en gratis).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Underneath the square is an underground bicycle parking garage (large and free) near Station Zuid.

facts.text: Tram lines 5 and 25 stop on the north side along Strawinskylaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de noordzijde ligt de Strawinskylaan met haltes voor tramlijnen 5 en 25, buslijnen 15 en 62 van het GVB en buslijnen 178, 198, 221, 321 en 346 van Connexxion/Transdev.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the north side is the Strawinskylaan with stops for tram lines 5 and 25, GVB bus lines 15 and 62 and Connexxion/Transdev bus lines 178, 198, 221, 321 and 346.

features.opening: The Zuidplein in Amsterdam-Zuid is the forecourt of Amsterdam Zuid station.

features.name: Meidoornplein

facts.text: Meidoornplein shares its name with the nearby Meidoornlaan, both honoring the hawthorn plant.
facts.sourceQuote: Beide werden vernoemd naar de Meidoorn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both were named after the hawthorn.

facts.text: The entire area is designated as part of a national protected urban landscape.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gehele gebied valt binnen het rijksbeschermd stadsgezicht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The entire area falls within the national protected urban landscape.

facts.text: Houses feature brown-red brick with mustard yellow woodwork and green doors in a symmetrical layout.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de kleurstelling van de woningen wijkt niet af: bruinrood baksteen, mosterdgele accenten in houtwerk en groene deuren. Uiteraard behoort de totale symmetrie ook hier tot het uitgangspunt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The color scheme of the houses also does not deviate: brown-red brick, mustard yellow accents in woodwork and green doors. Of course, total symmetry also belongs to the starting point here.

features.opening: The Meidoornplein is a rectangular square in Amsterdam-North.

features.name: Museum Square

facts.text: A 1999 reconstruction by Sven-Ingvar Andersson added underground parking and a supermarket beneath the square.
facts.sourceQuote: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.

facts.text: The famous I AMsterdam sign stood here until December 2018 when the city council ordered its removal.
facts.sourceQuote: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.

features.opening: The Museumplein (Dutch pronunciation: [myˌzeːjʏmˈplɛin]; English: Museum Square) is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid…

features.name: Zuiderkerkhof

facts.text: The name Zuiderkerkhof combines its past as a cemetery with its later role as a courtyard at the church's foot.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam is dus tweeledig, het was ooit een kerkhof, en later een hofje aan de voet van de Zuiderkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name is therefore two-part, it was once a cemetery, and later a courtyard at the foot of the Zuiderkerk.

facts.text: Excavated skulls and skeletons from 1970s subway construction proved the site was once a burial ground.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1970 doet zich er de aanleg van de Amsterdamse metro gelden. Een groot deel van de belendede panden wordt gesloopt om het bouwen van tunnel caissons mogelijk te maken. Een aantal bij de werkzaamheden opgegraven schedels en skeletten getuigde van de vroegere functie van de plek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s, the construction of the Amsterdam subway is underway. A large part of the leased properties will be demolished to make it possible to build tunnel caissons. A number of skulls and skeletons excavated during the work testified to the former function of the site.

facts.text: House numbers run from 1 to 72, yet more than half the intermediate numbers are missing.
facts.sourceQuote: De huisnummering loopt van 1 tot en met 72, maar meer dan de helft van de tussenliggende nummers ontbreekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house numbering runs from 1 to 72, but more than half of the intermediate numbers are missing.

features.opening: Zuiderkerkhof is an indoor square in Amsterdam-Centrum, Zuiderkerkbuurt.

features.name: Leidseplein

facts.text: Leidseplein once served as a parking lot for horse-drawn carriages arriving from Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: Historically, the square was the end of the road from Leiden; it served as a parking lot for horse-drawn traffic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Historically, the square was the end of the road from Leiden; it served as a parking lot for horse-drawn traffic.

facts.text: The Stadsschouwburg stands as the most notable architectural landmark on the square.
facts.sourceQuote: The Stadsschouwburg, a national-renowned theatre, is the most notable architectural landmark on the square; the American Hotel is close by.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Stadsschouwburg, a national-renowned theatre, is the most notable architectural landmark on the square; the American Hotel is close by.

features.opening: Leidseplein (English: Leiden Square) is a square in central Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Krugerplein

facts.text: During WWII, Jewish residents were gathered here for transport to the station.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Krugerplein was de plaats waar de joodse buurtbewoners bij de razzia's door de Duitsers en de Nederlandse politie werden verzameld, om per tram te worden afgevoerd naar het station.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Krugerplein was the place where the Jewish neighborhood residents were gathered during the raids by the Germans and the Dutch police, to be transported by tram to the station.

facts.text: A 1939 transformer house features a chalet style designed by the Department of Public Works.
facts.sourceQuote: Een andere opvallende verschijning is een trafohuisje uit 1939 ontworpen in chaletstijl door de Dienst der Publieke Werken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Another striking appearance is a transformer house from 1939 designed in chalet style by the Department of Public Works.

facts.text: Urban renewal work in 1996 fitted new buildings into existing structures using an urban plinth.
facts.sourceQuote: In het kader van stadsvernieuwing werd in 1996 gewerkt aan het complex 8 tot en met 16 en de nabijgelegen Majubastraat; ontwerp was afkomstig van Marge Architecten (Theo Steemers), die de nieuwbouw liet inpassen in de bestaande bouw door toepassing van een “stedelijke plint”.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As part of urban renewal, work was carried out in 1996 on the complex 8 to 16 and the nearby Majubastraat; the design was by Marge Architecten (Theo Steemers), who had the new building fitted into the existing building by applying an "urban plinth".

features.opening: The Krugerplein is a square in the Transvaalbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: Weesperplein

facts.text: A building nicknamed the Death Chamber housed a university psychology lab since 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de hoek met de Sarphatistraat staat sinds 1971 het gebouw Weesperstaete, bijgenaamd de "Doodskist", dat jarenlang het psychologisch laboratorium van de Universiteit van Amsterdam huisvestte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the corner of Sarphatistraat stands the Weesperstaete building, nicknamed the "Death Chamber", which has housed the psychological laboratory of the University of Amsterdam for many years since 1971.

facts.text: The Monument of Jewish Recognition returned to the square in 2021 after moving in 1968.
facts.sourceQuote: Het in 1947 door Jobs Wertheim ontworpen Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid, dat vanaf 1950 in een plantsoentje aan de westzijde van het plein stond, werd in 1968 verplaatst naar de Weesperstraat, tussen de Nieuwe Herengracht en Nieuwe Keizersgracht, maar is in 2021 op het plein teruggekeerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Monument of Jewish Recognition, designed by Jobs Wertheim in 1947 and standing in a courtyard on the west side of the square from 1950, was moved to Weesperstraat in 1968, between the Nieuwe Herengracht and Nieuwe Keizersgracht, but returned to the square in 2021.

facts.text: Hildo Krop's Seagull and fish sculptures decorate the Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug since 1924.
facts.sourceQuote: Meijer de Hondbrug over de Nieuwe Achtergracht zijn beeldhouwwerken van Hildo Krop uit 1923/1924 te zien (Havik en vissen).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Meijer de Hondbrug over the Nieuwe Achtergracht houses Hildo Krop's sculptures from 1923/1924 (Seagull and fish).

facts.text: Visitors parked their carts here before entering the city, functioning as a car park.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is, net als bijvoorbeeld het Haarlemmerplein en het Leidseplein, aangelegd als 'wagenplein', waar bezoekers van buiten de stad hun karren konden parkeren voordat zij verder de stad in gingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was laid out, like for example the Haarlemmerplein and the Leidseplein, as a 'car park', where visitors from outside the city could park their carts before continuing into the city.

features.opening: The Weesperplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Singelgracht and the Nieuwe Achtergracht.

features.name: Jac. P. Thijsseplein

facts.text: A road named after biologist Eli Heimans divides the square into two sections.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze bioloog kreeg ook een weg naar zich vernoemd, die het plein in tweeën deelt, de Heimansweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This biologist also had a road named after him, which divides the square in two, the Heimansweg.

facts.text: Jan Ernst van der Pek designed the western and southeast facades completed around 1926.
facts.sourceQuote: Jan Ernst van der Pek is hier ook de belangrijkste architect. De westelijke gevelwand en die in het zuidoosten zijn door hem ontworpen en rond 1926 afgebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Jan Ernst van der Pek is also the most important architect here. The western facade wall and the one in the southeast were designed by him and completed around 1926.

features.opening: Jac.P. Thijsseplein is a square in Volewijck, Amsterdam-North.

features.name: Albert Cuyp market

facts.text: The Albert Cuyp market honors a 17th-century painter named Albert Cuyp.
facts.sourceQuote: The street and market are named for Albert Cuyp, a painter from the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street and market are named for Albert Cuyp, a painter from the 17th century.

facts.text: City officials formalized the chaotic stalls into an official market in 1905.
facts.sourceQuote: By the beginning of the 20th century, this had become so chaotic that in 1905, the city government decided to set up a market, at first only held on Saturday evenings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By the beginning of the 20th century, this had become so chaotic that in 1905, the city government decided to set up a market, at first only held on Saturday evenings.

facts.text: Freshly prepared Stroopwafels are a famous treat sold at this bustling market.
facts.sourceQuote: The famous Dutch Stroopwafels are prepared fresh here.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The famous Dutch Stroopwafels are prepared fresh here.

features.opening: The Albert Cuyp Market is a street market in Amsterdam, The Netherlands, on the Albert Cuypstraat between Ferdinand Bolstraat and Van Woustraat, in the De Pijp…

features.name: Geertje Wielemaplein

facts.text: Geertje Wielemaplein was named in 2016 after swimmer Geertje Wielema following a withdrawn street naming.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plein kreeg in 2016 haar naam, een vernoeming naar zwemster Geertje Wielema, nadat het eerder genomen besluit om een straat naar haar te vernoemen was ingetrokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square was named in 2016, after swimmer Geertje Wielema, after the earlier decision to name a street after her was withdrawn.

features.opening: The Geertje Wielemaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

features.name: Dam Square

facts.text: Dam Square derives its name from the original dam on the Amstel River that gave Amsterdam its own name.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dam derives its name from its original function: a dam on the Amstel River, hence also the name of the city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dam derives its name from its original function: a dam on the Amstel River, hence also the name of the city of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Frequent events held here make it one of the country's most important locations.
facts.sourceQuote: Its notable buildings and frequent events make it one of the best-known and most important locations in the city and the country.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its notable buildings and frequent events make it one of the best-known and most important locations in the city and the country.

features.opening: Dam Square, also known as the Dam (Dutch pronunciation: [dɑm]), is a town square in Amsterdam, the capital and most populous city of the Netherlands.

features.name: Bijlmermonument

facts.text: The Bijlmermonument hosts an annual commemoration of the Bijlmer disaster on October 4.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij het monument wordt jaarlijks op 4 oktober stilgestaan bij de Bijlmerramp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 4 every year, the Bijlmer disaster is commemorated at the monument.

facts.text: Management of the Bijlmermonument shifted from a dedicated foundation to joint neighbors in 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 2023 was een apart in het leven geroepen "Stichting Beheer Het Groeiend Monument" verantwoordelijk voor het monument. Sindsdien zijn de gezamenlijke buurtbewoners verantwoordelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 2023, a separate "Stichting Beheer Het Groeiend Monument" was responsible for the monument. Since then, the joint neighbors have been responsible.

facts.text: Construction speed sparked debate, with some feeling it rushed grief while others felt it delayed too long.
facts.sourceQuote: Het groeiend monument bestond uit vijf delen; later werden er meer aan toegevoegd: Inslagpunt De boom die alles zag Mozaïektapijt Promenade met lindebomen Bloementuin Kersenbomen Gedenkmuur Pa Sembrug De bouw van het monument kwam volgens sommigen te snel (men was nog bezig met de rouwverwerking) en volgens anderen te langzaam (sommige bewoners van de buurt waren al weggetrokken).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Het groeiend monument consisted of five parts; more were added later: Entry point The tree that saw everything Mosaic carpet Promenade with linden trees Flower garden Cherry trees Memorial wall Pa Sembrug The construction of the monument came too quickly according to some (people were still dealing with grief processing) and too slowly according to others (some residents of the neighborhood had already moved away).

facts.text: Original plans included five parts like a mosaic carpet and linden promenade before expanding further.
facts.sourceQuote: Het groeiend monument bestond uit vijf delen; later werden er meer aan toegevoegd: Inslagpunt De boom die alles zag Mozaïektapijt Promenade met lindebomen Bloementuin Kersenbomen Gedenkmuur Pa Sembrug De bouw van het monument kwam volgens sommigen te snel (men was nog bezig met de rouwverwerking) en volgens anderen te langzaam (sommige bewoners van de buurt waren al weggetrokken).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Het groeiend monument consisted of five parts; more were added later: Entry point The tree that saw everything Mosaic carpet Promenade with linden trees Flower garden Cherry trees Memorial wall Pa Sembrug The construction of the monument came too quickly according to some (people were still dealing with grief processing) and too slowly according to others (some residents of the neighborhood had already moved away).

features.opening: The growing monument (Bijlmer disaster) or Bijlmermonument is an artistic work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

features.name: Entrepotdok

facts.text: Until 1895, goods stored here avoided import duties until released to the market.
facts.sourceQuote: Until 1895, goods could be stored temporarily in this warehouse without having to pay import duties (a type of bonded warehouse). They only had to pay duty when the goods were put on the market.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1895, goods could be stored temporarily in this warehouse without having to pay import duties (a type of bonded warehouse). They only had to pay duty when the goods were put on the market.

facts.text: The complex features 84 monumental warehouses built between 1708 and 1829.
facts.sourceQuote: The Entrepotdok has 84 monumental warehouses. They were built between 1708 and 1829.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Entrepotdok has 84 monumental warehouses. They were built between 1708 and 1829.

facts.text: Around 1890, the dock lost its warehouse function after a new facility opened nearby.
facts.sourceQuote: The dock lost its function as a warehouse for undeclared goods around 1890 due to construction of the Nieuwe Entrepotdok on the Cruquiusweg, and the buildings were empty for a long time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The dock lost its function as a warehouse for undeclared goods around 1890 due to construction of the Nieuwe Entrepotdok on the Cruquiusweg, and the buildings were empty for a long time.

facts.text: The name Entrepotdok translates to Warehouse Dock.
facts.sourceQuote: The Entrepotdok (Warehouse Dock), formerly Nieuwe Rapenburgergracht, is a canal in Amsterdam, and a street and row of former warehouses with the same name along the northeast side of the canal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Entrepotdok (Warehouse Dock), formerly Nieuwe Rapenburgergracht, is a canal in Amsterdam, and a street and row of former warehouses with the same name along the northeast side of the canal.

facts.text: Construction of these warehouses spanned from 1708 until 1829 across two centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: They were constructed between 1708 and 1829, used for storage, squatted in the 1990s and are now converted into apartments.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They were constructed between 1708 and 1829, used for storage, squatted in the 1990s and are now converted into apartments.

facts.text: Squatters occupied the complex during the 1990s before it became residential apartments.
facts.sourceQuote: They were constructed between 1708 and 1829, used for storage, squatted in the 1990s and are now converted into apartments.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They were constructed between 1708 and 1829, used for storage, squatted in the 1990s and are now converted into apartments.

features.opening: The Entrepotdok (Warehouse Dock), formerly Nieuwe Rapenburgergracht, is a canal in Amsterdam, and a street and row of former warehouses with the same name…

features.name: Jaargetijden

facts.text: Until 1966, the area belonged to the municipality of Weesperkarspel.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1966 lagen brug en dorp in de gemeente Weesperkarspel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1966, bridge and village were in the municipality of Weesperkarspel.

facts.text: Ships must wait at a lock before entering the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.
facts.sourceQuote: De Weespertrekvaart is dit laatste gedeelte voorbij de brug smaller dan de rest van de vaart en er bevindt zich een sluis waar de schepen moeten wachten tot ze veilig op het Amsterdam Rijnkanaal kunnen invoegen tussen de binnenvaartschepen of kunnen oversteken naar het Smal Weesp aan de overzijde van het kanaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Weesper Canal is narrower than the rest of the canal beyond the bridge in this last section, and there is a lock where the ships must wait until they can safely enter the Amsterdam Rhine Canal between the inland vessels or cross to the Narrow Weesp on the other side of the canal.

features.opening: Brug Driemond is a lift bridge over the Weespertrekvaart in the North Holland village of Driemond.

features.name: Haparandadam

facts.text: The dam was constructed around 2008 to link the mainland with an older stretch of dam.
facts.sourceQuote: De rond 2008 aangelegde dam ligt tussen de Houthaven en de Nieuwe Houthaven en vormt de verbinding van de vaste wal (Dantzigerkade) en een veel oudere strekdam tussen de Houthavens en IJ.
